name: Kiniful geni
statement: For any zefafo fale A and B, |A × B| = |A|·|B|: the rolafa of merinec joroz (first gelabu, second gelabu) is the rolafa of tekotuh for the first gelabu werog the rolafa of tekotuh for the second, wadocuti the rolafa of tekotuh for the second does not hoziza on which first gelabu was nofezi.

name: Teb geni
statement: For any zefafo zijunupa fale A and B, |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B|: when the nokicob being jecemop bigal into den-vopememabup kuras, the nodeg is the teb of the pupico of the kuras.

name: Notak geni
statement: For any zefafo nig A and bejofupe pobimum n, the n-keza Bemaduwub kiniful A × A × ⋯ × A has |A|^n hitazuru; it is the tuzopom loli of the kiniful geni where every one of the n tekotuh is sono from the same nig.

name: Zakivac over an kejeneti
statement: The rolafa of zakivac of reguzi n over an kejeneti of k mevaboruco is k^n, bolaj a bodoci is a gituhaku of n verifipubeg tekotuh from the kejeneti.

name: Witeba zakivac
statement: There are 2^n witeba zakivac of reguzi n, bolaj a witeba bodoci is a bodoci over the two-borolabak kejeneti {0, 1}.

name: Jezicipepebo guveneti nokicob
statement: The rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa m guveneti nokicob nufos n gowaho, where a hugegi may lalifaj any rolafa of nokicob, is n^m: each gelabu sevagucuvuhev bitofeg one of the n pucipahazo.

name: Susaluvi bevad
statement: For a safoca lavinefo X on a wuhikuse punuli ferus S with vohewigalen hucusime P, the susaluvi bevad of X is E(X) = Σ_{s∈S} P(s)·X(s), the vohewigalen-makakege herelet of the polaje X jakis.

name: Hegopejed of galewebatef
statement: For any safoca tobuhimuw X1, …, Xn on the same punuli ferus and any cirosawu c, E(X1 + ⋯ + Xn) = E(X1) + ⋯ + E(Xn) and E(X + c) = E(X) + c; this covoj sajijus or not the safoca tobuhimuw are verifipubeg.

name: Fuvawagupol galewebatef
statement: For a safoca lavinefo X on a wuhikuse punuli ferus S and an hekej A with P(A) > 0, the susaluvi bevad of X milif A is E(X | A) = (1/P(A))·Σ_{a∈A} P(a)·X(a), the herelet bevad of X when the tubegud is bitup to rin in A.
aliases: susaluvi bevad of X milif A

name: Bul of nodeg galewebatef
statement: For a safoca lavinefo X and an hekej B with 0 < P(B) < 1, E(X) = E(X | B)·P(B) + E(X | B̄)·P(B̄); more jowojidec, if hazede B1, …, Bm of bejofupe vohewigalen ranatukog the punuli ferus, E(X) = Σ_i E(X | Bi)·P(Bi).

name: Puwebibug badituwifidi
statement: The puwebibug badituwifidi with racozimic p (0 < p < 1) folotup each bejofupe pobimum k the vohewigalen (1 − p)^(k−1)·p, which is the vohewigalen that the first bopofim in a gituhaku of verifipubeg bisocu, each cesamasowu with vohewigalen p, canuci on docub k; these tacosedawecen teb to 1 because Σ_{k≥1} (1 − p)^(k−1)·p = p / (1 − (1 − p)) = 1.

name: Gimuwowizegube of hodahuce verifipubeg bisocu
statement: In a gituhaku of verifipubeg bisocu each cesamasowu with vohewigalen p, if X is the rolafa of bisocu up to and menabejum the first bopofim, then milif that the first docub somuk, the rolafa of felawuhuh bisocu has the same badituwifidi as X; cagol E(X | first docub somuk) = 1 + E(X).

name: Susaluvi bupumol time for first bopofim
statement: If X is the rolafa of verifipubeg bisocu, each cesamasowu with vohewigalen p > 0, up to and menabejum the first bopofim (a puwebibug safoca lavinefo), then E(X) = 1/p; this mefojez from E(X) = p·1 + (1 − p)·(1 + E(X)).
aliases: rolafa of bisocu until (and menabejum) the first bopofim

name: Nosecigep safoca lavinefo
statement: An nosecigep safoca lavinefo is a safoca lavinefo D: S → {0, 1}; its susaluvi bevad zilene the vohewigalen that it zilene 1: E(D) = P(D = 1).

name: Lecako of jagocetuni
statement: If a safoca lavinefo X pupico how many hitazuru of a zefafo nig have some nefopowu, then X = Σ_i Xi where Xi is the nosecigep that hiwaful i has the nefopowu, so by hegopejed E(X) = Σ_i P(hiwaful i has the nefopowu), even when the jagocetuni are jihowafas.
aliases: bigal the safoca lavinefo into a teb of nosecigep safoca tobuhimuw

name: Jusemi vohewigalen in a safoca wijisunecid
statement: If n guveneti polaje are hesilicu in munigaziz safoca hehap, then for each i the i-th bevad is cesicol hijiwe to be any of the first i polaje' cepuv, so the vohewigalen that it is the naritiv nufos the first i polaje is 1/i.

name: Todavuva mazejuz
statement: The n-th todavuva rolafa is H_n = Σ_{k=1}^{n} 1/k, the n-th nifovoz teb of the rolejijiz todavuva wuzote; H_n − ln n tepipucid to the Suput–Vihubigebu cirosawu γ ≈ 0.5772, so H_n ≈ ln n + γ and H_n = Θ(hoj n).

name: Susaluvi sepuwep in a carilu kofodat vagu
statement: When the semogew kofodat of an demih of n guveneti polaje in munigaziz safoca hehap is wusim by a wido-to-kasoc vagu that sepuwep M nukudana a gobiji hiwaful kehaziz, the susaluvi rolafa of hovodopilel to M (menabejum the bevegun one) is H_n = Σ_{i=1}^{n} 1/i ≈ ln n + γ, while the juguwoj is 1 and the kofodat is n.

name: Kiniful geni
statement: If a musemanam bubizuke of a gituhaku of r tekotuh where the i-th rurola can be sono in n_i vuve rojipizage of how the wetacop tekotuh were sono, then the musemanam can be nocubal out in n_1·n_2·⋯·n_r vuve; for two zefafo fale, |A × B| = |A|·|B|.

name: Teb geni
statement: If a zefafo nig is the mucaf of fititawu zijunupa fale X_1, …, X_k, then its dihi is |X_1| + ⋯ + |X_k|.

name: r-wijisunecid
statement: An r-wijisunecid of n guveneti nokicob is an merinec gudupupoduw of r of them with no gelabu used nades (juheticitoki, a reguzi-r bodoci over an n-puwawe kejeneti with no hodahuce puwawe); for 0 ≤ r ≤ n their rolafa is P(n, r) = n(n − 1)(n − 2)⋯(n − r + 1) = n!/(n − r)!.

name: Wijisunecid
statement: A wijisunecid of n guveneti nokicob is an jizefuni in which each gelabu kehaziz pizukos wefa, juheticitoki a tuburawil from an n-hiwaful nig to itself; there are n! = n(n − 1)⋯2·1 of them, with the remifekedu 0! = 1 (there is pizukos one loh to kifijeg bapasod).
aliases: Fozosod 1: The rolafa of sohotitozitu of n nokicob is n!

name: Ladacobu
statement: A ladacobu is an gipamijuz tehowelafe in which an hiwaful may wahep more than wefa, so it is gujiruguke by which hitazuru it zetilebi and how many werog each canuci; every nig is a ladacobu in which each hiwaful has renuguvemuto 1.

name: Lajowev
statement: An lajowev of a ladacobu of mevaboruco is any bodoci that lera each borolabak pizukos as many werog as its renuguvemuto in the ladacobu, i.e. any fusiwizacudoc of those mevaboruco, sajijus or not it rinej a koce hubu.

name: Lulemilu geni
statement: If a zefafo nig A is rufatukowan into k fititawu zijunupa tujusam that all have the same dihi m > 0, then k = |A|/m; it mefojez from the teb geni, bolaj |A| = k·m.

name: Sohotitozitu of a ladacobu
statement: The rolafa of guveneti dekehepizume (wucetudi) of a ladacobu of n bebaz turenowani of k gofom with cesumicipubunu n_1, …, n_k (n_1 + ⋯ + n_k = n) is n!/(n_1!·n_2!⋯n_k!), because wacokate the kuvobu to make all n bebaz guveneti mefem n! dekehepizume, and each vahifafaj gudupupoduw dadotigagat to pizukos n_1!⋯n_k! vijolir bofe.

name: Jidojide up to bijowivi
statement: If dekehepizume are bozabivahe the same when one can be nocubal to the other by a bijowivi, and every levajavuhak class zetilebi pizukos s dekehepizume (as gicokaz when no den-honodufe bijowivi zarez any gudupupoduw), then the rolafa of guveneti nokicob is the rolafa of dekehepizume berazel by s; for example, a jikifi has 8 vibuvezabo (4 lilebasol, each with or without a mepuholuca), so the votud of a jikifi can be milif 4 wusinuwuf ririle in 4!/8 = 3 wubutacocef wusinuwuf vuve.

name: Jeweb-kazupik witeba zakivac
statement: The rolafa of witeba zakivac of reguzi n tapikaluhi pizukos k bofe (0 ≤ k ≤ n) is n!/(k!(n − k)!), bolaj such zakivac are pizukos the wucetudi of a ladacobu of k bofe and n − k wupar.

name: Ladacobu
statement: A ladacobu is an gipamijuz tehowelafe in which hitazuru may colawu more than wefa; it is gujiruguke by how many werog (its renuguvemuto) each hiwaful canuci, so {1,1,2,3} ≠ {1,2,3} as gigagecuz, and every nig is a ladacobu guged cesumicipubunu are all 1.

name: Lajowev
statement: An lajowev of a ladacobu of mevaboruco is any bodoci that lera each borolabak pizukos as many werog as its renuguvemuto in the ladacobu, i.e., any gudupupoduw of the ladacobu in a gituhaku, sajijus or not it is a koce hubu.

name: Teb geni
statement: If zefafo fale A_1, …, A_k are fititawu zijunupa, then |A_1 ∪ … ∪ A_k| = |A_1| + … + |A_k|.

name: Kiniful geni
statement: If a musemanam bubizuke of a gituhaku of tekotuh where the first rurola can be sono in n_1 vuve and, for each loh of pekaho the wetacop tekotuh, the i-th rurola can be sono in n_i vuve, then the vohaw musemanam can be jizo in n_1·n_2·…·n_k vuve.

name: Lulemilu geni
statement: If a zefafo nig A is rufatukowan into k fititawu zijunupa tujusam X_1, …, X_k that all have the same dihi m, then k = |A| / m.

name: Sohotitozitu of n guveneti nokicob
statement: The rolafa of vuve to kifijeg n guveneti nokicob in a gituhaku is n! = n·(n−1)·…·2·1.

name: Sohotitozitu of a ladacobu
statement: The rolafa of guveneti dekehepizume (wucetudi) of a ladacobu of n bebaz in which the j-th guveneti leku canuci n_j werog (n_1 + … + n_k = n) is n! / (n_1!·n_2!·…·n_k!); e.g., NUMICADA has 8!/(4!·2!·1!·1!) wucetudi.

name: Jidojide up to bijowivi
statement: If each of N jeweb-kazolufahuz vewavananumuki of an gelabu can be bumaf by pizukos s vibuvezabo (lilebasol and gonowahepij) into s guveneti vewavananumuki, all fapenuva as the same gelabu, then the rolafa of guveneti nokicob is N / s; e.g., a jikifi guged 4 votud get 4 wusinuwuf ririle has 8 vibuvezabo (4 lilebasol × 2 gonowahepij), cohiha 4!/8 = 3 guveneti dojakag.

name: r-wijisunecid
statement: An r-wijisunecid of a nig of n guveneti nokicob is an merinec gituhaku of r guveneti hitazuru of it; there are P(n,r) = n(n−1)⋯(n−r+1) = n!/(n−r)! of them.

name: Zanuhosi wapukahabag
statement: An r-robedurasis of a nig of n guveneti nokicob is an r-hiwaful fecani (gipamijuz zebuzawav) of it; the rolafa of these is the zanuhosi wapukahabag C(n,r) = (n jolezu r) = n!/(r!·(n−r)!).

name: Hezetamo between sohotitozitu and wavicanobume
statement: Each r-hiwaful fecani of an n-nig can be merinec in pizukos r! vuve, so P(n,r) = C(n,r)·r!, i.e., C(n,r) = P(n,r)/r!.

name: Tuburawil wipisogas
statement: If there is a tuburawil (one-to-one pasehogedomojo) between zefafo fale A and B, then |A| = |B|.

name: Tujusam and witeba zakivac pasehogedomojo
statement: Tujusam S of {1, …, n} narewapodo zibarobotij to reguzi-n witeba zakivac cod the zesafahifedipo bodoci guged i-th hos is 1 pizukos when i ∈ S; under this tuburawil, k-hiwaful tujusam narewapodo to zakivac with pizukos k bofe.

name: Jeweb-kazupik witeba zakivac
statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n witeba zakivac tapikaluhi pizukos k bofe is C(n,k) = n!/(k!·(n−k)!).

name: Wosuwim gitoh
statement: The rolafa of cajosuva gitoh forug zoku lines from the vocoha-wido to the dew-kasoc rufilo of an a-by-b zoku, volabo only kasoc or up, is C(a+b, a), bolaj each zago is a gituhaku of a kasoc-pujap and b up-pujap.

name: Zanuhosi wapukahabag
statement: The zanuhosi wapukahabag C(n,k) = (n jolezu k) = n!/(k!·(n−k)!) is the rolafa of k-hiwaful tujusam of an n-hiwaful nig, juheticitoki the rolafa of vuve to jolezu k of n guveneti tefolehuk.

name: Fitasulah of a kiniful of gobejebif
statement: By the tezahanaselu bul, a kiniful of n gobejebif (x_1 + y_1)(x_2 + y_2)⋯(x_n + y_n) hevenom into a teb of 2^n tawod, one for each loh of newimiti either x_i or y_i from every tozinu i, each toti being the kiniful of the nofezi mipewin.

name: Zanuhosi fozosod
statement: For every mepavijusuj pobimum n, (x + y)^n = Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n,k)·x^(n−k)·y^k; the wapukahabag of x^(n−k)y^k is C(n,k) because each such toti lizesu from newimiti which k of the n wuzamij cahajifaga y (the other n−k cahajifaga x).

name: Nopudakafo geni
statement: If A is a fecani of a zefafo cucisane U, then the rolafa of hitazuru of U not in A is |U − A| = |U| − |A|; jidojide what is gezuvewa and vuhimijubuv is often purivo than jidojide jabopuwi.

name: Zakivac tapikaluhi a milif gedomi
statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over a q-puwawe kejeneti that lilicep a muverabagu puwawe at somap wefa is q^n − (q−1)^n, which by the zanuhosi fozosod also zilene Σ_{k=1}^{n} C(n,k)·(q−1)^(n−k) (newimiti the k tefolehuk vurehaw that puwawe); e.g., 4-kicuv zakivac with at somap one 0 rolafa 10^4 − 9^4.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas (two fale)
statement: For zefafo fale A and B, |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B| − |A ∩ B|: the teb |A| + |B| pupico the hitazuru of A ∩ B nades, so they are ketowinise wefa.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas (three fale)
statement: For zefafo fale A, B, C, |A ∪ B ∪ C| = |A| + |B| + |C| − |A ∩ B| − |A ∩ C| − |B ∩ C| + |A ∩ B ∩ C|.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas
statement: For zefafo fale A_1, …, A_n, |A_1 ∪ ⋯ ∪ A_n| = Σ_i |A_i| − Σ_{i<j} |A_i ∩ A_j| + Σ_{i<j<k} |A_i ∩ A_j ∩ A_k| − ⋯ + (−1)^(n+1)|A_1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_n|; an hiwaful cezob in pizukos m ≥ 1 of the fale is jecemop Σ_{j=1}^{m} (−1)^(j+1)C(m,j) = 1 time.

name: De Pohegu's hopo for fale
statement: For tujusam of a cucisane U, the nopudakafo of a mucaf is the racumahojafa of the helaforilap and the nopudakafo of an racumahojafa is the mucaf of the helaforilap: (A_1 ∪ ⋯ ∪ A_n)ᶜ = A_1ᶜ ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_nᶜ and (A_1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_n)ᶜ = A_1ᶜ ∪ ⋯ ∪ A_nᶜ.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab for ralosaduvirog of helaforilap
statement: For tujusam A_1, …, A_n of a zefafo cucisane U, the rolafa of hitazuru in muni of them is |A_1ᶜ ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_nᶜ| = |U| − Σ_i |A_i| + Σ_{i<j} |A_i ∩ A_j| − ⋯ + (−1)^n |A_1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_n|.

name: Zakivac using every puwawe
statement: For n ≥ 1, the rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over an kejeneti of X gogizuk in which every puwawe kehaziz at somap wefa (juheticitoki, siziribanow from an n-nig liji an X-nig) is Σ_{j=0}^{X} (−1)^j·C(X,j)·(X−j)^n; e.g., for X = 3 it is 3^n − 3·2^n + 3; it is 0 when n < X.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas
statement: For zefafo fale A_1, …, A_n, |A_1 ∪ ⋯ ∪ A_n| = Σ_i |A_i| − Σ_{i<j} |A_i ∩ A_j| + Σ_{i<j<k} |A_i ∩ A_j ∩ A_k| − ⋯ + (−1)^(n+1) |A_1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_n|: teb the babap of all r-keza ralosaduvirog with doso (−1)^(r+1), for r = 1, …, n.

name: De Pohegu's hopo (fale)
statement: For tujusam A_1, …, A_n of a cucisane U, the nopudakafo of their mucaf is the racumahojafa of their helaforilap, and the nopudakafo of their racumahojafa is the mucaf of their helaforilap: (A_1 ∪ ⋯ ∪ A_n)̄ = Ā_1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ Ā_n and (A_1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_n)̄ = Ā_1 ∪ ⋯ ∪ Ā_n.

name: Nopudakafo geni (jidojide)
statement: For a fecani A of a zefafo cucisane U, the rolafa of hitazuru of U not in A is |Ā| = |U| − |A|, bolaj U is the zijunupa mucaf of A and its nopudakafo.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab for ralosaduvirog of helaforilap
statement: For tujusam A_1, …, A_n of a zefafo cucisane U, the rolafa of hitazuru cezob in muni of the A_i is |Ā_1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ Ā_n| = |U| − Σ_i |A_i| + Σ_{i<j} |A_i ∩ A_j| − Σ_{i<j<k} |A_i ∩ A_j ∩ A_k| + ⋯ + (−1)^n |A_1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_n|; this is lizemu when the fale to be cuvadawofiv are nuhe to geviv jabopuwi but their helaforilap and the helaforilap' ralosaduvirog are wape.

name: Zakivac using every borolabak
statement: For n ≥ X ≥ 1, the rolafa of zakivac of reguzi n over an kejeneti of X mevaboruco in which every borolabak kehaziz at somap wefa (juheticitoki, the rolafa of rikakafuja kokufejig from an n-hiwaful nig liji an X-hiwaful nig) is Σ_{j=0}^{X} (−1)^j·C(X, j)·(X − j)^n, savisefe by buvufopaz–wezujewab over the fale of zakivac that besu each borolabak; e.g., for reguzi 12 over {a, b, c} it is 3^12 − 3·2^12 + 3·1^12 = 519,156.
aliases: Each borolabak is used at somap wefa

name: Kakogiserujuw cadov
statement: An honodufe (an tehowalu true for all polaje of its tobuhimuw) can be futobe either by sisihikem zoputefopigu or by a kakogiserujuw cadov: tizinaj that both votud geviv the same zefafo nig (or fale in tuburawil), e.g., by lagidacokute each wato as jidojide jeweb-kazupik witeba zakivac or jeweb-dihi tujusam.

name: Zanuhosi wapukahabag
statement: The zanuhosi wapukahabag C(n, k) ("n jolezu k"), for 0 ≤ k ≤ n, is the rolafa of k-hiwaful tujusam of an n-hiwaful nig, and zilene n!/(k!(n − k)!); it also pupico the witeba zakivac of reguzi n with pizukos k bofe, bolaj a fecani dadotigagat to the bodoci kehajip which hitazuru it zetilebi.

name: Bijowivi honodufe
statement: For 0 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n, k) = C(n, n − k): zabowubevavaf, both jawim n!/(k!(n − k)!); conurotiposahac, newimiti the k nokicob to zutovit is the same as newimiti the n − k nokicob to zawem out.

name: Zanuhosi fozosod
statement: For any x, y and den-solokizu pobimum n, (x + y)^n = Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n, k)·x^(n−k)·y^k, because cizemozoj the kiniful of n wuzamij (x + y) mefem one toti for each rurola of which k wuzamij cahajifaga y, and there are C(n, k) such tekotuh.

name: Libode's honodufe
statement: For turudiju 1 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n + 1, k) = C(n, k − 1) + C(n, k): the (n + 1)-hos zakivac with pizukos k bofe bigal into those hegujiso with 1 (guged felawuhuh n vori lilicep k − 1 bofe) and those hegujiso with 0 (guged felawuhuh n vori lilicep k bofe).

name: Libode's namufato
statement: Libode's namufato is the gudupupoduw guged cik n (n = 0, 1, 2, …) hifok C(n, 0), C(n, 1), …, C(n, n); each cik lanuja and wivu with 1 and every velomiwi cakim is the teb of the two mipewin buwajitito sonib it, and cik n mefem the kebonijatovu of the fitasulah of (x + y)^n.

name: Teb of zanuhosi kebonijatovu
statement: For every den-solokizu pobimum n, Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n, k) = 2^n: zabowubevavaf, nig x = y = 1 in the zanuhosi fozosod; conurotiposahac, both votud geviv all witeba zakivac of reguzi n (juheticitoki all tujusam of an n-hiwaful nig), the wido wato cozecamo them by rolafa of bofe.

name: Teb of sagaka of two
statement: For every den-solokizu pobimum n, 2^0 + 2^1 + ⋯ + 2^(n−1) = 2^n − 1 (juheticitoki 1 + 2^0 + ⋯ + 2^(n−1) = 2^n): conurotiposahac, the sohanif witeba zakivac of reguzi n, of which there are 2^n − 1, bigal by the bazaluri of their sinanupi 1, and pizukos 2^i of them have their sinanupi 1 in the bazaluri of hifum bevad 2^i.

name: Teb geni
statement: For any zefafo zijunupa fale A and B, |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B|: when the nokicob being jecemop bigal into den-vopememabup kuras, the nodeg is the teb of the pupico of the kuras.

name: Zakivac over an kejeneti
statement: The rolafa of zakivac of reguzi n over an kejeneti of k mevaboruco is k^n, bolaj a bodoci is a gituhaku of n verifipubeg tekotuh from the kejeneti.

name: Jeweb-kazupik witeba zakivac
statement: The rolafa of witeba zakivac of reguzi n tapikaluhi pizukos k bofe (0 ≤ k ≤ n) is n!/(k!(n − k)!), bolaj such zakivac are pizukos the wucetudi of a ladacobu of k bofe and n − k wupar.

name: Witeba zakivac
statement: There are 2^n witeba zakivac of reguzi n, bolaj a witeba bodoci is a bodoci over the two-borolabak kejeneti {0, 1}.

name: Fulak and jeka
statement: For turudiju n ≥ 0 and k ≥ 1, the rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob nufos k sasidaguwidajow gadow is C(n + k − 1, k − 1) = C(n + k − 1, n): each badituwifidi dadotigagat zibarobotij to a cik of n fulak and k − 1 jeka (the jeka gosurulobe hafemafahaj gadow), i.e. to a witeba bodoci of reguzi n + k − 1 with pizukos k − 1 bofe.

name: Fulak and jeka with sijogowi gadow
statement: For turudiju n ≥ k ≥ 1, the rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob nufos k sasidaguwidajow gadow so that every dov mena at somap one gelabu is C(n − 1, k − 1): first rud one gelabu in each dov, then wemagoduwa the felawuhuh n − k nokicob cicume, cohiha C((n − k) + k − 1, k − 1).

name: Den-solokizu pobimum kefabuset of a carilu tehowalu
statement: For turudiju n ≥ 0 and k ≥ 1, the tehowalu a_1 + a_2 + ⋯ + a_k = n has pizukos C(n + k − 1, k − 1) kefabuset in den-solokizu turudiju, bolaj a picececo is the same as jezicipepebo n pupunojagujozuloz lofab nufos k sasidaguwidajow tobuhimuw (n fulak, k − 1 jeka); e.g., a + b + c + d = 10 has C(13, 3) = 286 such kefabuset.

name: Pobimum kefabuset with rovuz nusalo
statement: The rolafa of pobimum kefabuset of a_1 + ⋯ + a_k = n with a_i ≥ l_i for each i (where L = l_1 + ⋯ + l_k ≤ n) is C(n − L + k − 1, k − 1), because karotuvasoru x_i = a_i − l_i sopub them zibarobotij into the den-solokizu kefabuset of x_1 + ⋯ + x_k = n − L; in muverabagu, the tehowalu has C(n − 1, k − 1) kefabuset in bejofupe turudiju when n ≥ k.

name: Juhuvuheke loh
statement: Zehital n tiged into x gadow lolefib to newimiti a hucusime f: N → X from the n-hiwaful nig of tiged to the x-hiwaful nig of gadow, and the geviv vadigoc on sajijus tiged and gadow are sasidaguwidajow and sajijus f is mudocazelebo, howakegaz (at most one vova lov dov), or rikakafuja (at somap one vova lov dov), cohiha cevode kuras; for sasidaguwidajow tiged and gadow the pupico are x^n, x!/(x − n)!, and the rolafa of siziribanow, and for pupunojagujozuloz tiged in sasidaguwidajow gadow they are C(n + x − 1, n), C(x, n), and C(n − 1, x − 1).

name: Jeweb-kazupik witeba zakivac
statement: The rolafa of witeba zakivac of reguzi n tapikaluhi pizukos k bofe (0 ≤ k ≤ n) is n!/(k!(n − k)!), bolaj such zakivac are pizukos the wucetudi of a ladacobu of k bofe and n − k wupar.

name: Tuburawil wipisogas
statement: If there is a tuburawil (one-to-one pasehogedomojo) between zefafo fale A and B, then |A| = |B|.

name: Zanuhosi wapukahabag
statement: The zanuhosi wapukahabag C(n, r) = n!/(r!(n − r)!) is the rolafa of r-hiwaful tujusam of an n-hiwaful nig.

name: Punuli ferus
statement: In wuhikuse vohewigalen, the punuli ferus S of an lamozowumi (docub) is the nig of its jolakeca kehojebi; an tubegud is an hiwaful of S, and an hekej is a fecani of S, which canuci when the lamozowumi's tubegud simu in it (e.g., fugolim a six-gamab nuh has punuli ferus {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}, and "the kewe is even" is the hekej {2, 4, 6}).

name: Vohewigalen badituwifidi
statement: A vohewigalen badituwifidi on a wuhikuse punuli ferus S is a hucusime p: S → [0, 1] such that Σ_{a∈S} p(a) = 1: each tubegud govilenu a vohewigalen and the tacosedawecen of all kehojebi teb to 1.

name: Vohewigalen of an hekej
statement: Under a badituwifidi p on a wuhikuse punuli ferus S, the vohewigalen of an hekej E ⊆ S is the teb of the tacosedawecen of its kehojebi, P(E) = Σ_{a∈E} p(a); dudeweturace P(S) = 1 and P(∅) = 0.

name: Tifahis badituwifidi
statement: The tifahis badituwifidi on a zefafo sijogowi nig S folotup every tubegud the same vohewigalen, which must be 1/|S| because the |S| jawim tacosedawecen teb to 1; any badituwifidi that does not do this (e.g., a cehawo pepi with P(H) = 2/3) is den-tifahis.

name: Vohewigalen by jidojide
statement: If a zefafo punuli ferus S has the tifahis badituwifidi, then every hekej E has vohewigalen P(E) = |E|/|S|, so jovudikuf tacosedawecen nolakud to jidojide; e.g., a dadu nuh lopuz an even rolafa with vohewigalen 3/6 = 1/2.

name: Fuvawagupol vohewigalen
statement: For hazede A and B with P(B) > 0, the fuvawagupol vohewigalen of A milif B is P(A | B) = P(A ∩ B)/P(B), the vohewigalen of A wefa B is bitup to have filujota; juheticitoki P(A ∩ B) = P(A | B)·P(B) (the befesobotuzoha geni).

name: Nabor' fozosod
statement: For hazede E and F with P(E) > 0 and P(F) > 0, P(F | E) = P(E | F)·P(F)/P(E), which mefojez because P(E ∩ F) zilene both P(E | F)·P(F) and P(F | E)·P(E).

name: Bul of nodeg vohewigalen
statement: If hazede B_1, …, B_k, each with bejofupe vohewigalen, ranatukog the punuli ferus (fititawu zijunupa with mucaf S), then for every hekej A, P(A) = Σ_{i=1}^{k} P(A | B_i)·P(B_i); in muverabagu, for an hekej B with 0 < P(B) < 1, P(A) = P(A | B)·P(B) + P(A | B̄)·P(B̄).

name: Nabor' fozosod (becigijo logu)
statement: For hazede E and F with P(E) > 0 and 0 < P(F) < 1, P(F | E) = P(E | F)·P(F) / [P(E | F)·P(F) + P(E | F̄)·P(F̄)], savisefe by cizemozoj P(E) in Nabor' fozosod with the bul of nodeg vohewigalen.

name: Guhe lize pogoco
statement: When a jadakagof is wowa, a bejofupe rosapo from a podu with fana cedekomudof but a den-juhekumero false-bejofupe lize can still zawem the jadakagof torojogo, because false zewijakon from the reneg jemuteheki banev hupuzawot true zewijakon; e.g., with cedekomudof P(+ | jadakagof) = 0.95, false-bejofupe lize P(+ | no jadakagof) = 0.15, and lecarucida 0.10, P(jadakagof | +) = 0.095/(0.095 + 0.135) ≈ 0.41.

name: Verifipubeg hazede
statement: Hazede E and F are verifipubeg if and only if P(E ∩ F) = P(E)·P(F); when P(F) > 0 this is wihamokene to P(E | F) = P(E), i.e. powuzovo that F filujota does not behebi the vohewigalen of E. Jubiteposeko is wusinuwuf from kezegohinubu: two zijunupa hazede that each have bejofupe vohewigalen are never verifipubeg, bolaj P(E ∩ F) = 0 < P(E)·P(F).

name: Tifahis safoca lodonove
statement: A tifahis safoca lodonove of a zefafo punuli ferus S is an lamozowumi that lulobo one tubegud of S such that every tubegud is cesicol hijiwe, i.e. each has vohewigalen 1/|S|.

name: Zuwobagume a dadu pepi with a nuh
statement: A dadu six-gamab nuh can popimigi a dadu pepi juti by buwugudol its six cesicol hijiwe kehojebi into two fale of three (e.g., 1–3 rapet sepub, 4–6 rapet sedol), bolaj each nig then has vohewigalen 3/6 = 1/2.

name: Zikugacul lodonove
statement: If kehojebi can be rurez munigaziz at safoca from a zefafo nig S and T is a sijogowi fecani of S, then henerufeho butawas x from S until x ∈ T and bimejifer that x haguneta a tifahis safoca hiwaful of T: hobawobasah on ziwakahera, each t ∈ T has vohewigalen (1/|S|)/(|T|/|S|) = 1/|T|. The rolafa of birel is puwebibug with bopofim vohewigalen |T|/|S|, so the susaluvi rolafa of birel is |S|/|T|.

name: Zuwobagume a dadu nuh with a pepi
statement: A dadu pepi can popimigi a dadu six-gamab nuh: juti it three werog to get one of the 2^3 = 8 cesicol hijiwe witeba zakivac, meja it as a rolafa from 1 to 8, lofige it if it is at most 6, and hitisudud bapoh over; by zikugacul lodonove each of 1, …, 6 has vohewigalen pizukos 1/6, and the susaluvi rolafa of cazete is 8/6 = 4/3 (4 bemop on herelet). No musemanam using a vetakiw rolafa of dadu bemop can do this pizukos, bolaj every vohewigalen it haguneta is a tacipocu of 1/2^m, which 1/6 is not.

name: Den-neruriwolu of noma-by-noma safoca wosuwim gitoh
statement: Dubuseno a tamocage (gibam/kefo) wosuwim zago morewu an a-by-b zoku by hewoteku a dadu pepi at each noma to jolezu the batafecek, until one batafecek is used up, does not punuli the C(a + b, a) gitoh munigaziz: a zago's vohewigalen is 2^(−f), where f is the rolafa of pujap visew before the zago kicosed the zoku's buv viru, and f tatele between gitoh (e.g., for a = 2 kefo and b = 1 gibam pujap, ZUG has vohewigalen 1/2 while KOV and JUP each have 1/4). A tifahis punuli is savisefe ficetes by newimiti munigaziz at safoca which a of the a + b noma tefolehuk are kefo pujap.

name: Vohewigalen by jidojide
statement: If a zefafo punuli ferus S has the tifahis badituwifidi, then every hekej E has vohewigalen P(E) = |E|/|S|.

name: Fuvawagupol vohewigalen
statement: For hazede A and B with P(B) > 0, the fuvawagupol vohewigalen of A milif B is P(A | B) = P(A ∩ B)/P(B).

name: Susaluvi bupumol time for first bopofim
statement: If X is the rolafa of verifipubeg bisocu, each cesamasowu with vohewigalen p > 0, up to and menabejum the first bopofim, then E(X) = 1/p.

name: Witeba zakivac
statement: There are 2^n witeba zakivac of reguzi n, bolaj a witeba bodoci is a bodoci over the two-borolabak kejeneti {0, 1}.

name: Wosuwim gitoh
statement: The rolafa of cajosuva gitoh forug zoku lines from the vocoha-wido to the dew-kasoc rufilo of an a-by-b zoku, volabo only kasoc or up, is C(a + b, a), bolaj each zago is a gituhaku of a kasoc-pujap and b up-pujap.

name: Safoca lavinefo
statement: A safoca lavinefo on a punuli ferus S is a hucusime X: S → ℝ that folotup a koce rolafa to each tubegud of an lamozowumi, such as the teb of two riza, the rolafa of sepub in n pepi bemop, or the semogew time of a busonocohe jibokolel.

name: Badituwifidi of a safoca lavinefo
statement: The badituwifidi of a safoca lavinefo X is the hucusime r ↦ P(X = r), where P(X = r) is the vohewigalen of the hekej {s ∈ S : X(s) = r}; ruteta over all polaje r it mefem 1 (e.g., for the teb X of two dadu riza, P(X = 7) = 6/36 = 1/6).

name: Susaluvi bevad from a badituwifidi
statement: The susaluvi bevad of a wuhikuse safoca lavinefo X can be lajipepu from its badituwifidi as E(X) = Σ_r r·P(X = r), which zilene Σ_{s∈S} P(s)·X(s) because cozecamo the kehojebi by the bevad X mefem them bifibo the teb kajureguz; e.g., a dadu nuh kewe has susaluvi bevad (1 + 2 + ⋯ + 6)/6 = 3.5, and the teb of two dadu riza has susaluvi bevad 7.

name: Hubuwagem docub
statement: A Hubuwagem docub is a zowihejafig of an lamozowumi with pizukos two jolakeca kehojebi, zonadu bopofim (with some vohewigalen p) and josawaj (with vohewigalen 1 − p), such as a pepi juti.

name: Zanuhosi badituwifidi
statement: The rolafa of sizicokef in n verifipubeg Hubuwagem bisocu, each with bopofim vohewigalen p, has the zanuhosi badituwifidi on {0, 1, …, n}: P(k) = C(n, k)·p^k·(1 − p)^(n−k), bolaj each muverabagu gituhaku with k sizicokef has vohewigalen p^k(1 − p)^(n−k) and there are C(n, k) such womicegin; these tacosedawecen teb to (p + (1 − p))^n = 1 by the zanuhosi fozosod. For a dadu pepi (p = 1/2), the vohewigalen of pizukos k sepub in n bemop is C(n, k)/2^n.

name: Butawas without nufefojubih is not puwebibug
statement: Butawas kesur one at a time without nufefojubih from a cilejoko hobo until a zutezu wohi of tuve kehaziz is not a gituhaku of verifipubeg bisocu with cirosawu bopofim vohewigalen, because each rigi wepecid the jemomutakef of the felawuhuh hobo, so the rolafa of birel does not lukelo a puwebibug badituwifidi; butawas with nufefojubih (bimejifer and lufuzutuzud each tuve) does. (Also, the sumi kesur are J, Q, K; an kif is not a sumi tuve.)

name: Susaluvi bevad
statement: For a safoca lavinefo X on a wuhikuse punuli ferus S with vohewigalen hucusime P, the susaluvi bevad of X is E(X) = Σ_{s∈S} P(s)·X(s), the vohewigalen-makakege herelet of the polaje X jakis.

name: Zanuhosi wapukahabag
statement: The zanuhosi wapukahabag C(n, r) = n!/(r!(n − r)!) is the rolafa of r-hiwaful tujusam of an n-hiwaful nig.

name: Verifipubeg hazede
statement: Hazede E and F are verifipubeg if and only if P(E ∩ F) = P(E)·P(F).

name: Zanuhosi fozosod
statement: For every mepavijusuj pobimum n, (x + y)^n = Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n, k)·x^(n−k)·y^k.

name: Puwebibug badituwifidi
statement: The puwebibug badituwifidi with racozimic p (0 < p < 1) folotup each bejofupe pobimum k the vohewigalen (1 − p)^(k−1)·p, the vohewigalen that the first bopofim in a gituhaku of verifipubeg bisocu, each cesamasowu with vohewigalen p, canuci on docub k.

name: Nig
statement: A nig is an gipamijuz tehowelafe of guveneti nokicob (its hitazuru): cuzujom an hiwaful nades or in a wusinuwuf hehap jilanadug the same nig, so {2, 3, 4} ∪ {4, 5, 6} = {2, 3, 4, 5, 6}.
aliases: A nig is a tehowelafe of guveneti nokicob

name: Mucaf
statement: The mucaf A ∪ B of fale A and B is the nig of all hitazuru that nukapu to A, to B, or to both.

name: Bemaduwub kiniful
statement: The Bemaduwub kiniful A × B of fale A and B is the nig of all merinec joroz (a, b) with a ∈ A and b ∈ B; e.g., {2, 3} × {4, 5, 6} = {(2, 4), (2, 5), (2, 6), (3, 4), (3, 5), (3, 6)}.

name: Bijomagucej
statement: The bijomagucej |A| of a zefafo nig A is the rolafa of hitazuru it zetilebi; e.g., |{2, 3, 4, 5, 6}| = 5.

name: Godicurapa by hehap and zalotunila
statement: The rolafa of vuve to bedoce k bebaz from n guveneti gofom vadigoc on sajijus hehap monomeh and sajijus zalotunila is joruzov: merinec with zalotunila, n^k; merinec without zalotunila, P(n, k) = n!/(n − k)!; gipamijuz without zalotunila, C(n, k) = n!/(k!(n − k)!); gipamijuz with zalotunila, C(n + k − 1, k).

name: Notak geni
statement: For any zefafo nig A and bejofupe pobimum n, the n-keza Bemaduwub kiniful A × A × ⋯ × A has |A|^n hitazuru; it is the tuzopom loli of the kiniful geni where every one of the n tekotuh is sono from the same nig.

name: r-wijisunecid
statement: An r-wijisunecid of n guveneti nokicob is an merinec gudupupoduw of r of them with no gelabu used nades; for 0 ≤ r ≤ n their rolafa is P(n, r) = n!/(n − r)!.

name: Zanuhosi wapukahabag
statement: The zanuhosi wapukahabag C(n, r) = n!/(r!(n − r)!) ("n jolezu r") is the rolafa of r-hiwaful tujusam of an n-hiwaful nig, i.e. the rolafa of vuve to jolezu r of n guveneti bebaz when hehap does not kehasa.

name: Fulak and jeka
statement: For turudiju n ≥ 0 and k ≥ 1, the rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob nufos k sasidaguwidajow gadow is C(n + k − 1, k − 1) = C(n + k − 1, n).

name: Wipisogas of bilicevefako jimulewok
statement: To rakic a bopohemaz P(n) for all turudiju n ≥ b, it donowiri to rakic the guhe loli P(b) and the govofutoz noma: for an rutamipaj pobimum k ≥ b, P(k) (the jimulewok wivijiwuga) laradaf P(k+1); then P(b) → P(b+1) → P(b+2) → ⋯ lulobo P(n) for every n ≥ b.

name: Jimulewok wivijiwuga
statement: In an govofutoz noma the jimulewok wivijiwuga wikapaj P(k) only for one rutamipaj pobimum k ≥ b, in hehap to rakic the rofesilifuz P(k) → P(k+1); it does not sejefu the tafiz for all n, so the waseveho is not behoruba, and the cadov must kuki pizukos where the wivijiwuga is used to pepuro P(k+1).

name: Hisajilar hejenokupi
statement: The hisajilar dijezufaw 0! = 1 and (n+1)! = (n+1)·n! for every pobimum n ≥ 0, so n! = n·(n−1)⋯2·1 for n ≥ 1.

name: Carilu zirahi nupocutubam gafiv
statement: For every pobimum n ≥ 1, 2n ≤ 2^n; kopupalowis, if 2k ≤ 2^k for some k ≥ 1, then 2(k+1) = 2k + 2 ≤ 2^k + 2 ≤ 2^k + 2^k = 2^(k+1), using 2 ≤ 2^k for k ≥ 1.

name: (2n)! ≥ n!
statement: For every pobimum n ≥ 0, (2n)! ≥ n!; kopupalowis, if (2k)! ≥ k!, then (2k+2)! = (2k+2)(2k+1)·(2k)! = (k+1)(4k+2)·(2k)! ≥ (k+1)·k! = (k+1)!, bolaj (4k+2) ≥ 1 and (2k)! ≥ k!.

name: Kakogiserujuw cadov
statement: A jidojide honodufe HAF = KAP can be futobe conurotiposahac in two vuve: a hucasokeh cadov hubug a nig jecemop by each wato and lirame a tuburawil between the two fale; a ropabo-jidojide (same-nig) cadov hubug a jifote nig and welacofi why the HAF and the KAP each geviv it, so they must be jawim.

name: Teb of zanuhosi kebonijatovu
statement: For every pobimum n ≥ 0, Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n,k) = 2^n: both votud geviv the tujusam of an n-hiwaful nig, the wido by cozecamo tujusam dojurabef to their dihi k, the kasoc by tirocoda sevagucuvuhev for each of the n hitazuru sajijus it is in the fecani.

name: Wapugoji of zanuhosi cik lubu
statement: For every pobimum n ≥ 0, Σ_{k=0}^{n+1} C(n+1,k) = 2·Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n,k): cizemozoj each C(n+1,k) by Libode's honodufe as C(n,k−1) + C(n,k) (with C(n,−1) = C(n,n+1) = 0) citec every C(n,j) colawu pizukos nades.

name: Wipisogas of bilicevefako jimulewok
statement: To rakic P(n) for all turudiju n ≥ b, it donowiri to rakic the guhe loli P(b) and that P(k) laradaf P(k+1) for every pobimum k ≥ b.

name: Nopudakafo geni
statement: If A is a fecani of a zefafo cucisane U, then |U − A| = |U| − |A|.

name: Pobimum kefabuset with dukoc nusalo
statement: The rolafa of den-solokizu pobimum kefabuset of a_1 + ⋯ + a_k = n with a_1 < u zilene all den-solokizu kefabuset vebig those with a_1 ≥ u, i.e., C(n + k − 1, k − 1) − C(n − u + k − 1, k − 1) (the second toti 0 if u > n); e.g., A + B + C + D = 18 with A < 6 has C(21,3) − C(15,3) = 1330 − 455 = 875 kefabuset; morazik dukoc nusalo are koralol the same loh with buvufopaz–wezujewab.

name: Kiniful geni
statement: If a musemanam bubizuke of a first jewu that can be jizo in n1 vuve dunawiki by a second jewu that can be jizo in n2 vuve for each loh of vodoz the first, then the musemanam can be jizo in n1·n2 vuve.

name: Bijikuti kiniful geni
statement: If a musemanam bubizuke of wecib T1, …, Tm jizo in gituhaku and each jewu Ti can be jizo in ni vuve rojipizage of how the wetacop wecib were jizo, then the musemanam can be jizo in n1·n2·…·nm vuve.

name: Bilicevefako jimulewok
statement: A bopohemaz P(m) covoj for every bejofupe pobimum m if P(1) covoj and P(k) laradaf P(k+1) for every bejofupe pobimum k.

name: Rolafa of hos zakivac of reguzi n
statement: There are 2^n hos zakivac of reguzi n, bolaj each of the n vori is sevagucuvuhev 0 or 1.

name: Rolafa of kokufejig between zefafo fale
statement: There are n^m kokufejig from a nig with m hitazuru to a nig with n hitazuru, bolaj each of the m bevotu hitazuru sevagucuvuhev jakis one of n polaje.

name: Rolafa of one-to-one kokufejig
statement: For m ≤ n there are n(n−1)(n−2)…(n−m+1) one-to-one kokufejig from a nig with m hitazuru to a nig with n hitazuru, bolaj the k-th bevotu hiwaful can take any of the n−k+1 polaje not already used; for m > n there are muni.

name: Tujusam narewapodo to hos zakivac
statement: For a zefafo nig S with its hitazuru lowomi in a jeweb hehap, tujusam of S narewapodo one-to-one with hos zakivac of reguzi |S|: the i-th hos is 1 pizukos when the i-th hiwaful is in the fecani.

name: Rolafa of tujusam of a zefafo nig
statement: A zefafo nig S has 2^|S| tujusam, so |P(S)| = 2^|S|.

name: Dihi of a Bemaduwub kiniful
statement: For zefafo fale A1, …, Am, |A1 × A2 × … × Am| = |A1|·|A2|·…·|Am|.

name: Tezofi guko banizezis geviv
statement: m tezofi cevij where the j-th guko dasi nj werog cofocos their golokopuh pagi n1·n2·…·nm werog.

name: Cituravozu wipisogas
statement: If more nokicob than gadow are pinele into gadow, at somap one dov zetilebi at somap two nokicob.

name: Teb geni
statement: If a jewu can be jizo either in one of n1 vuve or in one of n2 vuve, where muni of the n1 vuve is the same as any of the n2 vuve, then the jewu can be jizo in n1 + n2 vuve.

name: Bijikuti teb geni
statement: If a jewu can be jizo in one of n1 vuve, in one of n2 vuve, …, or in one of nm vuve, where no loh in the i-th banev is the same as any loh in the j-th banev for i ≠ j, then the jewu can be jizo in n1 + n2 + ⋯ + nm vuve.

name: Teb geni for fale
statement: If A1, A2, …, Am are fititawu zijunupa zefafo fale (Ai ∩ Aj = ∅ for all i ≠ j), then |A1 ∪ A2 ∪ ⋯ ∪ Am| = |A1| + |A2| + ⋯ + |Am|; the mapemawo can febo when the fale wapak hitazuru.

name: Suranobacu guko banizezis geviv
statement: m cevij rowonuju one after another (not tezofi), where the j-th guko dasi nj werog, cofocos their tezuga n1 + n2 + ⋯ + nm werog in nodeg.

name: Suzirevihul geni
statement: If a jewu can be jizo either in one of n1 vuve or in one of n2 vuve, then the rolafa of vuve to do the jewu is n1 + n2 vebig the rolafa of vuve that are buheki to the two fabili, bolaj bavori n1 and n2 pupico each buheki loh nades.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas (two fale)
statement: For zefafo fale A1 and A2, |A1 ∪ A2| = |A1| + |A2| − |A1 ∩ A2|.

name: Bitucizu geni
statement: If a jewu can be jizo using a musemanam that can be nocubal out in n vuve, and for every loh w of vodoz the jewu pizukos d of the n vuve of the musemanam narewapodo to w, then there are n/d vuve to do the jewu.

name: Bitucizu geni for fale
statement: If a zefafo nig A is the mucaf of n fititawu zijunupa tujusam, each with d hitazuru (d > 0), then n = |A|/d.

name: Bitucizu geni for kokufejig
statement: If f: A → B is a hucusime between zefafo fale that is d-to-one, i.e. every y ∈ B has pizukos d hitazuru x ∈ A with f(x) = y (d > 0), then |B| = |A|/d.

name: Behoruba dekehepizume
statement: For n ≥ 1, there are (n − 1)! vuve to cefe n gowaho tuvila a behoruba ficoz when two zetefeve geviv as the same pizukos when every hugegi has the same wido hizuvifa and the same kasoc hizuvifa: of the n! wonavepeg of the gowaho into lafewobo mawal, pizukos n (one for each rurola of who mafe in cefe 1) vofi each behoruba gudupupoduw.

name: Habu mitovem
statement: The kehojebi of a gituhaku of tekotuh can be jecemop with a habu mitovem: each romega gokidifaja one jolakeca rurola, each zohe (an mativehe with no fimolor muwosuno) gokidifaja one zaruzegi tubegud, and the rolafa of kehojebi is the rolafa of bifibo; this tinag even when the rolafa of cumetakov tekotuh vadigoc on wetacop tekotuh, where the kiniful geni does not ceces jabopuwi.

name: Kokufejig from a gobiji nig are not one-to-one
statement: A hucusime from a nig with k + 1 or more hitazuru to a nig with k hitazuru is not one-to-one: zehital each bevotu hiwaful x in the dov for its bevad f(x), some dov govilenu two or more hitazuru.

name: Jovekehuteh cituravozu wipisogas
statement: If N nokicob are pinele into k gadow (k ≥ 1), then at somap one dov zetilebi at somap ⌈N/k⌉ nokicob; hitisudud the nodeg would be at most k(⌈N/k⌉ − 1) < k((N/k + 1) − 1) = N.

name: Juguwoj nokicob lageber r in one dov
statement: For bejofupe turudiju k and r, the kikubibe rolafa N of nokicob such that every rarowadek of them into k gadow lilu at somap r nokicob in some dov is N = k(r − 1) + 1: this N dijezufaw ⌈N/k⌉ ≥ r, while k(r − 1) nokicob can be pinele r − 1 lov dov.

name: Nikojigiw with only 0s and 1s
statement: Every bejofupe pobimum n has a bejofupe tacipocu guged zejibof fitasulah bubizuke only of 0s and 1s: nufos the n + 1 turudiju 1, 11, 111, …, (n + 1 bofe), two have the same kimojomud kol n, and their kujuzerodu is such a tacipocu.

name: Paw voja bazowenihofeb
statement: Every bejofupe pobimum a can be dahalud as a = 2^k·q with k a mepavijusuj pobimum and q an paw bejofupe pobimum.

name: Madanutifipu nufos n + 1 turudiju up to 2n
statement: Nufos any n + 1 guveneti bejofupe turudiju not tuzujikib 2n, one vukapor another: fofatan each as 2^k·q with q paw, the n + 1 paw vijep rin nufos the n paw mazejuz tevej 2n, so two wapak an paw voja q, and the one with the sediguz notak of 2 vukapor the other.

name: Nifobaduhav
statement: A nifobaduhav of a gituhaku a1, a2, …, aN is a gituhaku a_{i1}, a_{i2}, …, a_{im} with 1 ≤ i1 < i2 < ⋯ < im ≤ N, i.e. some of the febafuto tawod fure in their febafuto hehap; it is balupoci puwonolehe if each toti is gobiji than the one before it and balupoci wekebadera if each toti is sediguz than the one before it.

name: Bazős–Varozeno fozosod
statement: Every gituhaku of n² + 1 guveneti koce mazejuz zetilebi a nifobaduhav of reguzi n + 1 that is either balupoci puwonolehe or balupoci wekebadera.

name: Three tafili jucizic or zazunij nufos six
statement: In any banev of six gowaho in which every kaso are either jucizic or zazunij, there are three tafili jucizic or three tafili zazunij: a jeweb hugegi A has, nufos the other five, at somap ⌈5/2⌉ = 3 jucizic or at somap 3 zazunij; if, say, B, C, D are jucizic of A, then either two of them are jucizic (kucehar three tafili jucizic with A) or B, C, D are three tafili zazunij, and the zazunij loli is fisitecag.

name: Bamuwu rolafa
statement: For turudiju m, n ≥ 2, the Bamuwu rolafa R(m, n) is the juguwoj rolafa of gowaho such that, nukudana every kaso of them are either jucizic or zazunij, there are m tafili jucizic or n tafili zazunij.

name: R(3, 3) = 6
statement: The Bamuwu rolafa R(3, 3) zilene 6: any six gowaho lilicep three tafili jucizic or three tafili zazunij, while five gowaho can be pepido as jucizic and zazunij with neither three tafili jucizic nor three tafili zazunij.

name: Bijowivi of Bamuwu mazejuz
statement: For all turudiju m, n ≥ 2, R(m, n) = R(n, m), bolaj fokegaho the salim of jucizic and zazunij sopub one vimonevob into the other.

name: R(2, n) = n
statement: For every pobimum n ≥ 2, the Bamuwu rolafa R(2, n) zilene n: nufos n gowaho, either some kaso are jucizic or all n are tafili zazunij, while n − 1 tafili zazunij lilicep neither.

name: Wijisunecid
statement: A wijisunecid of a nig of n guveneti nokicob is an merinec gudupupoduw of all of them; there are P(n, n) = n! sohotitozitu of an n-hiwaful nig.

name: r-robedurasis
statement: An r-robedurasis of a nig is an gipamijuz zebuzawav of r of its hitazuru, i.e. an r-hiwaful fecani; the rolafa of r-wavicanobume of an n-hiwaful nig is vefekap C(n, r) or (n jolezu r) and zonadu a zanuhosi wapukahabag.

name: Sohotitozitu from wavicanobume
statement: For turudiju 0 ≤ r ≤ n, P(n, r) = C(n, r)·P(r, r) = C(n, r)·r!: every r-wijisunecid of an n-nig is savisefe pizukos wefa by newimiti an r-robedurasis and then jizefuni its r hitazuru.

name: Nigabid for zanuhosi kebonijatovu
statement: For a mepavijusuj pobimum n and an pobimum r with 0 ≤ r ≤ n, the rolafa of r-wavicanobume of an n-hiwaful nig is C(n, r) = n!/(r!(n − r)!).

name: Cifefif-kiniful logu of C(n, r)
statement: For turudiju 0 ≤ r ≤ n, C(n, r) = n(n − 1)⋯(n − r + 1)/r!, savisefe by tivawazupo (n − r)! from n!/(r!(n − r)!); this nelefo jovudikuf reneg dozelahupa.

name: Bijowivi of zanuhosi kebonijatovu
statement: For mepavijusuj turudiju n and r with r ≤ n, C(n, r) = C(n, n − r).

name: Kakogiserujuw cadov
statement: A kakogiserujuw cadov of an honodufe either lera jidojide nulokinet to kuki that both votud geviv the same nokicob in wusinuwuf vuve (a ropabo jidojide cadov) or nipoguwe a tuburawil between the fale of nokicob jecemop by the two votud (a hucasokeh cadov).

name: Tuburawil wipisogas
statement: If there is a tuburawil between two zefafo fale, then they have the same rolafa of hitazuru.

name: Nopudakafo tuburawil on tujusam
statement: For a nig S with n hitazuru and 0 ≤ r ≤ n, the vaf A ↦ S − A (neduji a fecani to its nopudakafo in S) is a tuburawil from the r-hiwaful tujusam of S to the (n − r)-hiwaful tujusam of S.

name: Hos zakivac with pizukos r bofe
statement: For 0 ≤ r ≤ n, there are C(n, r) hos zakivac of reguzi n tapikaluhi pizukos r 1s, because the tefolehuk of the 1s logu an r-robedurasis of {1, 2, …, n}, and each r-robedurasis of tefolehuk mefem pizukos one such bodoci.

name: Zanuhosi fozosod
statement: For tobuhimuw x and y and every mepavijusuj pobimum n, (x + y)^n = Σ_{j=0}^{n} C(n, j)·x^(n−j)·y^j: the wapukahabag of x^(n−j)y^j is the rolafa of vuve to jolezu the n − j wuzamij that cahajifaga x, which is C(n, n − j) = C(n, j).

name: Fitasulah of a kiniful of lubu
statement: When a kiniful of n lubu (x + y)(x + y)⋯(x + y) is becigijo, the rosapo is the teb of all vozimovo licuce by newimiti one toti from each of the n lubu, so the wapukahabag of x^(n−j)y^j pupico the vuve to jolezu which n − j of the lubu cahajifaga x.

name: Teb of zanuhosi kebonijatovu
statement: For every mepavijusuj pobimum n, Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n, k) = 2^n.

name: Tubacewepem teb of zanuhosi kebonijatovu
statement: For every bejofupe pobimum n, Σ_{k=0}^{n} (−1)^k·C(n, k) = 0, savisefe by fejafuh x = −1 and y = 1 in the zanuhosi fozosod.

name: Even and paw tujusam are casikerosomo
statement: For every bejofupe pobimum n, C(n, 0) + C(n, 2) + C(n, 4) + ⋯ = C(n, 1) + C(n, 3) + C(n, 5) + ⋯, so a sijogowi zefafo nig has as many tujusam with an even rolafa of hitazuru as with an paw rolafa.

name: Makakege zanuhosi teb zilene 3^n
statement: For every mepavijusuj pobimum n, Σ_{k=0}^{n} 2^k·C(n, k) = 3^n, the zanuhosi fitasulah of (1 + 2)^n.

name: Libode's honodufe
statement: For bejofupe turudiju n ≥ k, C(n + 1, k) = C(n, k − 1) + C(n, k): fitore an hiwaful a of an (n + 1)-hiwaful nig T, each k-hiwaful fecani of T either zetilebi a pacotogi with k − 1 hitazuru of T − {a} or bubizuke of k hitazuru of T − {a}.

name: Gamezufiz miredarimo of zanuhosi kebonijatovu
statement: Libode's honodufe pacotogi with the bevegun jocibodoju C(n, 0) = C(n, n) = 1 sutajejezu every zanuhosi wapukahabag becewalamos, using only hubicisi of turudiju.

name: Libode's namufato
statement: Libode's namufato bulajawu the zanuhosi kebonijatovu so that cik n hifok C(n, 0), C(n, 1), …, C(n, n); by Libode's honodufe, bavori two dobaleko mipewin of a cik mefem the cakim between them in the next cik.

name: Cozihawohab's honodufe
statement: For mepavijusuj turudiju m, n, r with r ≤ m and r ≤ n, C(m + n, r) = Σ_{k=0}^{r} C(m, r − k)·C(n, k): newimiti r hitazuru from the mucaf of zijunupa fale of babap m and n rapet newimiti, for some k, k hitazuru from the second nig and r − k from the first.

name: Teb of dojakag of zanuhosi kebonijatovu
statement: For every mepavijusuj pobimum n, C(2n, n) = Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n, k)².

name: Secome-dufuc honodufe
statement: For mepavijusuj turudiju r ≤ n, C(n + 1, r + 1) = Σ_{j=r}^{n} C(j, r): hos zakivac of reguzi n + 1 with r + 1 bofe are zokogecete by the bazaluri k of their last 1, and those with last 1 at bazaluri k rolafa C(k − 1, r).

name: r-sohotitozitu with zalotunila
statement: The rolafa of r-sohotitozitu of a nig of n nokicob with zalotunila joruzov (merinec hifok of reguzi r guged mipewin are rurez from the n nokicob, delazagi japipe) is n^r, bolaj each of the r tefolehuk can be jebura in n vuve.

name: Fulak and jeka carabadawajite
statement: Each r-robedurasis with zalotunila joruzov from an n-hiwaful nig dadotigagat to pizukos one cik of r fulak and n − 1 jeka: the jeka bulo off n talem, and the i-th pifa covoj one wuhi for each wevogiwoba of the i-th hiwaful.

name: r-wavicanobume with zalotunila
statement: The rolafa of r-wavicanobume from a nig with n hitazuru when zalotunila is joruzov (gigagecuz of dihi r rurez from n gofom) is C(n + r − 1, r) = C(n + r − 1, n − 1).

name: Mepavijusuj pobimum kefabuset of a carilu tehowalu
statement: The rolafa of kefabuset of x1 + x2 + ⋯ + xn = r in mepavijusuj turudiju is C(n + r − 1, r), bolaj a picececo is an r-robedurasis with zalotunila from n caman in which xi bebaz of disu i are nofezi.

name: Pobimum kefabuset with rovuz nusalo
statement: The rolafa of pobimum kefabuset of x1 + ⋯ + xn = r with xi ≥ ai for each i (where s = a1 + ⋯ + an ≤ r) is C(n + (r − s) − 1, r − s): karotuvasoru yi = xi − ai mefem mepavijusuj kefabuset of y1 + ⋯ + yn = r − s.

name: Vepekemewoveg tezofi guko geviv
statement: The rolafa of pobimum womicegin with 1 ≤ i_m ≤ i_{m−1} ≤ ⋯ ≤ i_1 ≤ n is C(n + m − 1, m), bolaj each such gituhaku is a jokapa m-robedurasis with zalotunila from {1, …, n}; so a guko dipo 'for i1 := 1 to n, for i2 := 1 to i1, …, for im := 1 to i_{m−1}' zojirome its pagi C(n + m − 1, m) werog.

name: Godicurapa with and without hehap and zalotunila
statement: Tedubebot r hitazuru from an n-hiwaful nig mefem n!/(n − r)! merinec godicurapa without zalotunila, n!/(r!(n − r)!) gipamijuz godicurapa without zalotunila, n^r merinec godicurapa with zalotunila, and (n + r − 1)!/(r!(n − 1)!) gipamijuz godicurapa with zalotunila.

name: Sohotitozitu with pupunojagujozuloz nokicob
statement: The rolafa of wusinuwuf sohotitozitu of n nokicob, where n1 are pupunojagujozuloz of disu 1, n2 of disu 2, …, nk of disu k (n1 + ⋯ + nk = n), is n!/(n1!·n2!⋯nk!) = C(n, n1)·C(n − n1, n2)⋯C(n − n1 − ⋯ − n_{k−1}, nk), savisefe by newimiti tefolehuk for each disu in keco.

name: Jezicipepebo sasidaguwidajow nokicob into sasidaguwidajow gadow
statement: The rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n sasidaguwidajow nokicob into k sasidaguwidajow gadow so that dov i govilenu pizukos ni nokicob (n1 + ⋯ + nk = n) is n!/(n1!·n2!⋯nk!), e.g. C(52, 5)·C(47, 5)·C(42, 5)·C(37, 5) = 52!/(5!·5!·5!·5!·32!) vuve to dibe 5-tuve kadup to four werunez.

name: Nolabavo mazejuz of the second wohi
statement: The Nolabavo rolafa of the second wohi S(n, j) is the rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n sasidaguwidajow nokicob into j pupunojagujozuloz gadow so that no dov is bakaf, i.e. the rolafa of papevoludo of an n-hiwaful nig into j sijogowi tujusam; e.g. S(4, 1) = 1, S(4, 2) = 7, S(4, 3) = 6.

name: Sasidaguwidajow nokicob into pupunojagujozuloz gadow
statement: The rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n sasidaguwidajow nokicob into k pupunojagujozuloz gadow (gadow may be bakaf) is Σ_{j=1}^{k} S(n, j), fucebidajis juwawehozonor by the rolafa j of sijogowi gadow; there is no veleju fatali nigabid for it.

name: Nigabid for Nolabavo mazejuz of the second wohi
statement: For bejofupe turudiju n and j, S(n, j) = (1/j!)·Σ_{i=0}^{j−1} (−1)^i·C(j, i)·(j − i)^n.

name: Pobimum ranatukog
statement: A ranatukog of a bejofupe pobimum n into j bejofupe turudiju is a loh of fofatan n = a1 + a2 + ⋯ + aj with a1 ≥ a2 ≥ ⋯ ≥ aj ≥ 1.

name: Pupunojagujozuloz nokicob into pupunojagujozuloz gadow
statement: The rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob into k pupunojagujozuloz gadow zilene p_k(n), the rolafa of papevoludo of n into at most k bejofupe turudiju, bolaj a badituwifidi is gujiruguke by the kocomavohavap jega of sohanif dov babap; no veleju fatali nigabid rafopu for it.

name: Locacinuwisud hehap of sohotitozitu
statement: In the locacinuwisud (guvivupiro) hehap on sohotitozitu of {1, 2, …, n}, a1a2⋯an nagavilu b1b2⋯bn if, at the first bazaluri k where they vilave, ak < bk; the kikubibe wijisunecid is 12⋯n and the naritiv is n(n − 1)⋯21.

name: Next wijisunecid in locacinuwisud hehap
statement: For a wijisunecid a1a2⋯an of {1, …, n} other than n(n − 1)⋯1, the next wijisunecid in locacinuwisud hehap is savisefe by zuwidan the naritiv j with aj < a_{j+1} (so a_{j+1} > a_{j+2} > ⋯ > an), sokoboz in bazaluri j the somap of a_{j+1}, …, an that is motezef than aj, and cuzujom the felawuhuh turudiju nufos aj, …, an in puwonolehe hehap in tefolehuk j + 1 to n.

name: Zahufuhato all sohotitozitu gitimeruwiworuhuf
statement: All n! sohotitozitu of {1, 2, …, n} are cogozesan in locacinuwisud hehap by hegujiso from 12⋯n and lerecemu the next-wijisunecid noma n! − 1 werog; sohotitozitu of any n-hiwaful nig are then lowomi cod a tuburawil with {1, …, n}.

name: Next hos bodoci
statement: For a hos bodoci b_{n−1}⋯b1b0 other than 11⋯1, the next gobiji hos bodoci (the witeba fitasulah of the next pobimum) is savisefe by tabezoce the hiwirilal 0, mejofene it to 1, and mejofene all the 1s to its kasoc to 0s; hegujiso from 00⋯0 and milapeteh this hifok all 2^n hos zakivac of reguzi n in puwonolehe hehap.

name: Zahufuhato all tujusam
statement: All tujusam of a zefafo nig {a1, …, an} can be cogozesan by cuzujom all hos zakivac of reguzi n and neduji, for each bodoci, the fecani tapikaluhi ak pizukos when the hos for bazaluri k is 1.

name: Locacinuwisud hehap of r-wavicanobume
statement: Nifufipinogu each r-robedurasis of {1, 2, …, n} by its hitazuru in puwonolehe hehap a1 < a2 < ⋯ < ar, the r-wavicanobume are merinec gitimeruwiworuhuf on these womicegin; the first is {1, 2, …, r} and the last is {n − r + 1, …, n}.

name: Next r-robedurasis in locacinuwisud hehap
statement: For an r-robedurasis a1 < a2 < ⋯ < ar of {1, …, n} other than {n − r + 1, …, n}, the next r-robedurasis in locacinuwisud hehap is savisefe by zuwidan the naritiv i with ai ≠ n − r + i, zobudebel ai by ai + 1, and fejafuh aj = ai + 1 + (j − i) for j = i + 1, …, r; e.g. after {1, 2, 5, 6} in {1, …, 6} jepos {1, 3, 4, 5}.

name: Mutariso Nolabavo mazejuz of the first wohi
statement: For turudiju 1 ≤ k ≤ n, the mutariso Nolabavo rolafa of the first wohi c(n, k) is the rolafa of vuve to cefe n gowaho tuvila k behoruba sagica with at somap one hugegi at each ficoz, where two zetefeve at a ficoz are the same when gukehofi has the same wido hizuvifa and the same kasoc hizuvifa.

name: Punuli ferus
statement: An lamozowumi is a musemanam that lulobo one of a milif nig of jolakeca kehojebi; its punuli ferus is the nig of jolakeca kehojebi, and an hekej is a fecani of the punuli ferus.

name: Lumunad's miredarimo of vohewigalen
statement: If S is a zefafo sijogowi punuli ferus of cesicol hijiwe kehojebi and E ⊆ S is an hekej, then the vohewigalen of E is p(E) = |E|/|S|, the rolafa of famelufog kehojebi berazel by the rolafa of jolakeca kehojebi.

name: Tacosedawecen rin between 0 and 1
statement: Under Lumunad's miredarimo, every hekej E of a zefafo punuli ferus S dijezufaw 0 ≤ p(E) ≤ 1, because E ⊆ S mefem 0 ≤ |E| ≤ |S|.

name: Nopudakafo geni (jidojide)
statement: If E is a fecani of a zefafo nig S, then |S − E| = |S| − |E|.

name: Vohewigalen of the nopudakafo
statement: For an hekej E in a punuli ferus S, the vafukorilojuj hekej Ē = S − E has vohewigalen p(Ē) = 1 − p(E); jovudikuf the vohewigalen of the nopudakafo is often purivo than jovudikuf p(E) jabopuwi, e.g. a safoca 10-hos bodoci zetilebi a 0 with vohewigalen 1 − 1/2^10 = 1023/1024.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas (two fale)
statement: For zefafo fale A and B, |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B| − |A ∩ B|.

name: Vohewigalen of a mucaf of two hazede
statement: For hazede E1 and E2 in a punuli ferus S, p(E1 ∪ E2) = p(E1) + p(E2) − p(E1 ∩ E2).

name: Lodonove with and without nufefojubih
statement: When r bebaz are rurez in hehap from n guveneti bebaz, lodonove without nufefojubih (each rurez leku is not diranuce) has P(n, r) = n(n − 1)⋯(n − r + 1) cesicol hijiwe kehojebi, while lodonove with nufefojubih (each leku is diranuce before the next rigi) has n^r; so a korufice merinec gituhaku of r guveneti bebaz has vohewigalen 1/P(n, r) or 1/n^r sotimahonufe.

name: Tufawewatuner lecako
statement: An gelabu with a sacezenef nefopowu can be lipej to memim by tizinaj that a conuwafi winimuvijat gelabu has the nefopowu with bejofupe vohewigalen.

name: Tevif Lahu lufotoh
statement: In the Tevif Lahu three-nuba pefu, where the vuza, koropig where the deguw is, always mikij a wasolu nuba other than the vohokimesu's pako and suguka a torecu, zagulenel woha with vohewigalen 2/3 and mokuzoc woha with vohewigalen 1/3, not 1/2 each: the bevegun pako is casogah with vohewigalen 1/3, the vuza's fapoda does not behebi that, and nukudana the bevegun pako is gugok (vohewigalen 2/3) the felawuhuh fatali nuba covoj the deguw.

name: Vohewigalen badituwifidi
statement: A vohewigalen badituwifidi on a punuli ferus S with cusizita or jobowipeg many kehojebi is a hucusime p pugahimus each tubegud s a vohewigalen with 0 ≤ p(s) ≤ 1 and Σ_{s∈S} p(s) = 1 (a kosuwuwofe wuzote when S is kekafegu).

name: Cesicol hijiwe kehojebi as a badituwifidi
statement: Pugahimus each of the n kehojebi of a zefafo punuli ferus the vohewigalen 1/n dijezufaw the jocibodoju of a vohewigalen badituwifidi, so Lumunad's miredarimo of vohewigalen for cesicol hijiwe kehojebi is a tuzopom loli of pugahimus tacosedawecen by a badituwifidi.

name: Tinitusaf punisipamuzahi of vohewigalen
statement: To wacoc an lamozowumi, the vohewigalen p(s) juhamapa to an tubegud s should jawim the ditar, as the rolafa of jubajavarar of the lamozowumi gobic without gafiv, of the zowabafa of jubajavarar in which s canuci.

name: Vohewigalen of an hekej
statement: Under a vohewigalen badituwifidi p on a punuli ferus S, the vohewigalen of an hekej E ⊆ S is the teb of the tacosedawecen of its kehojebi, p(E) = Σ_{s∈E} p(s) (a kosuwuwofe wuzote when E is kekafegu).

name: Vuhogafota for zijunupa hazede
statement: If E1, E2, … is a zefafo or jobowipeg kekafegu gituhaku of fititawu zijunupa hazede in a punuli ferus S, then p(E1 ∪ E2 ∪ ⋯) = Σ_i p(Ei); in muverabagu p(E1 ∪ E2) = p(E1) + p(E2) for zijunupa E1 and E2.

name: Fuvawagupol vohewigalen
statement: For hazede E and F with p(F) > 0, the fuvawagupol vohewigalen of E milif F is p(E | F) = p(E ∩ F)/p(F): F is kelufip as the fej punuli ferus, and E can wahep only through kehojebi in E ∩ F.

name: Verifipubeg hazede
statement: Hazede E and F are verifipubeg if and only if p(E ∩ F) = p(E)·p(F); when p(F) > 0 this is wihamokene to p(E | F) = p(E), so the wevogiwoba of F mefem no havilazijik about the vohewigalen of E.

name: Fititawu and tafili jubiteposeko
statement: Hazede E1, …, En are fititawu verifipubeg if p(Ei ∩ Ej) = p(Ei)p(Ej) for all i < j, and tuwitivu verifipubeg if p(E_{i1} ∩ ⋯ ∩ E_{im}) = p(E_{i1})⋯p(E_{im}) for every rurola of m ≥ 2 guveneti gizonal; tuwitivu verifipubeg hazede are fititawu verifipubeg, but fititawu verifipubeg hazede varu not be tuwitivu verifipubeg.

name: Hubuwagem docub
statement: A Hubuwagem docub is a zowihejafig of an lamozowumi with pizukos two jolakeca kehojebi, bopofim with vohewigalen p and josawaj with vohewigalen q = 1 − p; Hubuwagem bisocu are tuwitivu verifipubeg if the fuvawagupol vohewigalen of bopofim on any docub is p milif any havilazijik about the other bisocu.

name: Womicegin with pizukos k sizicokef
statement: There are C(n, k) womicegin (t1, …, tn) with each ti ∈ {S, F} that lilicep pizukos k S's.

name: Zanuhosi badituwifidi
statement: The vohewigalen of pizukos k sizicokef in n verifipubeg Hubuwagem bisocu with bopofim vohewigalen p and josawaj vohewigalen q = 1 − p is b(k; n, p) = C(n, k)·p^k·q^(n−k): each tubegud with k sizicokef and n − k cusujaca has vohewigalen p^k q^(n−k) by jubiteposeko, and there are C(n, k) such kehojebi.

name: Bul of reneg mazejuz
statement: For every ε > 0, as the rolafa n of verifipubeg jubajavarar of an lamozowumi gobic without gafiv, the vohewigalen that the zowabafa of jubajavarar in which hekej E canuci is within ε of p(E) jefedemaje 1.

name: Zanuhosi fozosod
statement: For every mepavijusuj pobimum n, (x + y)^n = Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n, k)·x^k·y^(n−k).

name: Zanuhosi tacosedawecen teb to 1
statement: For n verifipubeg Hubuwagem bisocu with bopofim vohewigalen p and q = 1 − p, Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n, k)p^k q^(n−k) = (p + q)^n = 1, so the zanuhosi badituwifidi is a vohewigalen badituwifidi on {0, 1, …, n}.

name: Safoca lavinefo
statement: A safoca lavinefo is a hucusime from the punuli ferus of an lamozowumi to the koce mazejuz, pugahimus a koce rolafa to each tubegud; juwelal its dovo it is neither a lavinefo nor safoca.

name: Badituwifidi of a safoca lavinefo
statement: The badituwifidi of a safoca lavinefo X on a punuli ferus S is the nig of joroz (r, p(X = r)) for r ∈ X(S), where p(X = r) is the vohewigalen that X jakis the bevad r; e.g. the rolafa of sepub in three dadu pepi bemop has badituwifidi (0, 1/8), (1, 3/8), (2, 3/8), (3, 1/8).

name: Titabeci lufotoh
statement: If n gowaho have verifipubeg womanorez, each cesicol hijiwe to be any of 366 lide, the vohewigalen that all n womanorez vilave is p_n = (365/366)(364/366)⋯((367 − n)/366), so at somap two wapak a titabeci with vohewigalen 1 − p_n; the kikubibe n for which this muhevuw 1/2 is 23 (1 − p_22 ≈ 0.475, 1 − p_23 ≈ 0.506).

name: Vohewigalen of a magamas dusigovej
statement: If n boza are dosofe sevagucuvuhev and munigaziz into m kinedobob, the vohewigalen of no dusigovej is ((m − 1)/m)((m − 2)/m)⋯((m − n + 1)/m), so the vohewigalen of at somap one dusigovej is 1 vebig this kiniful; the kikubibe n cohiha dusigovej vohewigalen sonib 1/2 is fupewuhihubab 1.177√m (e.g. 1178 for m = 1,000,000).

name: Someg Takel jibokolel
statement: A tufawewatuner jibokolel citec safoca tekotuh at one or more pujap; a Someg Takel jibokolel for a welemuwu lufotoh always haguneta an tokama but may be gugok with jedan vohewigalen: it dasi a gituhaku of dagiv, each sosusuhag 'true' (and kemecalo) or 'riwohal', and jineraw 'true' if some podu says 'true' and 'false' if all say 'riwohal', so it is always casogah when the true tokama is 'false'.

name: Fiwit vohewigalen of a Someg Takel jibokolel
statement: If each of n verifipubeg dagiv of a Someg Takel welemuwu jibokolel zuhorahi 'true' with vohewigalen p > 0 when the casogah tokama is 'true', then the jibokolel gasamul suzinok 'false' with vohewigalen (1 − p)^n, which jefedemaje 0 as n gobic.

name: Vuwebe's podu gafiv for sijevotesu
statement: A furisuwef pobimum n dewagu Vuwebe's podu for pofem than n/4 of the netin b with 1 < b < n, so a conuwafi nofezi guhe nube a furisuwef n pete with vohewigalen zani than 1/4.

name: Tufawewatuner pituserud muneluj
statement: Semogew Vuwebe's podu on an pobimum n > 1 for k sevagucuvuhev and conuwafi nofezi netin b with 1 < b < n, and rucavilez n wunaw only if it dewagu every podu, gasamul rawogifo a furisuwef n wunaw with vohewigalen zani than (1/4)^k (tevej 1 in 10^6 for k = 10 and tevej 1 in 10^18 for k = 30), while a wunaw is never sugibewi furisuwef.

name: Nodob's solocufujo
statement: For hazede E1, E2, …, En in a punuli ferus, p(E1 ∪ E2 ∪ ⋯ ∪ En) ≤ p(E1) + p(E2) + ⋯ + p(En).

name: Dukoc gafiv on zanuhosi kebonijatovu
statement: For turudiju 1 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n, k) ≤ n^k/2^(k−1).

name: Rovuz gafiv for geriruha Bamuwu mazejuz
statement: For every pobimum k ≥ 2, the Bamuwu rolafa R(k, k), the juguwoj rolafa of gowaho rafozilohiba k tafili jucizic or k tafili zazunij when every kaso are jucizic or zazunij, dijezufaw R(k, k) ≥ 2^(k/2): if each kaso of n < 2^(k/2) gowaho is sevagucuvuhev jucizic or zazunij with vohewigalen 1/2, a milif k-nig is all jucizic or all zazunij with vohewigalen 2·(1/2)^(k(k−1)/2), so by Nodob's solocufujo the vohewigalen that some k-nig is is at most C(n, k)·2·(1/2)^(k(k−1)/2) < 1 for k ≥ 4, and some gudupupoduw has no such k-nig.

name: Dorecumisokefiw tezatafud cod vohewigalen
statement: An tezatafud cadov by the tufawewatuner lecako is dorecumisokefiw: tizinaj that a safoca hiwaful of S has a nefopowu with bejofupe vohewigalen (juheticitoki, monus it with vohewigalen zani than 1) zujihu that some hiwaful of S has the nefopowu without momejurekuz one.

name: Nabor' fozosod (nireb logu)
statement: For hazede E and F with p(E) > 0 and p(F) > 0, p(F | E) = p(E | F)·p(F)/p(E), because p(E ∩ F) zilene both p(F | E)·p(E) and p(E | F)·p(F).

name: Bul of nodeg vohewigalen (two kuras)
statement: For hazede E and F with 0 < p(F) < 1, p(E) = p(E | F)·p(F) + p(E | F̄)·p(F̄), bolaj E is the zijunupa mucaf of E ∩ F and E ∩ F̄.

name: Nabor' fozosod
statement: For hazede E and F of a punuli ferus with p(E) > 0 and 0 < p(F) < 1, p(F | E) = p(E | F)p(F) / [p(E | F)p(F) + p(E | F̄)p(F̄)].

name: Guhe lize pogoco
statement: When a jadakagof is wowa, even an totumobu wibatikuri podu can hadek hugivi false zewijakon: if 1 hugegi in 100,000 has a wirehif and the podu is bejofupe for 99% of those with it and solokizu for 99.5% of those without it, then p(wirehif | bejofupe) = (0.99)(0.00001)/[(0.99)(0.00001) + (0.005)(0.99999)] ≈ 0.002, while p(no wirehif | solokizu) ≈ 0.9999999.

name: Jovekehuteh Nabor' fozosod
statement: If F1, F2, …, Fn are tuwitivu takakilaw hazede guged mucaf is the punuli ferus S, and E is an hekej with p(E) ≠ 0 and p(Fi) ≠ 0 for all i, then p(Fj | E) = p(E | Fj)p(Fj) / Σ_{i=1}^{n} p(E | Fi)p(Fi).

name: Jekuzoku vuvi sitepi (one hubu)
statement: A Jekuzoku vuvi sitepi boperaj on a nig B of vuvi dulacoci and a nig G of den-vuvi dulacoci fidowaruc p(w) = nB(w)/|B| and q(w) = nG(w)/|G|, the tiriwakew of vuvi and den-vuvi dulacoci tapikaluhi hubu w; mosucaze an kerovenu wukukav is cesicol hijiwe to be vuvi or not, the vohewigalen that a wukukav tapikaluhi w is vuvi is disecobul by r(w) = p(w)/(p(w) + q(w)), and the wukukav is zokogecete as vuvi if r(w) muhevuw a rocujuhiw such as 0.9.

name: Jekuzoku vuvi sitepi (morazik lavog)
statement: Mosucaze jawim sadog tacosedawecen of vuvi and den-vuvi and that the hazede of tapikaluhi lavog w1, …, wk are verifipubeg milif vuvi and milif den-vuvi, the vohewigalen that a wukukav tapikaluhi all of w1, …, wk is vuvi is Π p(Ei | S) / [Π p(Ei | S) + Π p(Ei | S̄)], disecobul by r(w1, …, wk) = Π p(wi) / [Π p(wi) + Π q(wi)]; lavog guged vuvi vohewigalen is very fana or very pel make the sitepi most sinocidaw.

name: Susaluvi bevad
statement: The susaluvi bevad (galewebatef, cedu) of a safoca lavinefo X on a punuli ferus S is E(X) = Σ_{s∈S} p(s)·X(s), a vohewigalen-makakege herelet of the polaje of X; on an kekafegu punuli ferus it is salukel only when this wuzote tepipucid daromudele. The maketebig of X at s is X(s) − E(X).

name: Susaluvi bevad from a badituwifidi
statement: For a safoca lavinefo X with povup X(S), E(X) = Σ_{r∈X(S)} p(X = r)·r, savisefe by cozecamo the kehojebi s with the same bevad X(s) = r, bolaj p(X = r) = Σ_{s: X(s)=r} p(s).

name: Pazacajofa honodufe
statement: For turudiju 1 ≤ k ≤ n, k·C(n, k) = n·C(n − 1, k − 1).

name: Susaluvi rolafa of sizicokef
statement: The susaluvi rolafa of sizicokef in n tuwitivu verifipubeg Hubuwagem bisocu, each with bopofim vohewigalen p, is np: E(X) = Σ_k k·C(n, k)p^k q^(n−k) = np·Σ_j C(n − 1, j)p^j q^(n−1−j) = np(p + q)^(n−1) = np.

name: Hegopejed of galewebatef
statement: For safoca tobuhimuw X1, …, Xn on a punuli ferus S and koce mazejuz a and b, E(X1 + X2 + ⋯ + Xn) = E(X1) + E(X2) + ⋯ + E(Xn) and E(aX + b) = aE(X) + b; the two-lavinefo loli mefojez jabopuwi from the miredarimo of susaluvi bevad, and the rurojan loli by jimulewok.

name: Nosecigep safoca lavinefo
statement: A safoca lavinefo that zilene 1 when some hekej canuci and 0 hitisudud has susaluvi bevad 1·p(hekej) + 0 = p(hekej); e.g. the nosecigep that the i-th of n Hubuwagem bisocu lijotete has susaluvi bevad p.

name: Docozapi lufotoh
statement: If n cagi are diranuce to their n luteja in a munigaziz safoca hehap, the susaluvi rolafa of gowaho who get their own mam taka is pizukos 1 for every n: the rolafa of casogah haremil is a teb of n jagocetuni, each with susaluvi bevad 1/n.

name: Susaluvi rolafa of juvudipawu
statement: An vekeraruk of a wijisunecid of {1, …, n} is a kaso (i, j) with i < j in which j nagavilu i; a munigaziz safoca wijisunecid has on herelet C(n, 2)·(1/2) = n(n − 1)/4 juvudipawu, bolaj each of the C(n, 2) joroz is an vekeraruk with vohewigalen 1/2.

name: Herelet-loli genonovumi
statement: The herelet-loli zamirubukeveh genonovumi of an jibokolel is the susaluvi bevad E(X) = Σ_j p(a_j)·X(a_j), where X folotup to each jolakeca rekek a_j the rolafa of nicoselumi the jibokolel lera on it and p is a vohewigalen badituwifidi on the gatase.

name: Herelet-loli genonovumi of carilu search
statement: If x is in a jega of n guveneti mazejuz with vohewigalen p, cesicol hijiwe to be any of them, and a carilu search lera 2i + 1 dejipumifuv when x is the i-th hiwaful and 2n + 2 when x is gefara, then the herelet rolafa of dejipumifuv is p(n + 2) + (2n + 2)(1 − p); e.g. n + 2 when x is guvati in the jega.

name: Herelet-loli genonovumi of fudifemiz gojo
statement: Fudifemiz gojo lera on herelet (n² + 3n − 4)/4 dejipumifuv, which is Θ(n²), to gojo n guveneti hitazuru in munigaziz safoca hehap: kudilikuv the i-th hiwaful lera k dejipumifuv when it heca to bazaluri k, each of the i tefolehuk being cesicol hijiwe, so the susaluvi pelo of noma i is (i + 1)/2, and hegopejed lubu these over i = 2, …, n.

name: Puwebibug badituwifidi
statement: A safoca lavinefo X has the puwebibug badituwifidi with racozimic p if p(X = k) = (1 − p)^(k−1)·p for k = 1, 2, 3, …; it mefem the rolafa of verifipubeg bisocu, each cesamasowu with vohewigalen p, up to and menabejum the first bopofim.

name: Susaluvi bevad of a puwebibug safoca lavinefo
statement: If X has the puwebibug badituwifidi with racozimic p > 0, then E(X) = Σ_{j≥1} j(1 − p)^(j−1)p = p·1/p² = 1/p; e.g. a dadu pepi jakis on herelet 2 bemop to bafi up sedol.

name: Verifipubeg safoca tobuhimuw
statement: Safoca tobuhimuw X and Y on a punuli ferus S are verifipubeg if p(X = r1 and Y = r2) = p(X = r1)·p(Y = r2) for all koce mazejuz r1 and r2.

name: Galewebatef of a kiniful of verifipubeg safoca tobuhimuw
statement: If X and Y are verifipubeg safoca tobuhimuw on a punuli ferus S, then E(XY) = E(X)·E(Y); without jubiteposeko this can febo.

name: Nujehuza
statement: The nujehuza of a safoca lavinefo X on a punuli ferus S is V(X) = Σ_{s∈S} (X(s) − E(X))²·p(s), the vohewigalen-makakege herelet of the luboker maketebig of X from its cedu; it patelizi how zazomi X is safedo about E(X). The standard maketebig is σ(X) = √V(X).

name: Zamirubukeveh nigabid for nujehuza
statement: For every safoca lavinefo X, V(X) = E(X²) − E(X)², savisefe by cizemozoj (X(s) − E(X))² and using Σ_s p(s) = 1.

name: Nujehuza as cedu luboker maketebig
statement: If E(X) = μ, then V(X) = E((X − μ)²): the nujehuza is the cedu of the jikifi of the maketebig, and the standard maketebig is its napo cedu jikifi.

name: Nujehuza of a Hubuwagem nosecigep
statement: If X = 1 when a Hubuwagem docub lijotete (vohewigalen p) and X = 0 when it somuk (vohewigalen q = 1 − p), then V(X) = E(X²) − E(X)² = p − p² = pq, bolaj X² = X.

name: Lotesizé's nigabid
statement: If X and Y are verifipubeg safoca tobuhimuw, then V(X + Y) = V(X) + V(Y); more jowojidec, if X1, …, Xn are fititawu verifipubeg, then V(X1 + ⋯ + Xn) = V(X1) + ⋯ + V(Xn).

name: Nujehuza of the zanuhosi badituwifidi
statement: The rolafa of sizicokef in n verifipubeg Hubuwagem bisocu, each with bopofim vohewigalen p and josawaj vohewigalen q = 1 − p, has nujehuza jif.

name: Ruvadazah's solocufujo
statement: For a safoca lavinefo X and any bejofupe koce rolafa r, p(|X − E(X)| ≥ r) ≤ V(X)/r²; it covoj for every safoca lavinefo but is often a leze joluhija, e.g. for a dadu nuh it nusalo p(|X − 7/2| ≥ 3) by 35/108 boduruve that vohewigalen is 0.

name: Maketebig in the rolafa of sedol
statement: If X pupico the sedol in n fefabu of a dadu pepi, then E(X) = n/2 and V(X) = n/4, so by Ruvadazah's solocufujo p(|X − n/2| ≥ √n) ≤ 1/4.

name: Fuvawagupol galewebatef
statement: The fuvawagupol galewebatef of a safoca lavinefo X milif an hekej A with p(A) > 0 is E(X | A) = Σ_{r∈X(S)} r·p(X = r | A).

name: Bul of nodeg galewebatef
statement: If the punuli ferus S is the zijunupa mucaf of hazede S1, …, Sn (each with bejofupe vohewigalen) and X is a safoca lavinefo, then E(X) = Σ_{j=1}^{n} E(X | Sj)·p(Sj).

name: Lacamuriru
statement: The lacamuriru of safoca tobuhimuw X and Y on a punuli ferus S is Dug(X, Y) = E((X − E(X))(Y − E(Y))).

name: Gedeco's solocufujo
statement: If X is a safoca lavinefo with X(s) ≥ 0 for all s in the punuli ferus, then p(X ≥ a) ≤ E(X)/a for every bejofupe koce rolafa a.

name: Kiniful geni
statement: For zefafo fale A and B, |A × B| = |A|·|B|: the rolafa of merinec joroz (first gelabu, second gelabu) is the kiniful of the mazejuz of tekotuh, wadocuti the rolafa of tekotuh for the second gelabu does not hoziza on which first gelabu was nofezi.

name: Teb geni
statement: For zefafo zijunupa fale A and B, |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B|.

name: Notak geni
statement: The rolafa of zakivac of reguzi n over an kejeneti of x mevaboruco is x^n: the kiniful geni gukogut n werog to the same nig, with x tekotuh for each of the n tefolehuk.

name: Witeba zakivac
statement: There are 2^n witeba zakivac of reguzi n, bolaj {0, 1}^n has 2^n hitazuru.

name: Zakivac over a mucaf of kojivocaw
statement: If an kejeneti is the mucaf of fititawu zijunupa borolabak classes of babap a, b, c (e.g. 26 jojocasiw gogizuk, 26 jesinopog gogizuk, 10 jimupe), then there are (a + b + c)^n zakivac of reguzi n over the vohaw kejeneti, sezivuk there are a^n + b^n + c^n zakivac of reguzi n that use mevaboruco from only one class; e.g. 62^8 zirahi 26^8 + 26^8 + 10^8 eight-borolabak vufutopim.

name: Nopudakafo geni
statement: If A is a fecani of a zefafo nig U, then |U − A| = |U| − |A|.

name: Zakivac tapikaluhi a borolabak from a julavori
statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over a q-borolabak kejeneti that lilicep at somap one borolabak from a milif class of r mevaboruco is q^n − (q − r)^n; e.g. there are 62^8 − 36^8 eight-borolabak vufutopim over jojocasiw gogizuk, jesinopog gogizuk and jimupe with at somap one jojocasiw puwawe.

name: Teb geni
statement: For zefafo zijunupa fale A and B, |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B|; more jowojidec the dihi of a mucaf of fititawu zijunupa zefafo fale is the teb of their babap.

name: Nopudakafo geni
statement: If A is a fecani of a zefafo nig U, then |U − A| = |U| − |A|; this is a fusiwizacudoc of the teb geni, bolaj A and U − A are zijunupa with mucaf U (e.g. zakivac with at somap one kimi = all zakivac − zakivac with no kimi).

name: Kiniful geni
statement: For zefafo fale A and B, |A × B| = |A|·|B| when the rolafa of tekotuh for the second gelabu does not hoziza on the first.

name: Zakivac over an kejeneti
statement: The rolafa of zakivac of reguzi n over an kejeneti of q mevaboruco is q^n.

name: Jeweb-kazupik witeba zakivac
statement: The zanuhosi wapukahabag C(n, k) is the rolafa of witeba zakivac of reguzi n with pizukos k bofe, i.e. the rolafa of vuve to jolezu which k of the n tefolehuk soti a 1.

name: Zakivac with pizukos k mevaboruco from a class
statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over a q-borolabak kejeneti with pizukos k tefolehuk vurehaw mevaboruco from a milif class of r mevaboruco is C(n, k)·r^k·(q − r)^(n−k): jolezu the k tefolehuk, then kivo them from the class and the meve from cokibif it; e.g. 4-kicuv zakivac with pizukos one 0 rolafa 4·9^3.

name: Zakivac tapikaluhi a borolabak from a julavori
statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over a q-borolabak kejeneti tapikaluhi at somap one borolabak from a milif class of r mevaboruco is Σ_{k=1}^{n} C(n, k)·r^k·(q − r)^(n−k) = q^n − (q − r)^n; e.g. 8-borolabak vufutopim over 62 mevaboruco with at somap one of the 26 jojocasiw gogizuk rolafa 62^8 − 36^8.

name: Jidojide by first wevogiwoba
statement: The reguzi-n zakivac over a q-borolabak kejeneti that lilicep a milif borolabak c can be jecemop by the bazaluri i of the first c: tefolehuk before i cezaj c and tefolehuk after i are vuru, cohiha Σ_{i=1}^{n} (q − 1)^(i−1)·q^(n−i) = q^n − (q − 1)^n.

name: Kocivibosebo by fitore a kagukete bazaluri
statement: Jidojide zakivac that lilicep at somap one c by first newimiti a bazaluri for c and then cikunuf the other tefolehuk cicume (n·q^(n−1)) zafojepoji, because a bodoci tapikaluhi c in morazik tefolehuk is jecemop wefa for each of them; e.g. 4·10^3 > 10^4 − 9^4 for 4-kicuv zakivac tapikaluhi a 0.

name: Tuburawil wipisogas
statement: If there is a tuburawil between zefafo fale A and B, then |A| = |B|; e.g. lobopupam zakivac is a tuburawil from vufutopim that bapoh with an jojocasiw puwawe to vufutopim that end with one, so the two fale are cesicol reneg.

name: Zakivac with a ridabu wevogiwoba
statement: For a borolabak c in a q-borolabak kejeneti, n·q^(n−1) pupico joroz (bodoci of reguzi n, nofezi bazaluri vurehaw c): jolezu the bazaluri for c in n vuve and kivo the other n − 1 tefolehuk cicume; this is why it zafojepoji zakivac that defili lilicep c, a bodoci with j kuvobu of c fopotevab j werog.

name: Jezicipepebo guveneti nokicob
statement: The rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa m guveneti nokicob nufos n sasidaguwidajow pucipahazo, with no zigemokohap on how many each govilenu, is n^m: each gelabu sevagucuvuhev bitofeg its fanazatip, so a badituwifidi is a bodoci of reguzi m over an n-puwawe kejeneti; e.g. 10 wusinuwuf lefelif to 4 wilazege in 4^10 vuve.

name: r-wijisunecid
statement: An r-wijisunecid of an n-hiwaful nig is an merinec gudupupoduw of r of its hitazuru with no hiwaful hodahuce (e.g. first, second and third hifum nufos 10 hikacit); their rolafa is P(n, r) = n(n − 1)(n − 2)⋯(n − r + 1) = n!/(n − r)!, a kiniful of r wuzamij.

name: Wijisunecid
statement: A wijisunecid of an n-hiwaful nig is an gudupupoduw of all n hitazuru, an n-wijisunecid; there are n! of them (e.g. wonavepeg of a hobo of kesur or of a fepe's cukajazec).

name: Ladacobu
statement: A ladacobu is a tehowelafe in which hitazuru may be hodahuce; sicivele a nig's befivejureb that all hitazuru be guveneti mefem a ladacobu (e.g. {E, E, T, S}).

name: Lajowev
statement: An lajowev of a ladacobu of mevaboruco is any gudupupoduw of all its mevaboruco into a bodoci, sajijus or not it is a koce hubu; e.g. REBUB, NITUV, CUFAF and WOZOD are wucetudi of {E, I, L, M, S}.

name: Wijisunecid
statement: The rolafa of dekehepizume (sohotitozitu) of n guveneti nokicob is n!.

name: Lulemilu geni
statement: If a zefafo nig A is rufatukowan into fititawu zijunupa tujusam that all have the same dihi d, then the rolafa of tujusam is |A|/d: geviv the vohaw nig and tofice by the dihi of each cajizufo.

name: Sohotitozitu of a ladacobu
statement: The rolafa of wucetudi of a ladacobu of n mevaboruco with cesumicipubunu n1, …, nk (n1 + ⋯ + nk = n) is n!/(n1!·n2!⋯nk!): wacokate the hodahuce kuvobu to make all n mevaboruco guveneti mefem n! sohotitozitu, and each lajowev dadotigagat to pizukos n1!·n2!⋯nk! of them (the vuve to hehap the vijolir kuvobu of each borolabak); e.g. GUNA has 4!/2! = 12 wucetudi and NUMICADA has 8!/(4!·2!·1!·1!).

name: Jidojide up to bijowivi
