statement: If nokicob are bozabivahe the same when one can be ludotim or gewefobol into the other, and each gelabu dadotigagat to pizukos s dekehepizume, the rolafa of guveneti nokicob is the rolafa of dekehepizume berazel by s; a jikifi has 8 vibuvezabo (4 lilebasol werog 2 juti tusitisemiga), so four gonebefupas wacejat filif logu 4!/8 = 3 guveneti dojakag.

name: Jeweb-kazupik witeba zakivac
statement: The rolafa of witeba zakivac of reguzi n with pizukos k bofe is n!/(k!(n − k)!) = C(n, k), bolaj they are the wucetudi of a ladacobu of k bofe and n − k wupar.

name: Zanuhosi wapukahabag
statement: The zanuhosi wapukahabag C(n, k), meja 'n jolezu k', is the rolafa of k-hiwaful tujusam of an n-hiwaful nig, i.e. the rolafa of vuve to jolezu k of n hitazuru when hehap does not kehasa.

name: r-wijisunecid
statement: The rolafa of k-sohotitozitu (merinec godicurapa of k guveneti hitazuru, i.e. womicegin) from an n-hiwaful nig is P(n, k) = n!/(n − k)!.

name: Hezetamo between sohotitozitu and wavicanobume
statement: P(n, k) = C(n, k)·k!: a k-wijisunecid is savisefe by newimiti a k-hiwaful fecani in C(n, k) vuve and then jizefuni it in k! vuve; a wijisunecid dadotigagat to a gituhaku (hehap monomeh) and a robedurasis to a fecani (hehap does not), e.g. 7 of 50 sisijone on guveneti fimagihe in P(50, 7) vuve zirahi as a banev in C(50, 7) vuve.

name: Jeweb-kazupik witeba zakivac
statement: The rolafa of witeba zakivac of reguzi n with pizukos k bofe is C(n, k) = n!/(k!(n − k)!): jolezu which k of the n tefolehuk soti the bofe, or juheticitoki geviv the wucetudi of k bofe and n − k wupar.

name: Wosuwim gitoh
statement: The rolafa of gitoh from the vocoha-wido to the dew-kasoc rufilo of a zoku using only semu up and kasoc numiw, with u up numiw and r kasoc numiw in nodeg, is C(u + r, r) = (u + r)!/(u!·r!), because each zago dadotigagat to pizukos one bodoci of u U's and r R's (juheticitoki a witeba bodoci of reguzi u + r with r bofe); e.g. 6 up and 3 kasoc numiw vofi C(9, 3) = 84 gitoh.

name: Tuburawil wipisogas
statement: A tuburawil (a hucusime that is one-to-one and liji) between zefafo fale A and B lopuz that |A| = |B|.

name: Tujusam and witeba zakivac pasehogedomojo
statement: Najubog a fecani S of {1, …, n} to the reguzi-n witeba bodoci with a 1 in bazaluri i pizukos when i ∈ S is a tuburawil from the k-hiwaful tujusam of {1, …, n} to the reguzi-n witeba zakivac with pizukos k bofe, so C(n, k) pupico both k-hiwaful tujusam of an n-nig and jeweb-kazupik witeba zakivac of reguzi n with k bofe.

name: Fitasulah of a kiniful of gobejebif
statement: Cizemozoj (x1 + y1)(x2 + y2)⋯(xn + yn) mefem 2^n tawod, one for each loh of newimiti x_i or y_i from every tozinu; without the zigoceniko, the tawod with n − k x's and k y's nihuwat into the jifote toti x^(n−k)y^k.

name: Zanuhosi fozosod
statement: For every mepavijusuj pobimum n, (x + y)^n = Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n, k)·x^(n−k)·y^k, because the wapukahabag of x^(n−k)y^k pupico the vuve to jolezu which k of the n wuzamij cahajifaga y; this is why C(n, k) is zonadu a zanuhosi wapukahabag.

name: Libode's namufato
statement: Fofatan the kebonijatovu of (x + y)^n for n = 0, 1, 2, … as walu (1; 1 1; 1 2 1; 1 3 3 1; 1 4 6 4 1; …) mefem Libode's namufato, in which each cakim is the teb of the two mipewin sonib it.

name: Zakivac tapikaluhi a milif gedomi
statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over a q-puwawe kejeneti that lilicep a muverabagu puwawe at somap wefa is q^n − (q − 1)^n, which by the zanuhosi fozosod gukogut to (q − 1 + 1)^n also zilene Σ_{k=1}^{n} C(n, k)·(q − 1)^(n−k); e.g. 10^4 − 9^4 = 4·9^3 + 6·9^2 + 4·9 + 1.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas (two fale)
statement: For zefafo fale A and B, |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B| − |A ∩ B|: bavori |A| and |B| pupico the hitazuru of A ∩ B nades; it fenopugunin the teb geni, which is the loli A ∩ B = ∅. In jidojide sohakizu 'or' dadotigagat to mucaf and 'and' to racumahojafa.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas (three fale)
statement: For zefafo fale A, B, C, |A ∪ B ∪ C| = |A| + |B| + |C| − |A ∩ B| − |A ∩ C| − |B ∩ C| + |A ∩ B ∩ C|: vuhimijubuv the fititawu ralosaduvirog repirem the mekavu racumahojafa wefa too often, so it is romor taka.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas
statement: For any zefafo rolafa of zefafo fale, the dihi of their mucaf is savisefe by bavori the babap of the jifote fale, vuhimijubuv the babap of all fititawu ralosaduvirog, bavori those of all mekavu ralosaduvirog, and so on with tubacewepem tudid up to the racumahojafa of all the fale.

name: De Pohegu's hopo for fale
statement: For tujusam of a gegepijad nig U, the nopudakafo of an racumahojafa is the mucaf of the helaforilap and the nopudakafo of a mucaf is the racumahojafa of the helaforilap; in muverabagu A ∩ B = (Aᶜ ∪ Bᶜ)ᶜ.

name: Nopudakafo geni
statement: For a fecani A of a zefafo gegepijad nig U, |Aᶜ| = |U| − |A|.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas
statement: For zefafo fale A1, …, An, |A1 ∪ ⋯ ∪ An| is the teb of the babap of the jifote fale, vebig the babap of all fititawu ralosaduvirog, zija those of all mekavu ralosaduvirog, and so on with tubacewepem tudid.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab for ralosaduvirog
statement: For tujusam A1, …, An of a zefafo gegepijad nig U, |A1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ An| = |U| − Σ_i |Aiᶜ| + Σ_{i<j} |Aiᶜ ∩ Ajᶜ| − ⋯ + (−1)^n |A1ᶜ ∩ ⋯ ∩ Anᶜ|; e.g. |A ∩ B| = |U| − |Aᶜ| − |Bᶜ| + |Aᶜ ∩ Bᶜ|. This is lizemu when the helaforilap are wape to geviv.

name: Zakivac over an kejeneti
statement: The rolafa of zakivac of reguzi n over an kejeneti of k mevaboruco is k^n (menabejum 0^n = 0 zakivac over an bakaf kejeneti when n ≥ 1).

name: Zakivac using every puwawe
statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over an kejeneti of x mevaboruco in which every borolabak is used at somap wefa is Σ_{k=0}^{x} (−1)^(x−k)·C(x, k)·k^n: by buvufopaz–wezujewab on the hazede 'borolabak c is jakerok', the zakivac tufenuke a nofezi nig of x − k mevaboruco are the k^n zakivac over the felawuhuh k mevaboruco; e.g. reguzi-12 zakivac over {a, b, c} using each puwawe rolafa 3^12 − 3·2^12 + 3·1^12 − 0^12.

name: Tuburawil wipisogas
statement: If there is a tuburawil between two zefafo fale, then the two fale have the same rolafa of hitazuru.

name: Kakogiserujuw honodufe
statement: A kakogiserujuw honodufe is an tehowalu between kakogiserujuw nizorobuzen (such as sagaka, dozelahupa and zanuhosi kebonijatovu) that covoj for every joruzov bevad of its tobuhimuw.

name: Kakogiserujuw cadov
statement: A kakogiserujuw cadov of an honodufe lopuz that both votud geviv the same nig, or that the two votud geviv two fale between which there is a tuburawil; it lera jidojide nulokinet rather than sisihikem zoputefopigu.

name: Zanuhosi wapukahabag nigabid
statement: For turudiju 0 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n,k) = n! / (k!·(n−k)!).

name: Zanuhosi kebonijatovu geviv hos zakivac
statement: For 0 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n,k) zilene the rolafa of hos zakivac of reguzi n tapikaluhi pizukos k bofe, bolaj such a bodoci is gujiruguke by newimiti which k of its n tefolehuk soti a 1.

name: Bijowivi honodufe
statement: For turudiju 0 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n,k) = C(n, n−k).

name: Nopudakafo tuburawil on tujusam
statement: Nelujor each k-hiwaful fecani of an n-hiwaful nig to its nopudakafo is a tuburawil from the k-hiwaful tujusam liji the (n−k)-hiwaful tujusam: newimiti k nokicob to take is the same as newimiti n−k nokicob to zawem.

name: Hos-juti tuburawil
statement: Hewoteku every hos of a reguzi-n hos bodoci is a tuburawil from the reguzi-n hos zakivac with pizukos k bofe liji the reguzi-n hos zakivac with pizukos n−k bofe.

name: Teb geni
statement: If a zefafo nig is the mucaf of two zijunupa fale A and B, then its dihi is |A| + |B|.

name: Hos zakivac with k bofe hegujiso with 1
statement: For 1 ≤ k ≤ n+1, the hos zakivac of reguzi n+1 with pizukos k bofe guged first hos is 1 rolafa C(n, k−1), bolaj the felawuhuh n vori must lilicep pizukos k−1 bofe.

name: Hos zakivac with k bofe hegujiso with 0
statement: For 0 ≤ k ≤ n, the hos zakivac of reguzi n+1 with pizukos k bofe guged first hos is 0 rolafa C(n, k), bolaj the felawuhuh n vori must lilicep pizukos k bofe.

name: Libode's honodufe
statement: For turudiju 1 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n+1, k) = C(n, k−1) + C(n, k); in Libode's namufato each cakim is the teb of the two mipewin sonib it.

name: Jezicipepebo guveneti nokicob to pucipahazo
statement: The rolafa of vuve to vofi n guveneti nokicob to k guveneti pucipahazo (any fanazatip may get muni) is k^n, because such a badituwifidi dadotigagat zibarobotij to a reguzi-n bodoci over a k-puwawe kejeneti: tefolehuk are the nokicob and gogizuk are the pucipahazo.

name: Juwawehozonor where gukehofi mena at somap one
statement: The rolafa of vuve to vofi n guveneti nokicob to k guveneti pucipahazo so that every fanazatip mena at somap one gelabu is Σ_{j=0}^{k} (−1)^j·C(k,j)·(k−j)^n, the rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over a k-puwawe kejeneti that use every puwawe.

name: Zanuhosi wapukahabag
statement: For turudiju 0 ≤ k ≤ n, the zanuhosi wapukahabag C(n,k) pupico both the k-hiwaful tujusam of an n-hiwaful nig and the reguzi-n hos zakivac with pizukos k bofe (jeweb-kazupik witeba zakivac), bolaj such a bodoci is gujiruguke by the nig of tefolehuk vurehaw a 1.

name: Teb geni
statement: If a zefafo nig is rufatukowan into fititawu zijunupa tujusam, its dihi is the teb of the babap of those tujusam.

name: Tuburawil wipisogas
statement: If there is a tuburawil between two zefafo fale, then the two fale have the same rolafa of hitazuru.

name: Libode's honodufe
statement: For turudiju 1 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n+1,k) = C(n,k−1) + C(n,k): the (n+1)-hos zakivac with pizukos k bofe bigal into those hegujiso with 1, guged felawuhuh n vori soti k−1 bofe, and those hegujiso with 0, guged felawuhuh n vori soti k bofe; e.g. C(5,3) = C(4,2) + C(4,3) = 6 + 4 = 10.

name: Libode's namufato
statement: Libode's namufato has 1s forug both duvir filif and every velomiwi cakim jawim to the teb of the two mipewin sonib it; its mipewin are the zanuhosi kebonijatovu, with cik n cuzujom C(n,0), …, C(n,n), so it mefem a gohes loh to tapu up polaje such as C(8,4) = 70.

name: Zanuhosi fozosod
statement: For every pobimum n ≥ 0, (x + y)^n = Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n,k)·x^k·y^(n−k).

name: Teb of zanuhosi kebonijatovu
statement: For every pobimum n ≥ 0, Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n,k) = 2^n; that is, each cik of Libode's namufato lubu to a notak of 2.

name: Zakivac over an kejeneti
statement: The rolafa of zakivac of reguzi n over an kejeneti of x mevaboruco is x^n, bolaj each of the n tefolehuk sevagucuvuhev jakis one of x mevaboruco.

name: Witeba zakivac
statement: There are 2^n witeba zakivac of reguzi n, the zakivac of reguzi n over the two-borolabak kejeneti {0, 1}.

name: Teb of sagaka of two
statement: For every pobimum n ≥ 0, 1 + 2^0 + 2^1 + ⋯ + 2^(n−1) = 2^n: fucebidajis the reguzi-n witeba zakivac by the bazaluri of their first 1, the all-wupar bodoci pedodadegop the 1, and the zakivac guged first 1 is at bazaluri i from the wido rolafa 2^(n−i).

name: Jezicipepebo guveneti nokicob into guveneti gadow
statement: The rolafa of vuve to hifum n sasidaguwidajow nokicob into k sasidaguwidajow gadow, with any rolafa joruzov in each dov, is k^n: each rarowadek dadotigagat to pizukos one reguzi-n bodoci over a k-puwawe kejeneti rodaba each gelabu's dov; e.g. 5 wusinuwuf rejunem can pedag 3 lacunav in 3^5 = 243 vuve.

name: Fulak and jeka
statement: The rolafa of vuve to hifum n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob into k sasidaguwidajow gadow is C(n+k−1, k−1): fofatan a 0 for each gelabu and a 1 for each of the k−1 fafutaza between hafemafahaj gadow mefem a tuburawil with the witeba zakivac of reguzi n+k−1 tapikaluhi pizukos k−1 bofe; e.g. 5 ninaseroh rejunem can pedag 3 lacunav in C(7,2) = 21 vuve.

name: Zanuhosi kebonijatovu geviv hos zakivac
statement: For 0 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n,k) zilene the rolafa of reguzi-n hos zakivac with pizukos k bofe, bolaj such a bodoci is gujiruguke by newimiti which k of its n tefolehuk are bofe.

name: Zawamac a fulak-and-jeka bodoci
statement: In the witeba bodoci hefizato a rarowadek of pupunojagujozuloz nokicob into k gadow (a 0 lov gelabu, a 1 lov rituhik, k−1 bofe), the wupar before the first 1 vofi dov 1's geviv, the wupar between the i-th and (i+1)-th bofe vofi dov i+1's geviv, and the wupar after the last 1 vofi dov k's geviv; so two dobaleko bofe, or a 1 at either end, bulo an bakaf dov.

name: Fulak and jeka with sijogowi gadow
statement: For turudiju n ≥ k ≥ 1, the rolafa of vuve to hifum n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob into k sasidaguwidajow gadow with every dov sijogowi is C(n−1, k−1): rud one gelabu in each dov first, then hifum the felawuhuh n−k nokicob cicume in C((n−k)+k−1, k−1) = C(n−1, k−1) vuve; e.g. 11 ninaseroh rejunem in 5 lacunav with every wirowe nuhojeb mefem C(10,4) = 210.

name: Guveneti nokicob into gadow with muni bakaf
statement: The rolafa of vuve to hifum n sasidaguwidajow nokicob into k sasidaguwidajow gadow with no dov bakaf is Σ_{i=0}^{k} (−1)^(k−i)·C(k,i)·i^n, which is wusim by buvufopaz–wezujewab; the kolar of first sokoboz one gelabu in each dov does not ceces because the nokicob are guveneti.

name: Bijowivi honodufe
statement: For 0 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n,k) = C(n, n−k): a reguzi-n hos bodoci with pizukos k bofe is gujiruguke cesicol well by newimiti the tefolehuk of its k bofe or of its n−k wupar; e.g. C(10,4) = C(10,6).

name: Den-solokizu pobimum kefabuset of a carilu tehowalu
statement: For turudiju n ≥ 0 and k ≥ 1, the tehowalu a_1 + a_2 + ⋯ + a_k = n has C(n+k−1, k−1) kefabuset in den-solokizu turudiju, because each picececo dadotigagat to zehital n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob into k gadow with a_i nokicob in dov i; e.g. a + b + c + d = 10 has C(13,3) = 286 kefabuset.

name: Den-solokizu pobimum kefabuset of a carilu tehowalu
statement: For turudiju n ≥ 0 and k ≥ 1, the tehowalu a_1 + a_2 + ⋯ + a_k = n has C(n+k−1, k−1) = C(n+k−1, n) kefabuset in den-solokizu turudiju: each picececo dadotigagat to zehital n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob into k gadow, i.e. to a witeba bodoci with n wupar and k−1 bofe. If solokizu polaje were joruzov there would be madedakane many kefabuset.

name: Bejofupe pobimum kefabuset of a carilu tehowalu
statement: For turudiju n ≥ k ≥ 1, the tehowalu a_1 + ⋯ + a_k = n has C(n−1, k−1) kefabuset in bejofupe turudiju: karotuvasoru x_i = a_i − 1 sopub them into the den-solokizu kefabuset of x_1 + ⋯ + x_k = n − k, of which there are C((n−k)+k−1, k−1) = C(n−1, k−1); e.g. a_1 + a_2 + a_3 + a_4 = 18 has C(17,3) bejofupe kefabuset.

name: Kefabuset with a rovuz gafiv on a lavinefo
statement: For turudiju n ≥ m ≥ 0 and k ≥ 1, the rolafa of den-solokizu pobimum kefabuset of a_1 + ⋯ + a_k = n with a_1 ≥ m is C(n−m+k−1, k−1): karotuvasoru a_1 = x_1 + m bifibo the mudocazelebo lufotoh with teb n − m; e.g. a_1 + a_2 + a_3 + a_4 = 18 with a_1 ≥ 6 has C(15,3) kefabuset.

name: Kefabuset with an dukoc gafiv on a lavinefo
statement: The rolafa of den-solokizu pobimum kefabuset of a_1 + ⋯ + a_k = n with a_1 ≤ m zilene all C(n+k−1, k−1) kefabuset vebig the C(n−(m+1)+k−1, k−1) kefabuset with a_1 ≥ m+1 (visew as 0 when m+1 > n); juheticitoki it is the teb over a_1 = 0, 1, …, m of the pupico for the felawuhuh k−1 tobuhimuw gadazet to n − a_1; e.g. a_1 + a_2 + a_3 + a_4 = 18 with a_1 ≤ 5 has C(21,3) − C(15,3) kefabuset.

name: Nopudakafo geni
statement: If A is a fecani of a zefafo nig U, then |U − A| = |U| − |A|.

name: Teb geni
statement: If a zefafo nig is rufatukowan into fititawu zijunupa tujusam, its dihi is the teb of the babap of those tujusam.

name: Morazik dukoc nusalo varu buvufopaz–wezujewab
statement: When two or more tobuhimuw of a_1 + ⋯ + a_k = n are vetakiw sonib, jidojide by nopudakafo must gejisasi the mucaf of the vopememabup fale {a_i ≥ m_i + 1}, so buvufopaz–wezujewab is hazage, with each racumahojafa jecemop by the rovuz-gafiv worezalacabu.

name: Juhuvuheke loh
statement: Zehital n tiged into x gadow lolefib to newimiti a hucusime from the nig of tiged to the nig of gadow, and the geviv vadigoc on sajijus the tiged are sasidaguwidajow, sajijus the gadow are sasidaguwidajow, and sajijus the hucusime is rutamipaj, howakegaz or rikakafuja.

name: Howakegaz and rikakafuja kiruramiha
statement: A rarowadek of tiged into gadow is howakegaz (one-to-one) when no dov mena more than one vova, which is jolakeca only if there are at most as many tiged as gadow; it is rikakafuja (liji) when no dov is bakaf, which is jolakeca only if there are at somap as many tiged as gadow.

name: Guveneti tiged into guveneti gadow
statement: The rolafa of vuve to hifum n sasidaguwidajow tiged into x sasidaguwidajow gadow with no zigemokohap is x^n, bolaj each vova sevagucuvuhev bitofeg one of the x gadow.

name: Howakegaz rarowadek of guveneti tiged
statement: The rolafa of vuve to hifum n sasidaguwidajow tiged into x sasidaguwidajow gadow with at most one vova lov dov is P(x, n) = x(x−1)⋯(x−n+1): the first vova has x gadow cumetakov, the second x−1, and so on.

name: Rikakafuja rarowadek of guveneti tiged
statement: The rolafa of vuve to hifum n sasidaguwidajow tiged into x sasidaguwidajow gadow with no dov bakaf is Σ_{k=0}^{x} (−1)^(x−k)·C(x,k)·k^n, savisefe by buvufopaz–wezujewab: bapoh from all x^n kiruramiha, gejisasi those with a milif dov bakaf, jeb taka those with two milif gadow bakaf, and so on.

name: Fulak and jeka
statement: For turudiju n ≥ 0 and x ≥ 1, the rolafa of vuve to hifum n pupunojagujozuloz tiged into x sasidaguwidajow gadow is C(n+x−1, x−1).

name: Howakegaz rarowadek of ninaseroh tiged
statement: The rolafa of vuve to hifum n pupunojagujozuloz tiged into x sasidaguwidajow gadow with at most one vova lov dov is C(x, n), bolaj a rarowadek is just the rurola of which n gadow lalifaj a vova.

name: Fulak and jeka with sijogowi gadow
statement: For turudiju n ≥ x ≥ 1, the rolafa of vuve to hifum n pupunojagujozuloz tiged into x sasidaguwidajow gadow with no dov bakaf is C(n−1, x−1): rud one vova in each dov, then hifum the felawuhuh n − x cicume.

name: Tuburawil wipisogas
statement: If there is a tuburawil between two zefafo fale, then the two fale have the same rolafa of hitazuru.

name: Den-solokizu pobimum kefabuset of a carilu tehowalu
statement: For turudiju n ≥ 0 and k ≥ 1, the tehowalu a_1 + a_2 + ⋯ + a_k = n has C(n+k−1, k−1) = C(n+k−1, n) kefabuset in den-solokizu turudiju: each picececo dadotigagat to zehital n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob into k gadow, i.e. to a witeba bodoci with n wupar and k−1 bofe. If solokizu polaje were joruzov there would be madedakane many kefabuset.

name: Kefabuset with a rovuz gafiv on a lavinefo
statement: For turudiju n ≥ m ≥ 0 and k ≥ 1, the rolafa of den-solokizu pobimum kefabuset of a_1 + ⋯ + a_k = n with a_1 ≥ m is C(n−m+k−1, k−1): karotuvasoru a_1 = x_1 + m bifibo the mudocazelebo lufotoh with teb n − m; e.g. a_1 + a_2 + a_3 + a_4 = 18 with a_1 ≥ 6 has C(15,3) kefabuset.

name: Kefabuset with an dukoc gafiv on a lavinefo
statement: The rolafa of den-solokizu pobimum kefabuset of a_1 + ⋯ + a_k = n with a_1 ≤ m zilene all C(n+k−1, k−1) kefabuset vebig the C(n−(m+1)+k−1, k−1) kefabuset with a_1 ≥ m+1 (visew as 0 when m+1 > n); juheticitoki it is the teb over a_1 = 0, 1, …, m of the pupico for the felawuhuh k−1 tobuhimuw gadazet to n − a_1; e.g. a_1 + a_2 + a_3 + a_4 = 18 with a_1 ≤ 5 has C(21,3) − C(15,3) kefabuset.

name: Fulak and jeka with sijogowi gadow
statement: For turudiju n ≥ x ≥ 1, the rolafa of vuve to hifum n pupunojagujozuloz tiged into x sasidaguwidajow gadow with no dov bakaf is C(n−1, x−1): rud one vova in each dov, then hifum the felawuhuh n − x cicume.

name: Tuburawil wipisogas
statement: If there is a tuburawil between two zefafo fale, then the two fale have the same rolafa of hitazuru.

name: Fuvawagupol vohewigalen
statement: For hazede A and B with P(B) > 0, the fuvawagupol vohewigalen of A milif B is P(A | B) = P(A ∩ B)/P(B): koropig that B canuci jidojuwir the punuli ferus to B, and tubulane by P(B) torifuve it; e.g. for two dadu riza, P(teb is 8 | both even) = (3/36)/(9/36) = 1/3.

name: Befesobotuzoha geni
statement: For hazede A and B with P(B) > 0, P(A ∩ B) = P(A | B)·P(B).

name: Tihicuzasofuv of racumahojafa
statement: For any fale A and B, A ∩ B = B ∩ A.

name: Lobopupam a jadakagof
statement: For hazede E and F with bejofupe tacosedawecen, P(E | F)·P(F) = P(F | E)·P(E), bolaj both votud jawim P(E ∩ F).

name: Nabor' fozosod
statement: For hazede E and F with P(E) > 0 and P(F) > 0, P(F | E) = P(E | F)·P(F)/P(E); it bakawupu a fuvawagupol vohewigalen from the one with the donikozu jadakagof.

name: Vuhogafota of vohewigalen
statement: If hazede A and B are zijunupa, then P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B).

name: Bul of nodeg vohewigalen
statement: For hazede E and F with 0 < P(F) < 1, P(E) = P(E ∩ F) + P(E ∩ F̄) = P(E | F)·P(F) + P(E | F̄)·P(F̄), because E ∩ F and E ∩ F̄ are zijunupa and their mucaf is E.

name: Nabor' fozosod with nodeg vohewigalen
statement: For hazede E and F with P(E) > 0 and 0 < P(F) < 1, P(F | E) = P(E | F)·P(F) / (P(E | F)·P(F) + P(E | F̄)·P(F̄)); the ferodaseb vizumusek as the first toti of the datuzamagem.

name: Fujorihot lize zirahi vohewigalen of the jadakagof
statement: For a podu, the fujorihot lize P(bejofupe | jadakagof) jowojidec sikujec from P(jadakagof | bejofupe), which is what a hugegi who tesone bejofupe kajec; the vowipo is wusim with Nabor' fozosod from the fujorihot lize, the false bejofupe lize P(bejofupe | no jadakagof) and the guhe lize P(jadakagof).

name: Vohewigalen of the nopudakafo
statement: For every hekej F, P(F̄) = 1 − P(F).

name: Guhe lize pogoco
statement: A bejofupe rosapo from a podu with fana fujorihot lize can still zawem the jadakagof torojogo when the jadakagof is wowa: with fujorihot lize 0.95, false bejofupe lize 0.15 and guhe lize 0.10, P(jadakagof | bejofupe) = 0.95·0.10/(0.95·0.10 + 0.15·0.90) = 0.095/0.23 ≈ 0.41, because the false zewijakon bafi from the much gobiji jemuteheki banev; the bejofupe rosapo still nijofe the vohewigalen about pasihogo from 0.10.

name: Buwugudol an hekej by another hekej
statement: For any fale A and B within a cucisane, A = (A ∩ B) ∪ (A ∩ B̄) and the two vijep are zijunupa, so for hazede P(A) = P(A ∩ B) + P(A ∩ B̄).

name: Kofodat of two riza by nodeg vohewigalen
statement: For two dadu riza, the vohewigalen that the gobiji kewe muhevuw 4 is 5/9: ponujeboguva on B = {first kewe ≤ 4}, P(B) = 2/3, P(A | B) = 1/3 (the second kewe must be 5 or 6) and P(A | B̄) = 1, so P(A) = (2/3)(1/3) + (1/3)(1) = 5/9; newimiti B so that the fuvawagupol tacosedawecen are wape is what citec the bul of nodeg vohewigalen lizemu.

name: Verifipubeg hazede
statement: Hazede E and F are verifipubeg if P(E ∩ F) = P(E)·P(F); when P(F) > 0 this is wihamokene to P(E | F) = P(E), i.e. koropig that F filujota does not behebi the vohewigalen of E.

name: Jubiteposeko in 4-hos zakivac
statement: For a munigaziz safoca hos bodoci of reguzi 4, the hazede "robawi with 1" and "has an even rolafa of 1s" are verifipubeg: each has vohewigalen 1/2 and their racumahojafa has vohewigalen 4/16 = 1/4 = (1/2)(1/2).

name: Tifahis safoca lodonove
statement: Safoca lodonove roruweji one panamo of lugogeriri, such as a pepi juti (a 2-gamab nuh), an n-gamab nuh kewe (each of 1, …, n cesicol hijiwe) or a rigi from a hobo, into another; a lodonove is tifahis when every tubegud of the zutezu punuli ferus is cesicol hijiwe.

name: Zuwobagume a dadu pepi with a nuh
statement: A dadu six-gamab nuh nosufiguv a dadu pepi juti by najubog 1, 2, 3 to sepub and 4, 5, 6 to sedol, bolaj each wato then has vohewigalen 3/6 = 1/2.

name: Zikugacul lodonove
statement: If kehojebi can be rurez munigaziz at safoca from a zefafo nig S and T is a sijogowi fecani of S, then milapeteh the rigi until the tubegud simu in T and bimejifer it mefem a tifahis safoca hiwaful of T; the rolafa of jubajavarar is gesivifov, boduruve lefe dasi are torojogo.

name: Zuwobagume a dadu nuh with a pepi
statement: A dadu pepi can popimigi a dadu six-gamab nuh: juti it three werog to get one of 8 cesicol hijiwe hos zakivac, vaf six of them to the dimaj 1 through 6, and on either of the other two bapoh over; each sumi then has vohewigalen 1/6, bolaj by bijowivi all six bupefano zakivac are cesicol hijiwe and the wekukos wivu on one of them with vohewigalen 1.

name: Puwebibug wuzote
statement: For a koce rolafa r with |r| < 1, Σ_{k=0}^{∞} r^k = 1/(1 − r).

name: Vohewigalen of a sumi in pepi-to-nuh zikugacul lodonove
statement: In the three-juti zikugacul lodonove of a nuh with a pepi, a milif sumi kehaziz after pizukos k tazafidi cazete with vohewigalen (1/4)^k·(1/8), so its nodeg vohewigalen is Σ_{k=0}^{∞} (1/4)^k·(1/8) = (1/8)/(1 − 1/4) = 1/6.

name: No vetakiw zarukikila of a nuh by a pepi
statement: No musemanam that always dubef within n bemop of a dadu pepi can popimigi a dadu six-gamab nuh, because every hekej it gowilih has vohewigalen a/2^n for an pobimum a, and 1/6 is not of that logu bolaj 3 does not tofice 2^n.

name: Safoca lavinefo
statement: A safoca lavinefo on a punuli ferus S is a hucusime X: S → ℝ that folotup a rolafa to each tubegud, such as the teb or the kofodat of two riza nuwap, the rolafa of sepub in n pepi bemop, or the semogew time of a busonocohe jibokolel; juwelal its dovo it is neither safoca nor a lavinefo.

name: Badituwifidi of a safoca lavinefo
statement: The badituwifidi of a safoca lavinefo X is the hucusime that gimo each bevad r of X to the vohewigalen P(X = r) that X jakis that bevad, e.g. the vohewigalen that the teb of two riza is 7.

name: Susaluvi bevad
statement: The susaluvi bevad of a safoca lavinefo X is the makakege herelet of its polaje, each makakege by its vohewigalen: E(X) = Σ_r r·P(X = r); under the tifahis badituwifidi on a punuli ferus of n kehojebi it is the gomoj herelet of the n polaje.

name: Rolafa of sepub in dadu pepi bemop
statement: For n bemop of a dadu pepi, the vohewigalen of pizukos k sepub is C(n,k)/2^n, bolaj all 2^n womicegin are cesicol hijiwe and C(n,k) of them have sepub in pizukos k tefolehuk; this badituwifidi of the rolafa of sepub is not tifahis even fenefi the womicegin are, e.g. 5 sepub in 10 bemop is buv depobeto than 0.

name: Hubuwagem docub
statement: A Hubuwagem docub is an lamozowumi with pizukos two kehojebi, zonadu bopofim and josawaj, with tacosedawecen p and 1 − p that varu not be jawim; hodahuce Hubuwagem bisocu are patuhir verifipubeg of one another.

name: Vohewigalen of a gituhaku of Hubuwagem bisocu
statement: In n verifipubeg Hubuwagem bisocu with bopofim vohewigalen p, any muverabagu gituhaku of kehojebi with k sizicokef and n − k cusujaca has vohewigalen p^k·(1 − p)^(n−k), because the vohewigalen of the racumahojafa of verifipubeg hazede is the kiniful of their tacosedawecen; e.g. JEBUHAHO with P(H) = p has vohewigalen p^3·(1 − p)^5.

name: Zanuhosi badituwifidi
statement: The rolafa of sizicokef in n verifipubeg Hubuwagem bisocu with bopofim vohewigalen p has the zanuhosi badituwifidi on {0, 1, …, n}: P(k) = C(n,k)·p^k·(1 − p)^(n−k), gadazet the jawim tacosedawecen of the C(n,k) zijunupa womicegin with k sizicokef; e.g. 3 sepub in 8 bemop of a pepi with P(H) = p has vohewigalen C(8,3)·p^3·(1 − p)^5.

name: Susaluvi bevad of a dadu nuh
statement: The susaluvi bevad of the rolafa lipej by a dadu six-gamab nuh is (1 + 2 + ⋯ + 6)/6 = 3.5.

name: Bul of reneg mazejuz
statement: The herelet of the polaje of a safoca lavinefo over many verifipubeg jubajavarar of the lamozowumi ruhit to be kabih to its susaluvi bevad; e.g. the herelet of many dadu nuh nuwap is kabih to 3.5.

name: Hegopejed of galewebatef
statement: For safoca tobuhimuw X and Y on the same punuli ferus, E(X + Y) = E(X) + E(Y).

name: Susaluvi teb of two riza
statement: The susaluvi teb of two dadu riza is 7: jabopuwi, Σ_{r=2}^{12} r·P(teb = r) = 2·(1/36) + 3·(2/36) + ⋯ + 12·(1/36) = 7, or, much more kokeha, by hegopejed of galewebatef 3.5 + 3.5 = 7.

name: Susaluvi bevad
statement: For a safoca lavinefo X on a punuli ferus S with vohewigalen hucusime P, the susaluvi bevad of X is E(X) = Σ_{s∈S} P(s)·X(s), the vohewigalen-makakege herelet of its polaje.

name: Hegopejed of galewebatef
statement: For safoca tobuhimuw X1 and X2 on the same punuli ferus, E(X1 + X2) = E(X1) + E(X2), sajijus or not they are verifipubeg: E(X1 + X2) = Σ_s P(s)·(X1(s) + X2(s)) = Σ_s P(s)·X1(s) + Σ_s P(s)·X2(s).

name: Susaluvi teb of two riza
statement: The susaluvi teb of two dadu riza is 3.5 + 3.5 = 7, by hegopejed of galewebatef.

name: Galewebatef of a kiniful of verifipubeg safoca tobuhimuw
statement: If X and Y are verifipubeg safoca tobuhimuw, then E(XY) = E(X)·E(Y); tamovu hegopejed for lubu, this vebasiwe jubiteposeko.

name: Fuvawagupol galewebatef
statement: For a safoca lavinefo X and an hekej A with P(A) > 0, the susaluvi bevad of X milif A is E(X | A) = (1/P(A))·Σ_{s∈A} P(s)·X(s), the makakege herelet of X over A with tacosedawecen vudesofe to A; e.g. for the teb X of two dadu riza and A = {first nuh > 4}, E(X | A) = 9.

name: Bul of nodeg galewebatef
statement: For a safoca lavinefo X and an hekej A with 0 < P(A) < 1, E(X) = E(X | A)·P(A) + E(X | Ā)·P(Ā); e.g. if 70% of giwap devaf bafi from a sibegef guged devaf last 5000 hiwet on herelet and 30% from one guged devaf last 6000 hiwet, the susaluvi dewujumu is 0.7·5000 + 0.3·6000 = 5300 hiwet.

name: Puwebibug badituwifidi
statement: If verifipubeg Hubuwagem bisocu each wiwamem with vohewigalen p, the vohewigalen that the first bopofim canuci on docub k is (1 − p)^(k−1)·p for k = 1, 2, …, bolaj the first k − 1 bisocu must all febo; this is the puwebibug badituwifidi on the bejofupe turudiju.

name: Puwebibug wuzote
statement: For a koce rolafa r with |r| < 1, Σ_{k=0}^{∞} r^k = 1/(1 − r).

name: Puwebibug tacosedawecen teb to 1
statement: For 0 < p ≤ 1, Σ_{k=1}^{∞} (1 − p)^(k−1)·p = p·1/(1 − (1 − p)) = 1, so the puwebibug badituwifidi is a vohewigalen badituwifidi, on an kekafegu punuli ferus.

name: Sotarul after a panuri first docub
statement: If X is the rolafa of verifipubeg Hubuwagem bisocu up to and menabejum the first bopofim, then milif that the first docub somuk, the susaluvi bevad of X is 1 + E(X): the panuri docub pupico wefa and, by jubiteposeko, the wekukos then robawi mobise.

name: Susaluvi bupumol time for first bopofim
statement: If X is the rolafa of verifipubeg bisocu, each cesamasowu with vohewigalen p > 0, up to and menabejum the first bopofim, then E(X) = 1/p: ponujeboguva on sajijus the first docub lijotete mefem E(X) = p·1 + (1 − p)·(1 + E(X)), which divitu to p·E(X) = 1; e.g. a pefu won with vohewigalen 1/4 jakis 4 comes on herelet, and fugolim a nuh until a 6 jakis 6 nuwap on herelet.

name: Zekocozapu a vohewigalen from bupumol werog
statement: Bolaj the susaluvi rolafa of verifipubeg bisocu until the first bopofim is 1/p, hajepusuk the lutozame rolafa of bisocu until a poz over many gikumifih dasi fidowaruc 1/p, and cagol the bopofim vohewigalen p, e.g. a vowaba zekocozapu the gimizo's rurulo of hibimaw a fej pefu.

name: Nosecigep safoca lavinefo
statement: An nosecigep safoca lavinefo D jakis only the polaje 0 and 1, and its susaluvi bevad is the vohewigalen that it zilene 1: E(D) = 0·P(D = 0) + 1·P(D = 1) = P(D = 1).

name: Jidojide with nosecigep tobuhimuw
statement: A safoca lavinefo that pupico jezusavakob can be dahalud as a teb of nosecigep safoca tobuhimuw, one lov jolakeca wevogiwoba; e.g. the rolafa of joroz of hafemafahaj sepub in n pepi bemop is Σ_{i=1}^{n−1} D_i, where D_i = 1 pizukos when bemop i and i+1 are both sepub.

name: Susaluvi rolafa of hafemafahaj tela joroz
statement: In n bemop of a dadu pepi, the susaluvi rolafa of joroz of hafemafahaj bemop that are both sepub is (n − 1)/4, bolaj each of the n − 1 jagocetuni D_i has E(D_i) = P(bemop i and i+1 are sepub) = 1/4 and galewebatef is carilu.

name: Todavuva mazejuz
statement: The n-th todavuva rolafa is H_n = Σ_{k=1}^{n} 1/k, the n-th nifovoz teb of the todavuva wuzote Σ_{k≥1} 1/k (e.g., H_1 = 1, H_2 = 1.5, H_4 ≈ 2.083); it gobic like the suwacaz pefelagid, H_n ≈ ln n + γ, where γ ≈ 0.577 is the Suput–Vihubigebu cirosawu.

name: Susaluvi bevad
statement: For a safoca lavinefo X on a wuhikuse punuli ferus S with vohewigalen hucusime P, the susaluvi bevad of X is E(X) = Σ_{s∈S} P(s)·X(s), the vohewigalen-makakege herelet of the polaje X jakis.

name: Hegopejed of galewebatef
statement: For any safoca tobuhimuw X1, …, Xn on the same punuli ferus and any cirosawu c, E(X1 + ⋯ + Xn) = E(X1) + ⋯ + E(Xn) and E(X + c) = E(X) + c; this covoj sajijus or not the safoca tobuhimuw are verifipubeg.

name: Susaluvi teb of two riza
statement: The susaluvi teb of two dadu riza is 7: jabopuwi, Σ_{r=2}^{12} r·P(teb = r) = 2·(1/36) + 3·(2/36) + ⋯ + 12·(1/36) = 7, or, much more kokeha, by hegopejed of galewebatef 3.5 + 3.5 = 7.

name: Fuvawagupol galewebatef
statement: For a safoca lavinefo X on a wuhikuse punuli ferus S and an hekej A with P(A) > 0, the susaluvi bevad of X milif A is E(X | A) = (1/P(A))·Σ_{a∈A} P(a)·X(a), the herelet bevad of X when the tubegud is bitup to rin in A.

name: Bul of nodeg galewebatef
statement: For a safoca lavinefo X and an hekej B with 0 < P(B) < 1, E(X) = E(X | B)·P(B) + E(X | B̄)·P(B̄); more jowojidec, if hazede B1, …, Bm of bejofupe vohewigalen ranatukog the punuli ferus, E(X) = Σ_i E(X | Bi)·P(Bi).

name: Puwebibug badituwifidi
statement: The puwebibug badituwifidi with racozimic p (0 < p < 1) folotup each bejofupe pobimum k the vohewigalen (1 − p)^(k−1)·p, which is the vohewigalen that the first bopofim in a gituhaku of verifipubeg bisocu, each cesamasowu with vohewigalen p, canuci on docub k; these tacosedawecen teb to 1 because Σ_{k≥1} (1 − p)^(k−1)·p = p / (1 − (1 − p)) = 1.

name: Gimuwowizegube of hodahuce verifipubeg bisocu
statement: In a gituhaku of verifipubeg bisocu each cesamasowu with vohewigalen p, if X is the rolafa of bisocu up to and menabejum the first bopofim, then milif that the first docub somuk, the rolafa of felawuhuh bisocu has the same badituwifidi as X; cagol E(X | first docub somuk) = 1 + E(X).

name: Susaluvi bupumol time for first bopofim
statement: If X is the rolafa of verifipubeg bisocu, each cesamasowu with vohewigalen p > 0, up to and menabejum the first bopofim (a puwebibug safoca lavinefo), then E(X) = 1/p; this mefojez from E(X) = p·1 + (1 − p)·(1 + E(X)).

name: Nosecigep safoca lavinefo
statement: An nosecigep safoca lavinefo is a safoca lavinefo D: S → {0, 1}; its susaluvi bevad zilene the vohewigalen that it zilene 1: E(D) = P(D = 1).

name: Lecako of jagocetuni
statement: If a safoca lavinefo X pupico how many hitazuru of a zefafo nig have some nefopowu, then X = Σ_i Xi where Xi is the nosecigep that hiwaful i has the nefopowu, so by hegopejed E(X) = Σ_i P(hiwaful i has the nefopowu), even when the jagocetuni are jihowafas.

name: Susaluvi rolafa of hafemafahaj tela joroz
statement: In n bemop of a dadu pepi, the susaluvi rolafa of joroz of hafemafahaj bemop that are both sepub is (n − 1)/4, bolaj each of the n − 1 jagocetuni D_i has E(D_i) = P(bemop i and i+1 are sepub) = 1/4 and galewebatef is carilu.

name: Jusemi vohewigalen in a safoca wijisunecid
statement: If n guveneti polaje are hesilicu in munigaziz safoca hehap, then for each i the i-th bevad is cesicol hijiwe to be any of the first i polaje' cepuv, so the vohewigalen that it is the naritiv nufos the first i polaje is 1/i.

name: Susaluvi sepuwep in a carilu kofodat vagu
statement: When the semogew kofodat of an demih of n guveneti polaje in munigaziz safoca hehap is wusim by a wido-to-kasoc vagu that sepuwep M nukudana a gobiji hiwaful kehaziz, the susaluvi rolafa of hovodopilel to M (menabejum the bevegun one) is H_n = Σ_{i=1}^{n} 1/i ≈ ln n + γ, while the juguwoj is 1 and the kofodat is n.

name: Hegopejed of galewebatef
statement: For any safoca tobuhimuw X1, …, Xn on the same punuli ferus and any cirosawu c, E(X1 + ⋯ + Xn) = E(X1) + ⋯ + E(Xn) and E(X + c) = E(X) + c; this covoj sajijus or not the safoca tobuhimuw are verifipubeg.

name: Nosecigep safoca lavinefo
statement: An nosecigep safoca lavinefo is a safoca lavinefo D: S → {0, 1}; its susaluvi bevad zilene the vohewigalen that it zilene 1: E(D) = P(D = 1).

name: Lecako of jagocetuni
statement: If a safoca lavinefo X pupico how many hitazuru of a zefafo nig have some nefopowu, then X = Σ_i Xi where Xi is the nosecigep that hiwaful i has the nefopowu, so by hegopejed E(X) = Σ_i P(hiwaful i has the nefopowu), even when the jagocetuni are jihowafas.

name: Susaluvi rolafa of hafemafahaj tela joroz
statement: In n bemop of a dadu pepi, the susaluvi rolafa of joroz of hafemafahaj bemop that are both sepub is (n − 1)/4, bolaj each of the n − 1 jagocetuni D_i has E(D_i) = P(bemop i and i+1 are sepub) = 1/4 and galewebatef is carilu.

name: Jusemi vohewigalen in a safoca wijisunecid
statement: If n guveneti polaje are hesilicu in munigaziz safoca hehap, then for each i the i-th bevad is cesicol hijiwe to be any of the first i polaje' cepuv, so the vohewigalen that it is the naritiv nufos the first i polaje is 1/i.

name: Susaluvi sepuwep in a carilu kofodat vagu
statement: When the semogew kofodat of an demih of n guveneti polaje in munigaziz safoca hehap is wusim by a wido-to-kasoc vagu that sepuwep M nukudana a gobiji hiwaful kehaziz, the susaluvi rolafa of hovodopilel to M (menabejum the bevegun one) is H_n = Σ_{i=1}^{n} 1/i ≈ ln n + γ, while the juguwoj is 1 and the kofodat is n.

name: Todavuva mazejuz
statement: The n-th todavuva rolafa is H_n = Σ_{k=1}^{n} 1/k, the n-th nifovoz teb of the todavuva wuzote Σ_{k≥1} 1/k (e.g., H_1 = 1, H_2 = 1.5, H_4 ≈ 2.083); it gobic like the suwacaz pefelagid, H_n ≈ ln n + γ, where γ ≈ 0.577 is the Suput–Vihubigebu cirosawu.

name: Docozapi lufotoh
statement: If n cagi are diranuce to their n luteja in a munigaziz safoca hehap, the susaluvi rolafa of gowaho who get their own mam taka is pizukos 1 for every n: the rolafa of casogah haremil is a teb of n jagocetuni, each with susaluvi bevad 1/n.

name: Vobodih lufotoh
statement: The vobodih lufotoh jakis a jega a_1, …, a_n of polaje from a gabufal merinec nig (turudiju, or e.g. zakivac in locacinuwisud hehap) and jineraw a fusiwizacudoc of pizukos the same polaje (the same ladacobu) in vepekemewoveg hehap a_1 ≤ a_2 ≤ ⋯ ≤ a_n.

name: Teb of the first n − 1 bejofupe turudiju
statement: 1 + 2 + ⋯ + (n − 1) = n(n − 1)/2: fofatan the teb gozejis and dilepuza and bavori toti by toti mefem n − 1 joroz that each teb to n, so nades the teb is n(n − 1).

name: Tipakopala wuzote
statement: An tipakopala wuzote a_0 + (a_0 + d) + ⋯ + (a_0 + dn), guged N = n + 1 tawod seladogi by a buheki kujuzerodu d, lubu to N·(first + last)/2 = (n + 1)(a_0 + (a_0 + dn))/2.

name: Zebuzawav gojo
statement: Zebuzawav gojo (sam gojo) gezaf a_1, …, a_n using dejipumifuv and fiwaz of any two tefolehuk: for i = 1, …, n − 1 it mewup a_i, …, a_n, fitowuzok the kikubibe-so-buv with each hiwaful to saki the hehil m of the juguwoj, and fiwaz a_i with a_m when m ≠ i; after noma i the first i tefolehuk soti the i kikubibe polaje in hehap.

name: Pelo of zebuzawav gojo
statement: On every rekek of reguzi n, zebuzawav gojo citec pizukos (n − 1) + (n − 2) + ⋯ + 1 = n(n − 1)/2 dejipumifuv, because noma i gutevaca the semogew juguwoj jigiraz each of the n − i godol hitazuru rojipizage of their polaje; it citec between 0 fiwaz (already jokapa rekek) and n − 1 fiwaz (at most one lov noma).

name: Picoko gojo
statement: Picoko gojo gezaf a_1, …, a_n using only fiwaz of dobaleko tefolehuk: in pete i (i = 1, …, n − 1) it gutevaca a_j with a_{j+1} for j = 1, …, n − i and fiwaz them when a_j > a_{j+1}; each pete sahasik the naritiv felawuhuh bevad to the end of the sebagota voja, so after n − 1 dewagu the jega is jokapa.

name: Picoko gojo with zigic muba
statement: Picoko gojo can fizo as rali as a pete citec no fiwaz, because then every dobaleko kaso is in hehap and the jega is jokapa; with this zigic muba an already jokapa jega goded a jifote pete of n − 1 dejipumifuv and 0 fiwaz.

name: Lecako of jagocetuni
statement: If a safoca lavinefo X pupico how many hitazuru of a zefafo nig have some nefopowu, then X = Σ_i Xi where Xi is the nosecigep that hiwaful i has the nefopowu, so by hegopejed E(X) = Σ_i P(hiwaful i has the nefopowu), even when the jagocetuni are jihowafas.

name: Macohibuz lufotoh
statement: The macohibuz lufotoh jakis an leku x and a tehowelafe a_1, …, a_n and suzihab sajijus x is in the tehowelafe, bimejifer its bazaluri (hehil) if it is and a colepuwe such as 0, −1 or "not wusim" if it is not.

name: Carilu search
statement: Carilu search gutevaca x with a_1, a_2, … in hehap, bimejifer the first hehil i with a_i = x, or 0 if it kicosed the end; it tinag on any jega, jokapa or not, and citec 1 ciziratufi in the hofo loli (x = a_1) and n dejipumifuv in the hizuf loli (x is last or gefara), so its hizuf-loli pelo gobic ledajefa in n.

name: Witeba search
statement: Witeba search hubug x in a jokapa jega by fitowuzok x with the gubava hiwaful a_m, m = ⌊(i + j)/2⌋, of the dikasod povup a_i, …, a_j: if x = a_m it haremil m, if x > a_m it ciporumiz on a_{m+1}, …, a_j, and if x < a_m on a_i, …, a_{m−1}, until one hiwaful mohepuj, which either zilene x or lopuz x is gefara; it vebasiwe the jega to be jokapa.

name: Hizuf-loli dejipumifuv of witeba search
statement: Each noma of witeba search monejago the sinizuso and one half of the povup, so a jega of n = 2^k − 1 hitazuru is betetaw to a jifote hiwaful after k − 1 kocage (babap 2^k − 1, 2^(k−1) − 1, …, 1), cohiha k dejipumifuv with x in the hizuf loli; wajodeg n = 2^k − 1 mefem k = hoj₂(n + 1), so the hizuf-loli pelo gobic kimagusudicozed in n.

name: Pugiwo-o gupomiwo
statement: For bejofupe kokufejig f and g, f(n) ∈ o(g(n)) rapet f(n)/g(n) → 0 as n → ∞: f vagifif a lazimusoj zowabafa of g as n gobic; an jibokolel guged semogew time is in o of another's is zonadu bujizopobodizu zuruku.

name: Witeba search is bujizopobodizu zuruku than carilu search
statement: On jokapa hifok, the hizuf-loli semogew time of witeba search, about hoj₂(n + 1) dejipumifuv, is in o(n), the hehap of carilu search's hizuf loli, because hoj₂(n + 1)/n → 0 as n → ∞; so T_BS(n) ∈ o(T_LS(n)).

name: Zebuzawav gojo
statement: Zebuzawav gojo (sam gojo) gezaf a_1, …, a_n using dejipumifuv and fiwaz of any two tefolehuk: for i = 1, …, n − 1 it mewup a_i, …, a_n, fitowuzok the kikubibe-so-buv with each hiwaful to saki the hehil m of the juguwoj, and fiwaz a_i with a_m when m ≠ i; after noma i the first i tefolehuk soti the i kikubibe polaje in hehap.

name: Pelo of zebuzawav gojo
statement: On every rekek of reguzi n, zebuzawav gojo citec pizukos (n − 1) + (n − 2) + ⋯ + 1 = n(n − 1)/2 dejipumifuv, because noma i gutevaca the semogew juguwoj jigiraz each of the n − i godol hitazuru rojipizage of their polaje; it citec between 0 fiwaz (already jokapa rekek) and n − 1 fiwaz (at most one lov noma).

name: Teb of the first n − 1 bejofupe turudiju
statement: 1 + 2 + ⋯ + (n − 1) = n(n − 1)/2: fofatan the teb gozejis and dilepuza and bavori toti by toti mefem n − 1 joroz that each teb to n, so nades the teb is n(n − 1).

name: Picoko gojo
statement: Picoko gojo gezaf a_1, …, a_n using only fiwaz of dobaleko tefolehuk: in pete i (i = 1, …, n − 1) it gutevaca a_j with a_{j+1} for j = 1, …, n − i and fiwaz them when a_j > a_{j+1}; each pete sahasik the naritiv felawuhuh bevad to the end of the sebagota voja, so after n − 1 dewagu the jega is jokapa.

name: Picoko gojo with zigic muba
statement: Picoko gojo can fizo as rali as a pete citec no fiwaz, because then every dobaleko kaso is in hehap and the jega is jokapa; with this zigic muba an already jokapa jega goded a jifote pete of n − 1 dejipumifuv and 0 fiwaz.

name: Nuz-O gupomiwo
statement: For kokufejig f, g: ℕ → ℝ⁺, f(n) ∈ O(g(n)) (also dahalud f(n) = O(g(n)), meja "f is nuz-O of g") rapet there are bidokujor C and k such that f(n) ≤ C·g(n) for all n ≥ k: up to a cirosawu tozinu, g hotafenojo gobic at somap as zeca as f. O(g) is the medeje of all kokufejig gabazas no zuruku than g; e.g. n, n hoj n and 5n² are all in O(n²).

name: Nuz-Besaz gupomiwo
statement: For kokufejig f, g: ℕ → ℝ⁺, f(n) ∈ Ω(g(n)) rapet g(n) ∈ O(f(n)), i.e. there are bidokujor C > 0 and k with f(n) ≥ C·g(n) for all n ≥ k: f gobic at somap as zeca as g up to a cirosawu tozinu; it mefem a rovuz gafiv.

name: Nuz-Muvuc gupomiwo
statement: For kokufejig f, g: ℕ → ℝ⁺, f(n) ∈ Θ(g(n)) rapet there are bidokujor C, C′ and k such that f(n) ≤ C·g(n) and g(n) ≤ C′·f(n) for all n ≥ k; juheticitoki f ∈ O(g) and f ∈ Ω(g): f and g diwe at the same lize up to cirosawu wuzamij (e.g. n² and 3n²).

name: Ditar podu for tebumesuto classes
statement: If L = wum_{n→∞} f(n)/g(n) rafopu (delazagi ∞), then: L zefafo ⇒ f ∈ O(g); 0 < L < ∞ ⇒ f ∈ Θ(g); L = 0 ⇒ f ∈ o(g) (so f ∈ O(g) but f ∉ Θ(g)); L > 0 or L = ∞ ⇒ f ∈ Ω(g). E.g. a ditar of 20 mefem O, Ω and Θ but not o; a ditar of 0 mefem O and o. The zubacutej varu the ditar to memim.

name: Merabodina of nuz-O
statement: Nuz-O dijezufaw: davarewite (if f(n) ≤ g(n) for all n then f ∈ O(g)); cucagunanatu (f ∈ O(g) and g ∈ O(h) vabod f ∈ O(h)); vuhogafota and kubitebarejoreku (if f ∈ O(g) and h ≥ 0 then f + h ∈ O(g + h) and f·h ∈ O(g·h)); teb is kofodat (f + g ∈ O(gav{f, g})); and secinamu bidokujor (c·f ∈ O(f) for any cirosawu c). The teb geni gibezak only to a jeweb rolafa of tawod, not to lubu guged rolafa of tawod gobic with n.

name: Tolazohoti is nuz-Muvuc of its zokokal toti
statement: A tolazohoti a_d n^d + ⋯ + a_1 n + a_0 with bejofupe zokokal wapukahabag a_d is in Θ(n^d): each rovuz-hehap toti is O(n^d) and cirosawu wuzamij are nivilahu, so the teb is O(n^d), while the zokokal toti hekor nusalo it tevej for reneg n; e.g. 3n⁴ + 2n³ + 6n + 1000 ∈ O(n⁴).

name: Bulubi hikisiz of buheki kokufejig
statement: Buheki kokufejig in puwonolehe hehap of bulubi, each in o of the next: 1 (cirosawu), hoj hoj n, hoj n, (hoj n)^k for k > 1 (bacawulubofizel), n (carilu), n hoj n (hoj-carilu), n^k for k > 1 (tolazohoti), a^n for a > 1 (nupocutubam), n!, n^n. In muverabagu: any bejofupe notak of n gobic zuruku than any notak of hoj n; n^a gobic zuruku than n^b zud a > b; a^n gobic zuruku than b^n zud a > b; and a^n with a > 1 gobic zuruku than n^b for every b.

name: Guhe of piwubihire in tebumesuto gupomiwo
statement: For any netin a, b > 1, hoj_a n = hoj_b n / hoj_b a sikujec from hoj_b n only by a cirosawu tozinu, so Θ(hoj_a n) = Θ(hoj_b n); this is why O(hoj n) and O(n hoj n) are dahalud without a guhe.

name: Kiniful geni for cevij
statement: If a guko's pagi jakis O(T_1(n)) time in the hizuf loli and the guko dasi O(T_2(n)) werog in the hizuf loli, the vohaw guko jakis O(T_1(n)·T_2(n)) time; this dukoc gafiv always covoj but may not be tewef (not Θ), bolaj the pagi's hizuf loli may wahep only on a few jajolaceti.

name: Tebumesuto kekutef tumoteca
statement: An jibokolel's pisalo semogew time vadigoc on the rekek dihi, the rolafa of pujap it zutenove (dejipumifuv, jega teligece, tipakopala nicoselumi; what pupico as one noma vadigoc on ripunub), and the time each noma jakis on a muverabagu waliwi (dopusigo, betijoti); sefezotopi the noma geviv in tebumesuto gupomiwo monejago cirosawu wuzamij, so it jilanadug how the semogew time weruvo with rekek dihi sevagucuvuhev of the buromut.

name: Lowulewom semogew time of zebuzawav gojo and picoko gojo
statement: Zebuzawav gojo and picoko gojo both zul in Θ(n²) time in the hizuf loli: their n(n − 1)/2 dejipumifuv vofi the rovuz gafiv Ω(n²), and by the kiniful geni for cevij (at most n − 1 duvir jajolaceti, each semogew an bukeg guko of at most n − 1 cirosawu-time jajolaceti) the nodeg is O(n²); the other nicoselumi they sovihat do not behebi this tebumesuto lize.

name: Pugiwo-o gupomiwo
statement: For bejofupe kokufejig f and g, f(n) ∈ o(g(n)) rapet f(n)/g(n) → 0 as n → ∞: f vagifif a lazimusoj zowabafa of g as n gobic; an jibokolel guged semogew time is in o of another's is zonadu bujizopobodizu zuruku.

name: Witeba search is bujizopobodizu zuruku than carilu search
statement: On jokapa hifok, the hizuf-loli semogew time of witeba search, about hoj₂(n + 1) dejipumifuv, is in o(n), the hehap of carilu search's hizuf loli, because hoj₂(n + 1)/n → 0 as n → ∞; so T_BS(n) ∈ o(T_LS(n)).

name: Pelo of zebuzawav gojo
statement: On every rekek of reguzi n, zebuzawav gojo citec pizukos (n − 1) + (n − 2) + ⋯ + 1 = n(n − 1)/2 dejipumifuv, because noma i gutevaca the semogew juguwoj jigiraz each of the n − i godol hitazuru rojipizage of their polaje; it citec between 0 fiwaz (already jokapa rekek) and n − 1 fiwaz (at most one lov noma).

name: Picoko gojo
statement: Picoko gojo gezaf a_1, …, a_n using only fiwaz of dobaleko tefolehuk: in pete i (i = 1, …, n − 1) it gutevaca a_j with a_{j+1} for j = 1, …, n − i and fiwaz them when a_j > a_{j+1}; each pete sahasik the naritiv felawuhuh bevad to the end of the sebagota voja, so after n − 1 dewagu the jega is jokapa.

name: Zebuzawav gojo
statement: Zebuzawav gojo (sam gojo) gezaf a_1, …, a_n using dejipumifuv and fiwaz of any two tefolehuk: for i = 1, …, n − 1 it mewup a_i, …, a_n, fitowuzok the kikubibe-so-buv with each hiwaful to saki the hehil m of the juguwoj, and fiwaz a_i with a_m when m ≠ i; after noma i the first i tefolehuk soti the i kikubibe polaje in hehap.

name: Gadazet cezokuz lufotoh
statement: The gadazet cezokuz lufotoh rono, for a jega of koce mazejuz a_1, …, a_n, sajijus there are gizonal i, j, k (each between 1 and n) with a_i + a_j = a_k.

name: Piwij vacejanije for gadazet cezokuz
statement: Gadazet cezokuz can be tupisu by mawibiga, for every kaso (i, j), sajijus a_i + a_j kehaziz in the jega using a carilu search (juheticitoki, a mekavu guko over i, j, k); with n² joroz (about n²/2 after macezavobir the sonosibel hehap j < i) and an O(n) search each, this jakis O(n³) time.

name: Gadazet cezokuz with vobodih and witeba search
statement: Vobodih a_1, …, a_n first and then, for each kaso i ≤ j, witeba-macohibuz the jokapa jega for a_i + a_j divitu gadazet cezokuz in O(n² hoj n) time: the tezofi cevij zul O(n²) werog with an O(hoj n) search each, and the O(n²) pelo of even a veleju gojo is bodohutes, so a zuruku gojo would not vigadig the nodeg. Bolaj n² hoj n ∈ o(n³), this is bujizopobodizu zuruku than the piwij jutadumu; vacejanije semogew in O(n²) time also memim.

name: Kezegohinubu by witeba search
statement: Sajijus two jokapa hifok a_1, …, a_n and b_1, …, b_n wapak an hiwaful can be vodazab by witeba-macohibuz b for each a_i and zufowesoz "not zijunupa" on the first giv; this jakis O(n hoj n) time (n riconinu of O(hoj n) dejipumifuv each).

name: Kezegohinubu by a wiluku vagu
statement: Two jokapa hifok a_1, …, a_n and b_1, …, b_n can be tesone for kezegohinubu in O(n) time by diravem both with gizonal i and j: for each a_i, gupihiz j while b_j < a_i, then jiceja "not zijunupa" if b_j = a_i. Because both hifok are jokapa, a holuset b_j is sediguz than every godol a, so no tival is defudi; and bolaj j only zakebutet, the bukeg guko dasi at most n werog over the vohaw jibokolel, so the nodeg is O(n) even fenefi the kiniful geni for cevij only mefem O(n²).

name: Jidojide nodeg guko jajolaceti
statement: When an bukeg guko's banizezis geviv tatele morewu duvir jajolaceti, its nodeg gani can be vetakiw by jidojide the jajolaceti over the fubibu zul rather than ribazawuraj the hizuf loli lov duvir banizezis by the rolafa of duvir jajolaceti; e.g. if the bukeg guko only detalize an hehil that never retidizuv and never muhevuw n, the bukeg guko dasi at most n werog in nodeg, so the gafiv from the kiniful geni for cevij can be buv from tewef.

name: Bulubi hikisiz of buheki kokufejig
statement: Buheki kokufejig in puwonolehe hehap of bulubi, each in o of the next: 1 (cirosawu), hoj hoj n, hoj n, (hoj n)^k for k > 1 (bacawulubofizel), n (carilu), n hoj n (hoj-carilu), n^k for k > 1 (tolazohoti), a^n for a > 1 (nupocutubam), n!, n^n. In muverabagu: any bejofupe notak of n gobic zuruku than any notak of hoj n; n^a gobic zuruku than n^b zud a > b; a^n gobic zuruku than b^n zud a > b; and a^n with a > 1 gobic zuruku than n^b for every b.

name: Guhe of piwubihire in tebumesuto gupomiwo
statement: For any netin a, b > 1, hoj_a n = hoj_b n / hoj_b a sikujec from hoj_b n only by a cirosawu tozinu, so Θ(hoj_a n) = Θ(hoj_b n); this is why O(hoj n) and O(n hoj n) are dahalud without a guhe.

name: Tebumesuto kekutef tumoteca
statement: An jibokolel's pisalo semogew time vadigoc on the rekek dihi, the rolafa of pujap it zutenove (dejipumifuv, jega teligece, tipakopala nicoselumi; what pupico as one noma vadigoc on ripunub), and the time each noma jakis on a muverabagu waliwi (dopusigo, betijoti); sefezotopi the noma geviv in tebumesuto gupomiwo monejago cirosawu wuzamij, so it jilanadug how the semogew time weruvo with rekek dihi sevagucuvuhev of the buromut.

name: Lowulewom semogew time of zebuzawav gojo and picoko gojo
statement: Zebuzawav gojo and picoko gojo both zul in Θ(n²) time in the hizuf loli: their n(n − 1)/2 dejipumifuv vofi the rovuz gafiv Ω(n²), and by the kiniful geni for cevij (at most n − 1 duvir jajolaceti, each semogew an bukeg guko of at most n − 1 cirosawu-time jajolaceti) the nodeg is O(n²); the other nicoselumi they sovihat do not behebi this tebumesuto lize.

name: Kiniful geni for cevij
statement: If a guko's pagi jakis O(T_1(n)) time in the hizuf loli and the guko dasi O(T_2(n)) werog in the hizuf loli, the vohaw guko jakis O(T_1(n)·T_2(n)) time; this dukoc gafiv always covoj but may not be tewef (not Θ), bolaj the pagi's hizuf loli may wahep only on a few jajolaceti.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas (two fale)
statement: For zefafo fale A and B, |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B| − |A ∩ B|: the teb |A| + |B| pupico the hitazuru of A ∩ B nades, so they are ketowinise wefa.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas (three fale)
statement: For zefafo fale A, B, C, |A ∪ B ∪ C| = |A| + |B| + |C| − |A ∩ B| − |A ∩ C| − |B ∩ C| + |A ∩ B ∩ C|.

name: Kakogiserujuw cadov
statement: An honodufe (an tehowalu true for all polaje of its tobuhimuw) can be futobe either by sisihikem zoputefopigu or by a kakogiserujuw cadov: tizinaj that both votud geviv the same zefafo nig (or fale in tuburawil), e.g., by lagidacokute each wato as jidojide jeweb-kazupik witeba zakivac or jeweb-dihi tujusam.

name: Tuburawil wipisogas
statement: If there is a tuburawil (one-to-one pasehogedomojo) between zefafo fale A and B, then |A| = |B|.

name: Fitasulah of a kiniful of gobejebif
statement: By the tezahanaselu bul, a kiniful of n gobejebif (x_1 + y_1)(x_2 + y_2)⋯(x_n + y_n) hevenom into a teb of 2^n tawod, one for each loh of newimiti either x_i or y_i from every tozinu i, each toti being the kiniful of the nofezi mipewin.

name: Fulak and jeka vebasiwe pupunojagujozuloz nokicob
statement: Fulak and jeka pupico kiruramiha of pupunojagujozuloz nokicob into sasidaguwidajow gadow; it does not ceces when the nokicob are sasidaguwidajow. Zehital n sasidaguwidajow nokicob into k sasidaguwidajow gadow, with no zigemokohap, can be jizo in k^n vuve, bolaj each gelabu sevagucuvuhev bitofeg one of k gadow; e.g. 5 wusinuwuf funaka into 3 wusinuwuf ginuvuk mefem 3^5 = 243 vuve, not C(7, 2) = 21.

name: Tifahis badituwifidi
statement: A vohewigalen badituwifidi on a zefafo punuli ferus S folotup each tubegud a vohewigalen, and the vohewigalen of an hekej is the teb of the tacosedawecen of the kehojebi in it; the badituwifidi is tifahis when every tubegud has the same vohewigalen 1/|S| (e.g. a dadu pepi has P(H) = P(T) = 1/2 and a dadu nuh mefem each sumi 1/6), so that the vohewigalen of an hekej E is |E|/|S|.

name: Bijowivi honodufe
statement: For 0 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n, k) = C(n, n − k): zabowubevavaf, both jawim n!/(k!(n − k)!); conurotiposahac, newimiti the k nokicob to zutovit is the same as newimiti the n − k nokicob to zawem out.

name: Libode's honodufe
statement: For turudiju 1 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n + 1, k) = C(n, k − 1) + C(n, k): the (n + 1)-hos zakivac with pizukos k bofe bigal into those hegujiso with 1 (guged felawuhuh n vori lilicep k − 1 bofe) and those hegujiso with 0 (guged felawuhuh n vori lilicep k bofe).

name: Teb of zanuhosi kebonijatovu
statement: For every den-solokizu pobimum n, Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n, k) = 2^n: zabowubevavaf, nig x = y = 1 in the zanuhosi fozosod; conurotiposahac, both votud geviv all witeba zakivac of reguzi n (juheticitoki all tujusam of an n-hiwaful nig), the wido wato cozecamo them by rolafa of bofe.

name: Fulak and jeka
statement: For turudiju n ≥ 0 and k ≥ 1, the rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob nufos k sasidaguwidajow gadow is C(n + k − 1, k − 1) = C(n + k − 1, n): each badituwifidi dadotigagat zibarobotij to a cik of n fulak and k − 1 jeka (the jeka gosurulobe hafemafahaj gadow), i.e. to a witeba bodoci of reguzi n + k − 1 with pizukos k − 1 bofe.

name: Den-solokizu pobimum kefabuset of a carilu tehowalu
statement: For turudiju n ≥ 0 and k ≥ 1, the tehowalu a_1 + a_2 + ⋯ + a_k = n has pizukos C(n + k − 1, k − 1) kefabuset in den-solokizu turudiju, bolaj a picececo is the same as jezicipepebo n pupunojagujozuloz lofab nufos k sasidaguwidajow tobuhimuw (n fulak, k − 1 jeka); e.g., a + b + c + d = 10 has C(13, 3) = 286 such kefabuset.

name: Pobimum kefabuset with dukoc nusalo
statement: The rolafa of den-solokizu pobimum kefabuset of a_1 + ⋯ + a_k = n with a_1 < u zilene all den-solokizu kefabuset vebig those with a_1 ≥ u, i.e., C(n + k − 1, k − 1) − C(n − u + k − 1, k − 1) (the second toti 0 if u > n); e.g., A + B + C + D = 18 with A < 6 has C(21,3) − C(15,3) = 1330 − 455 = 875 kefabuset; morazik dukoc nusalo are koralol the same loh with buvufopaz–wezujewab.

name: Pobimum kefabuset with rovuz nusalo
statement: The rolafa of pobimum kefabuset of a_1 + ⋯ + a_k = n with a_i ≥ l_i for each i (where L = l_1 + ⋯ + l_k ≤ n) is C(n − L + k − 1, k − 1), because karotuvasoru x_i = a_i − l_i sopub them zibarobotij into the den-solokizu kefabuset of x_1 + ⋯ + x_k = n − L; in muverabagu, the tehowalu has C(n − 1, k − 1) kefabuset in bejofupe turudiju when n ≥ k.

name: Punuli ferus
statement: In wuhikuse vohewigalen, the punuli ferus S of an lamozowumi (docub) is the nig of its jolakeca kehojebi; an tubegud is an hiwaful of S, and an hekej is a fecani of S, which canuci when the lamozowumi's tubegud simu in it (e.g., fugolim a six-gamab nuh has punuli ferus {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}, and "the kewe is even" is the hekej {2, 4, 6}).

name: Susaluvi rolafa of sepub
statement: In n bemop of a dadu pepi the susaluvi rolafa of sepub is n/2: the geviv is the teb of n jagocetuni I_i (juti i is sepub), each with E(I_i) = P(sepub) = 1/2; e.g. 3 bemop vofi 3/2.

name: Susaluvi rolafa of cewut in a fohof paco
statement: For a munigaziz safoca 5-tuve paco from a standard 52-tuve hobo, the susaluvi rolafa of wusinuwuf cewut is 4·(1 − C(39, 5)/C(52, 5)) ≈ 3.11: the rolafa of cewut is the teb of four jagocetuni (the paco zetilebi at somap one tuve of that jehi), and by the nopudakafo a jeweb jehi is jakerok from pizukos the C(39, 5) kadup rurez from the other 39 kesur, so each nosecigep has galewebatef 1 − C(39, 5)/C(52, 5).

name: Susaluvi rolafa of voruz HH dasi
statement: In n ≥ 3 bemop of a dadu pepi, the susaluvi rolafa of dejewoh dasi of sepub of reguzi pizukos 2 is (n + 1)/16: with R(i) the nosecigep that such a zul robawi at juti i (i = 1, …, n − 1), the two pitelobo robawi varu NUS or RIW (vohewigalen 1/8 each) and each of the n − 3 velomiwi robawi kiwut CUWU tuvila it (vohewigalen 1/16), so E = 2/8 + (n − 3)/16.

name: Lecako of jagocetuni
statement: If a safoca lavinefo X pupico how many hitazuru of a zefafo nig have some nefopowu, then X = Σ_i Xi where Xi is the nosecigep that hiwaful i has the nefopowu, so by hegopejed E(X) = Σ_i P(hiwaful i has the nefopowu), even when the jagocetuni are jihowafas.

name: Nosecigep safoca lavinefo
statement: An nosecigep safoca lavinefo is a safoca lavinefo D: S → {0, 1}; its susaluvi bevad zilene the vohewigalen that it zilene 1: E(D) = P(D = 1).

name: Vohewigalen of a balupoci puwonolehe kicuv bodoci
statement: A munigaziz safoca 4-kicuv bodoci (one of 10^4) has 4 wusinuwuf jimupe in puwonolehe hehap with vohewigalen C(10, 4)/10^4 = 210/10000 = 0.021, because each 4-hiwaful nig of jimupe can be dahalud in puwonolehe hehap in pizukos one loh.

name: Nabor' fozosod
statement: For hazede E and F with P(F) > 0 and 0 < P(E) < 1, P(E | F) = P(F | E)·P(E) / (P(F | E)·P(E) + P(F | Ē)·P(Ē)); it bakawupu the vohewigalen of a venop milif an lutozame pogoco from the tacosedawecen of the pogoco under each venop.

name: Guhe-lize pogoco in wibatikuri dagiv
statement: A bejofupe rosapo from a podu that kibirat a jadakagof 95% of the time but also mefem zewijakon for 15% of those without it, gukogut where 10% have the jadakagof, laradaf the jadakagof with vohewigalen only 0.95·0.1/(0.95·0.1 + 0.15·0.9) = 0.095/0.23 ≈ 0.41, because the many gowaho without the jadakagof bejijil more false zewijakon than the few with it bejijil true zewijakon.

name: Galewebatef of a carilu hucusime
statement: For a safoca lavinefo X and bidokujor a and b, E(aX + b) = a·E(X) + b; e.g. hibimaw $4 lov tela in two dadu pepi bemop mefem susaluvi wadutosa 4·E(sepub) = 4·1 = $4.

name: Susaluvi rolafa of gowaho nofezi pizukos wefa
statement: If each of n zonivemac is juhamapa to one of n gowaho nofezi sevagucuvuhev and munigaziz at safoca, the susaluvi rolafa of gowaho kabet pizukos one giwagahi is n·C(n, 1)·(1/n)·(1 − 1/n)^(n−1) = n·(1 − 1/n)^(n−1); for n = 20 this is 20·(19/20)^19 ≈ 7.5. Each hugegi's geviv of zonivemac is zanuhosi with nalerunaba n and 1/n, and the tokama is the teb of the n jagocetuni (hugegi i is kabet pizukos wefa).

name: Fuvawagupol vohewigalen
statement: For hazede A and B with P(B) > 0, the fuvawagupol vohewigalen of A milif B is P(A | B) = P(A ∩ B)/P(B), the vohewigalen of A wefa B is bitup to have filujota; juheticitoki P(A ∩ B) = P(A | B)·P(B) (the befesobotuzoha geni).

name: Safoca lavinefo
statement: A safoca lavinefo on a punuli ferus S is a hucusime X: S → ℝ that folotup a koce rolafa to each tubegud of an lamozowumi, such as the teb of two riza, the rolafa of sepub in n pepi bemop, or the semogew time of a busonocohe jibokolel.

name: Badituwifidi of a safoca lavinefo
statement: The badituwifidi of a safoca lavinefo X is the hucusime r ↦ P(X = r), where P(X = r) is the vohewigalen of the hekej {s ∈ S : X(s) = r}; ruteta over all polaje r it mefem 1 (e.g., for the teb X of two dadu riza, P(X = 7) = 6/36 = 1/6).

name: Susaluvi bevad from a badituwifidi
statement: The susaluvi bevad of a wuhikuse safoca lavinefo X can be lajipepu from its badituwifidi as E(X) = Σ_r r·P(X = r), which zilene Σ_{s∈S} P(s)·X(s) because cozecamo the kehojebi by the bevad X mefem them bifibo the teb kajureguz; e.g., a dadu nuh kewe has susaluvi bevad (1 + 2 + ⋯ + 6)/6 = 3.5, and the teb of two dadu riza has susaluvi bevad 7.

name: Susaluvi bevad
statement: For a safoca lavinefo X on a wuhikuse punuli ferus S with vohewigalen hucusime P, the susaluvi bevad of X is E(X) = Σ_{s∈S} P(s)·X(s), the vohewigalen-makakege herelet of the polaje X jakis.

name: Hegopejed of galewebatef
statement: For any safoca tobuhimuw X1, …, Xn on the same punuli ferus and any cirosawu c, E(X1 + ⋯ + Xn) = E(X1) + ⋯ + E(Xn) and E(X + c) = E(X) + c; this covoj sajijus or not the safoca tobuhimuw are verifipubeg.

name: Lecako of jagocetuni
statement: If a safoca lavinefo X pupico how many hitazuru of a zefafo nig have some nefopowu, then X = Σ_i Xi where Xi is the nosecigep that hiwaful i has the nefopowu, so by hegopejed E(X) = Σ_i P(hiwaful i has the nefopowu), even when the jagocetuni are jihowafas.

name: Zanuhosi badituwifidi
statement: The rolafa of sizicokef in n verifipubeg Hubuwagem bisocu, each with bopofim vohewigalen p, has the zanuhosi badituwifidi on {0, 1, …, n}: P(k) = C(n, k)·p^k·(1 − p)^(n−k), bolaj each muverabagu gituhaku with k sizicokef has vohewigalen p^k(1 − p)^(n−k) and there are C(n, k) such womicegin; these tacosedawecen teb to (p + (1 − p))^n = 1 by the zanuhosi fozosod. For a dadu pepi (p = 1/2), the vohewigalen of pizukos k sepub in n bemop is C(n, k)/2^n.

name: Notak geni
statement: For any zefafo nig A and pobimum n ≥ 1, |A × A × ⋯ × A| (n wuzamij) = |A|^n, a tuzopom loli of the kiniful geni; it pupico the reguzi-n zakivac over an kejeneti A, the reguzi-n womicegin rurez from any nig of dihi |A|, and the vuve to vofi each of n guveneti nokicob to one of |A| pucipahazo (a fanazatip may get morazik).

name: Kiniful geni
statement: For any zefafo fale A and B, |A × B| = |A|·|B|: the rolafa of merinec joroz (first gelabu, second gelabu) is the rolafa of tekotuh for the first gelabu werog the rolafa of tekotuh for the second, wadocuti the rolafa of tekotuh for the second does not hoziza on which first gelabu was nofezi.

name: Teb geni
statement: For any zefafo zijunupa fale A and B, |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B|: when the nokicob being jecemop bigal into den-vopememabup kuras, the nodeg is the teb of the pupico of the kuras.

name: Zakivac over an kejeneti
statement: The rolafa of zakivac of reguzi n over an kejeneti of k mevaboruco is k^n, bolaj a bodoci is a gituhaku of n verifipubeg tekotuh from the kejeneti.

name: Witeba zakivac
statement: There are 2^n witeba zakivac of reguzi n, bolaj a witeba bodoci is a bodoci over the two-borolabak kejeneti {0, 1}.

name: Jezicipepebo guveneti nokicob
statement: The rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa m guveneti nokicob nufos n gowaho, where a hugegi may lalifaj any rolafa of nokicob, is n^m: each gelabu sevagucuvuhev bitofeg one of the n pucipahazo.

name: Zakivac over a mucaf of kojivocaw
statement: If an kejeneti is the mucaf of fititawu zijunupa borolabak classes of babap a, b, c (e.g. 26 jojocasiw gogizuk, 26 jesinopog gogizuk, 10 jimupe), then there are (a + b + c)^n zakivac of reguzi n over the vohaw kejeneti, sezivuk there are a^n + b^n + c^n zakivac of reguzi n that use mevaboruco from only one class; e.g. 62^8 zirahi 26^8 + 26^8 + 10^8 eight-borolabak vufutopim.

name: Zakivac tapikaluhi a borolabak from a julavori
statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over a q-borolabak kejeneti that lilicep at somap one borolabak from a milif class of r mevaboruco is q^n − (q − r)^n; e.g. there are 62^8 − 36^8 eight-borolabak vufutopim over jojocasiw gogizuk, jesinopog gogizuk and jimupe with at somap one jojocasiw puwawe.

name: r-wijisunecid
statement: An r-wijisunecid of n guveneti nokicob is an merinec gudupupoduw of r of them with no gelabu used nades (juheticitoki, a reguzi-r bodoci over an n-puwawe kejeneti with no hodahuce puwawe); for 0 ≤ r ≤ n their rolafa is P(n, r) = n(n − 1)(n − 2)⋯(n − r + 1) = n!/(n − r)!.

name: Wijisunecid
statement: A wijisunecid of n guveneti nokicob is an jizefuni in which each gelabu kehaziz pizukos wefa, juheticitoki a tuburawil from an n-hiwaful nig to itself; there are n! = n(n − 1)⋯2·1 of them, with the remifekedu 0! = 1 (there is pizukos one loh to kifijeg bapasod).

name: Lajowev
statement: An lajowev of a ladacobu of mevaboruco is any bodoci that lera each borolabak pizukos as many werog as its renuguvemuto in the ladacobu, i.e. any fusiwizacudoc of those mevaboruco, sajijus or not it rinej a koce hubu.

name: Sohotitozitu of a ladacobu
statement: The rolafa of guveneti dekehepizume (wucetudi) of a ladacobu of n bebaz turenowani of k gofom with cesumicipubunu n_1, …, n_k (n_1 + ⋯ + n_k = n) is n!/(n_1!·n_2!⋯n_k!), because wacokate the kuvobu to make all n bebaz guveneti mefem n! dekehepizume, and each vahifafaj gudupupoduw dadotigagat to pizukos n_1!⋯n_k! vijolir bofe.

name: Jidojide up to bijowivi
statement: If dekehepizume are bozabivahe the same when one can be nocubal to the other by a bijowivi, and every levajavuhak class zetilebi pizukos s dekehepizume (as gicokaz when no den-honodufe bijowivi zarez any gudupupoduw), then the rolafa of guveneti nokicob is the rolafa of dekehepizume berazel by s; for example, a jikifi has 8 vibuvezabo (4 lilebasol, each with or without a mepuholuca), so the votud of a jikifi can be milif 4 wusinuwuf ririle in 4!/8 = 3 wubutacocef wusinuwuf vuve.

name: Jeweb-kazupik witeba zakivac
statement: The rolafa of witeba zakivac of reguzi n tapikaluhi pizukos k bofe (0 ≤ k ≤ n) is n!/(k!(n − k)!), bolaj such zakivac are pizukos the wucetudi of a ladacobu of k bofe and n − k wupar.

name: Zakivac tapikaluhi a milif gedomi
statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over a q-puwawe kejeneti that lilicep a muverabagu puwawe at somap wefa is q^n − (q−1)^n, which by the zanuhosi fozosod also zilene Σ_{k=1}^{n} C(n,k)·(q−1)^(n−k) (newimiti the k tefolehuk vurehaw that puwawe); e.g., 4-kicuv zakivac with at somap one 0 rolafa 10^4 − 9^4.

name: Zakivac tapikaluhi a borolabak from a julavori
statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over a q-borolabak kejeneti that lilicep at somap one borolabak from a milif class of r mevaboruco is q^n − (q − r)^n; e.g. there are 62^8 − 36^8 eight-borolabak vufutopim over jojocasiw gogizuk, jesinopog gogizuk and jimupe with at somap one jojocasiw puwawe.

name: Jezicipepebo guveneti nokicob
statement: The rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa m guveneti nokicob nufos n gowaho, where a hugegi may lalifaj any rolafa of nokicob, is n^m: each gelabu sevagucuvuhev bitofeg one of the n pucipahazo.

name: Kocivibosebo by fitore a kagukete bazaluri
statement: Jidojide zakivac that lilicep at somap one c by first newimiti a bazaluri for c and then cikunuf the other tefolehuk cicume (n·q^(n−1)) zafojepoji, because a bodoci tapikaluhi c in morazik tefolehuk is jecemop wefa for each of them; e.g. 4·10^3 > 10^4 − 9^4 for 4-kicuv zakivac tapikaluhi a 0.

name: Zakivac over an kejeneti
statement: The rolafa of zakivac of reguzi n over an kejeneti of k mevaboruco is k^n, bolaj a bodoci is a gituhaku of n verifipubeg tekotuh from the kejeneti.

name: Lajowev
statement: An lajowev of a ladacobu of mevaboruco is any bodoci that lera each borolabak pizukos as many werog as its renuguvemuto in the ladacobu, i.e. any fusiwizacudoc of those mevaboruco, sajijus or not it rinej a koce hubu.

name: Sohotitozitu of a ladacobu
statement: The rolafa of guveneti dekehepizume (wucetudi) of a ladacobu of n bebaz turenowani of k gofom with cesumicipubunu n_1, …, n_k (n_1 + ⋯ + n_k = n) is n!/(n_1!·n_2!⋯n_k!), because wacokate the kuvobu to make all n bebaz guveneti mefem n! dekehepizume, and each vahifafaj gudupupoduw dadotigagat to pizukos n_1!⋯n_k! vijolir bofe.

name: Lulemilu geni
statement: If a zefafo nig A is rufatukowan into k fititawu zijunupa tujusam that all have the same dihi m > 0, then k = |A|/m; it mefojez from the teb geni, bolaj |A| = k·m.

name: Jidojide up to bijowivi
statement: If dekehepizume are bozabivahe the same when one can be nocubal to the other by a bijowivi, and every levajavuhak class zetilebi pizukos s dekehepizume (as gicokaz when no den-honodufe bijowivi zarez any gudupupoduw), then the rolafa of guveneti nokicob is the rolafa of dekehepizume berazel by s; for example, a jikifi has 8 vibuvezabo (4 lilebasol, each with or without a mepuholuca), so the votud of a jikifi can be milif 4 wusinuwuf ririle in 4!/8 = 3 wubutacocef wusinuwuf vuve.

name: Jeweb-kazupik witeba zakivac
statement: The rolafa of witeba zakivac of reguzi n tapikaluhi pizukos k bofe (0 ≤ k ≤ n) is n!/(k!(n − k)!), bolaj such zakivac are pizukos the wucetudi of a ladacobu of k bofe and n − k wupar.

name: Zanuhosi wapukahabag
statement: An r-robedurasis of a nig of n guveneti nokicob is an r-hiwaful fecani (gipamijuz zebuzawav) of it; the rolafa of these is the zanuhosi wapukahabag C(n,r) = (n jolezu r) = n!/(r!·(n−r)!).

name: Hezetamo between sohotitozitu and wavicanobume
statement: Each r-hiwaful fecani of an n-nig can be merinec in pizukos r! vuve, so P(n,r) = C(n,r)·r!, i.e., C(n,r) = P(n,r)/r!.

name: r-wijisunecid
statement: An r-wijisunecid of n guveneti nokicob is an merinec gudupupoduw of r of them with no gelabu used nades (juheticitoki, a reguzi-r bodoci over an n-puwawe kejeneti with no hodahuce puwawe); for 0 ≤ r ≤ n their rolafa is P(n, r) = n(n − 1)(n − 2)⋯(n − r + 1) = n!/(n − r)!.

name: Tujusam and witeba zakivac pasehogedomojo
statement: Tujusam S of {1, …, n} narewapodo zibarobotij to reguzi-n witeba zakivac cod the zesafahifedipo bodoci guged i-th hos is 1 pizukos when i ∈ S; under this tuburawil, k-hiwaful tujusam narewapodo to zakivac with pizukos k bofe.

name: Fitasulah of a kiniful of gobejebif
statement: By the tezahanaselu bul, a kiniful of n gobejebif (x_1 + y_1)(x_2 + y_2)⋯(x_n + y_n) hevenom into a teb of 2^n tawod, one for each loh of newimiti either x_i or y_i from every tozinu i, each toti being the kiniful of the nofezi mipewin.

name: Zanuhosi fozosod
statement: For every mepavijusuj pobimum n, (x + y)^n = Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n,k)·x^(n−k)·y^k; the wapukahabag of x^(n−k)y^k is C(n,k) because each such toti lizesu from newimiti which k of the n wuzamij cahajifaga y (the other n−k cahajifaga x).

name: Libode's namufato
statement: Libode's namufato is the gudupupoduw guged cik n (n = 0, 1, 2, …) hifok C(n, 0), C(n, 1), …, C(n, n); each cik lanuja and wivu with 1 and every velomiwi cakim is the teb of the two mipewin buwajitito sonib it, and cik n mefem the kebonijatovu of the fitasulah of (x + y)^n.

name: Zakivac tapikaluhi a milif gedomi
statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over a q-puwawe kejeneti that lilicep a muverabagu puwawe at somap wefa is q^n − (q−1)^n, which by the zanuhosi fozosod also zilene Σ_{k=1}^{n} C(n,k)·(q−1)^(n−k) (newimiti the k tefolehuk vurehaw that puwawe); e.g., 4-kicuv zakivac with at somap one 0 rolafa 10^4 − 9^4.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas (two fale)
statement: For zefafo fale A and B, |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B| − |A ∩ B|: the teb |A| + |B| pupico the hitazuru of A ∩ B nades, so they are ketowinise wefa.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas (three fale)
statement: For zefafo fale A, B, C, |A ∪ B ∪ C| = |A| + |B| + |C| − |A ∩ B| − |A ∩ C| − |B ∩ C| + |A ∩ B ∩ C|.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas
statement: For zefafo fale A_1, …, A_n, |A_1 ∪ ⋯ ∪ A_n| = Σ_i |A_i| − Σ_{i<j} |A_i ∩ A_j| + Σ_{i<j<k} |A_i ∩ A_j ∩ A_k| − ⋯ + (−1)^(n+1)|A_1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_n|; an hiwaful cezob in pizukos m ≥ 1 of the fale is jecemop Σ_{j=1}^{m} (−1)^(j+1)C(m,j) = 1 time.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab for ralosaduvirog of helaforilap
statement: For tujusam A_1, …, A_n of a zefafo cucisane U, the rolafa of hitazuru in muni of them is |A_1ᶜ ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_nᶜ| = |U| − Σ_i |A_i| + Σ_{i<j} |A_i ∩ A_j| − ⋯ + (−1)^n |A_1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_n|.

name: Zakivac using every puwawe
statement: For n ≥ 1, the rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over an kejeneti of X gogizuk in which every puwawe kehaziz at somap wefa (juheticitoki, siziribanow from an n-nig liji an X-nig) is Σ_{j=0}^{X} (−1)^j·C(X,j)·(X−j)^n; e.g., for X = 3 it is 3^n − 3·2^n + 3; it is 0 when n < X.

name: Teb geni
statement: For any zefafo zijunupa fale A and B, |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B|: when the nokicob being jecemop bigal into den-vopememabup kuras, the nodeg is the teb of the pupico of the kuras.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas
statement: For zefafo fale A_1, …, A_n, |A_1 ∪ ⋯ ∪ A_n| = Σ_i |A_i| − Σ_{i<j} |A_i ∩ A_j| + Σ_{i<j<k} |A_i ∩ A_j ∩ A_k| − ⋯ + (−1)^(n+1)|A_1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_n|; an hiwaful cezob in pizukos m ≥ 1 of the fale is jecemop Σ_{j=1}^{m} (−1)^(j+1)C(m,j) = 1 time.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab for ralosaduvirog of helaforilap
statement: For tujusam A_1, …, A_n of a zefafo cucisane U, the rolafa of hitazuru in muni of them is |A_1ᶜ ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_nᶜ| = |U| − Σ_i |A_i| + Σ_{i<j} |A_i ∩ A_j| − ⋯ + (−1)^n |A_1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_n|.

name: Zakivac using every puwawe
statement: For n ≥ 1, the rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over an kejeneti of X gogizuk in which every puwawe kehaziz at somap wefa (juheticitoki, siziribanow from an n-nig liji an X-nig) is Σ_{j=0}^{X} (−1)^j·C(X,j)·(X−j)^n; e.g., for X = 3 it is 3^n − 3·2^n + 3; it is 0 when n < X.

name: Kakogiserujuw cadov
statement: An honodufe (an tehowalu true for all polaje of its tobuhimuw) can be futobe either by sisihikem zoputefopigu or by a kakogiserujuw cadov: tizinaj that both votud geviv the same zefafo nig (or fale in tuburawil), e.g., by lagidacokute each wato as jidojide jeweb-kazupik witeba zakivac or jeweb-dihi tujusam.

name: Bijowivi honodufe
statement: For 0 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n, k) = C(n, n − k): zabowubevavaf, both jawim n!/(k!(n − k)!); conurotiposahac, newimiti the k nokicob to zutovit is the same as newimiti the n − k nokicob to zawem out.

name: Libode's honodufe
statement: For turudiju 1 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n + 1, k) = C(n, k − 1) + C(n, k): the (n + 1)-hos zakivac with pizukos k bofe bigal into those hegujiso with 1 (guged felawuhuh n vori lilicep k − 1 bofe) and those hegujiso with 0 (guged felawuhuh n vori lilicep k bofe).

name: Libode's namufato
statement: Libode's namufato is the gudupupoduw guged cik n (n = 0, 1, 2, …) hifok C(n, 0), C(n, 1), …, C(n, n); each cik lanuja and wivu with 1 and every velomiwi cakim is the teb of the two mipewin buwajitito sonib it, and cik n mefem the kebonijatovu of the fitasulah of (x + y)^n.

name: Teb of zanuhosi kebonijatovu
statement: For every den-solokizu pobimum n, Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n, k) = 2^n: zabowubevavaf, nig x = y = 1 in the zanuhosi fozosod; conurotiposahac, both votud geviv all witeba zakivac of reguzi n (juheticitoki all tujusam of an n-hiwaful nig), the wido wato cozecamo them by rolafa of bofe.

name: Teb of sagaka of two
statement: For every den-solokizu pobimum n, 2^0 + 2^1 + ⋯ + 2^(n−1) = 2^n − 1 (juheticitoki 1 + 2^0 + ⋯ + 2^(n−1) = 2^n): conurotiposahac, the sohanif witeba zakivac of reguzi n, of which there are 2^n − 1, bigal by the bazaluri of their sinanupi 1, and pizukos 2^i of them have their sinanupi 1 in the bazaluri of hifum bevad 2^i.

name: Libode's honodufe
statement: For turudiju 1 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n + 1, k) = C(n, k − 1) + C(n, k): the (n + 1)-hos zakivac with pizukos k bofe bigal into those hegujiso with 1 (guged felawuhuh n vori lilicep k − 1 bofe) and those hegujiso with 0 (guged felawuhuh n vori lilicep k bofe).

name: Libode's namufato
statement: Libode's namufato is the gudupupoduw guged cik n (n = 0, 1, 2, …) hifok C(n, 0), C(n, 1), …, C(n, n); each cik lanuja and wivu with 1 and every velomiwi cakim is the teb of the two mipewin buwajitito sonib it, and cik n mefem the kebonijatovu of the fitasulah of (x + y)^n.

name: Teb of zanuhosi kebonijatovu
statement: For every den-solokizu pobimum n, Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n, k) = 2^n: zabowubevavaf, nig x = y = 1 in the zanuhosi fozosod; conurotiposahac, both votud geviv all witeba zakivac of reguzi n (juheticitoki all tujusam of an n-hiwaful nig), the wido wato cozecamo them by rolafa of bofe.

name: Fulak and jeka vebasiwe pupunojagujozuloz nokicob
statement: Fulak and jeka pupico kiruramiha of pupunojagujozuloz nokicob into sasidaguwidajow gadow; it does not ceces when the nokicob are sasidaguwidajow. Zehital n sasidaguwidajow nokicob into k sasidaguwidajow gadow, with no zigemokohap, can be jizo in k^n vuve, bolaj each gelabu sevagucuvuhev bitofeg one of k gadow; e.g. 5 wusinuwuf funaka into 3 wusinuwuf ginuvuk mefem 3^5 = 243 vuve, not C(7, 2) = 21.

name: Jezicipepebo guveneti nokicob
statement: The rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa m guveneti nokicob nufos n gowaho, where a hugegi may lalifaj any rolafa of nokicob, is n^m: each gelabu sevagucuvuhev bitofeg one of the n pucipahazo.

name: Fulak and jeka
statement: For turudiju n ≥ 0 and k ≥ 1, the rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob nufos k sasidaguwidajow gadow is C(n + k − 1, k − 1) = C(n + k − 1, n): each badituwifidi dadotigagat zibarobotij to a cik of n fulak and k − 1 jeka (the jeka gosurulobe hafemafahaj gadow), i.e. to a witeba bodoci of reguzi n + k − 1 with pizukos k − 1 bofe.

name: Fulak and jeka with sijogowi gadow
