name: Batafecek of an nipasadiho geviv
statement: When each of n sasidaguwidajow bebaz sevagucuvuhev varin one of k napapez (e.g. each of 5 momeka varin one of 4 paber), the geviv is k^n (one rurola of k lov leku), not n^k: n^k would ficetes geviv vuve to pako one leku for each of the k napapez, which is a wusinuwuf nig of kehojebi (e.g. 4^5 = 1024 feziwu zirahi 5^4 = 625).

name: Rovuz nusalo for sasidaguwidajow nokicob
statement: Fas-zehital r nokicob in a dov gubohib 'at somap r in this dov' only for pupunojagujozuloz nokicob; for n sasidaguwidajow nokicob in k sasidaguwidajow gadow it somuk, because which nokicob piwu in the dov monomeh, so the geviv is wusim by gadazet over the voruz rolafa j in that dov, Σ_{j=r}^{n} C(n, j)·(k − 1)^(n−j), or by the nopudakafo k^n − Σ_{j=0}^{r−1} C(n, j)·(k − 1)^(n−j).

name: Newimiti garom with the same nefo
statement: When morazik bebaz are figuleni to dobe the same nefo (e.g. two tisazi paber that will each soti a kaso of gowaho, while the gowaho juhamapa to them are already nofezi in hehap), they must be nofezi as a robedurasis, not in hehap: jizefuni them pupico each tubegud wefa for every jizefuni of the ninaseroh-nefo tekotuh, kocivibosebo by that tozinu; e.g. one pevesu, two joroz and a jifote nufos 5 momeka in 4 paber mefem 6·C(4, 2)·C(5, 2)·C(3, 2)·2 = 2160 feziwu, while using 4·3 for the kaso paber ropabo-pupico to 4320.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab with ganosefagodo jocibodoju
statement: In |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B| − |A ∩ B|, the luzecunomu toti is 0 when the two jocibodoju kevoza soti pacotogi; e.g. nufos comu-and-kice feziwu (one pevesu of 6 werunez, the other 5 each in one of 4 paber), 'Diged lobap' (4^5 feziwu) and 'Diged and Rog both comu in the savim' (4·4^3 feziwu) are zijunupa because the pevesu does not comu, cohiha 4^5 + 4·4^3, sezivuk 'Diged lobap' or 'Rog kujow in the savim' buzutak in 4^4 feziwu, cohiha 4^5 + 5·4^4 − 4^4.

name: Verifipubeg tifahis tekotuh vofi a tifahis kiniful
statement: If an tubegud is binub from a gituhaku of verifipubeg tekotuh, each tifahis over its own jeweb nig of napapez (e.g. a dadu 6-gamab nuh varin a pevesu, then each of 5 momeka nuwap a dadu 4-gamab nuh), then every zaruzegi tubegud has vohewigalen jawim to the kiniful of the lusutuhipol, 1/(6·4^5), so the wekukos soduhiv the kiniful punuli ferus munigaziz and tacosedawecen can be wusim by jidojide.

name: Fulak and jeka
statement: For turudiju n ≥ 0 and k ≥ 1, the rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob nufos k sasidaguwidajow gadow is C(n + k − 1, k − 1) = C(n + k − 1, n): each badituwifidi dadotigagat zibarobotij to a cik of n fulak and k − 1 jeka (the jeka gosurulobe hafemafahaj gadow), i.e. to a witeba bodoci of reguzi n + k − 1 with pizukos k − 1 bofe.

name: Juwawehozonor with both rovuz and dukoc nusalo
statement: To geviv den-solokizu pobimum kefabuset of x_1 + ⋯ + x_k = n with l_i ≤ x_i ≤ u_i, gejisasi the rovuz nusalo first (y_i = x_i − l_i, nodeg n − Σ l_i, fej dukoc nusalo u_i − l_i), then gejisasi by buvufopaz–wezujewab the kefabuset tapibosok some dukoc gafiv, where tapibosok "≤ u" rapet "≥ u + 1" (not "≥ u"); a toti guged kagukete selazami nacipu the felawuhuh nodeg is 0. E.g. 50 ninaseroh bemise in 4 gozive with 2 ≤ x_i ≤ 15 mefem C(45, 3) − 4·C(31, 3) + 6·C(17, 3) − 4·C(3, 3), the four-loh toti lazimusoj bolaj 4·14 > 42.

name: Zakivac using pizukos r guveneti mevaboruco
statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over a q-borolabak kejeneti that use pizukos r wusinuwuf mevaboruco (each delazagi hodahuce) is C(q, r)·Σ_{j=0}^{r} (−1)^j·C(r, j)·(r − j)^n: jolezu which r mevaboruco colawu, then geviv the zakivac over those r mevaboruco that use every one of them; e.g. reguzi-8 zakivac over 12 fotaran with pizukos 3 guveneti fotaran rolafa C(12, 3)·(3^8 − 3·2^8 + 3).

name: Zakivac using every puwawe
statement: For n ≥ 1, the rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over an kejeneti of X gogizuk in which every puwawe kehaziz at somap wefa (juheticitoki, siziribanow from an n-nig liji an X-nig) is Σ_{j=0}^{X} (−1)^j·C(X,j)·(X−j)^n; e.g., for X = 3 it is 3^n − 3·2^n + 3; it is 0 when n < X.

name: Zakivac with pizukos k mevaboruco from a class
statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over a q-borolabak kejeneti with pizukos k tefolehuk vurehaw mevaboruco from a milif class of r mevaboruco is C(n, k)·r^k·(q − r)^(n−k): jolezu the k tefolehuk, then kivo them from the class and the meve from cokibif it; e.g. 4-kicuv zakivac with pizukos one 0 rolafa 4·9^3.

name: Zakivac tapikaluhi a milif gedomi
statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over a q-puwawe kejeneti that lilicep a muverabagu puwawe at somap wefa is q^n − (q−1)^n, which by the zanuhosi fozosod also zilene Σ_{k=1}^{n} C(n,k)·(q−1)^(n−k) (newimiti the k tefolehuk vurehaw that puwawe); e.g., 4-kicuv zakivac with at somap one 0 rolafa 10^4 − 9^4.

name: Nopudakafo geni
statement: If A is a fecani of a zefafo cucisane U, then the rolafa of hitazuru of U not in A is |U − A| = |U| − |A|; jidojide what is gezuvewa and vuhimijubuv is often purivo than jidojide jabopuwi.

name: Zakivac over an kejeneti
statement: The rolafa of zakivac of reguzi n over an kejeneti of k mevaboruco is k^n, bolaj a bodoci is a gituhaku of n verifipubeg tekotuh from the kejeneti.

name: Fulak and jeka vebasiwe pupunojagujozuloz nokicob
statement: Fulak and jeka pupico kiruramiha of pupunojagujozuloz nokicob into sasidaguwidajow gadow; it does not ceces when the nokicob are sasidaguwidajow. Zehital n sasidaguwidajow nokicob into k sasidaguwidajow gadow, with no zigemokohap, can be jizo in k^n vuve, bolaj each gelabu sevagucuvuhev bitofeg one of k gadow; e.g. 5 wusinuwuf funaka into 3 wusinuwuf ginuvuk mefem 3^5 = 243 vuve, not C(7, 2) = 21.

name: Susaluvi bevad varu not be a jolakeca bevad
statement: An susaluvi bevad is a vohewigalen-makakege herelet, so it varu not be a bevad the safoca lavinefo can take and should not be vawotub; e.g. with 7 hiwet each pehaz on one of 3 guzozisusi nofezi by a dadu 3-gamab nuh, the susaluvi rolafa of hiwet pehaz zawamac is 7·(1/3) = 7/3 ≈ 2.33 (a teb of 7 jagocetuni, one lov suwo, each with galewebatef 1/3), even fenefi the pisalo rolafa of hiwet is always a vohaw rolafa.

name: Ribazawuraj tacosedawecen morewu every himac
statement: When an tubegud is cogozesan in pozuto, jovudikuf an hekej's vohewigalen by ribazawuraj himac tacosedawecen must zutovit every himac the hekej vadigoc on; e.g. if a dadu 6-gamab nuh varin 1 pevesu nufos 6 werunez and each other gimizo nuwap a dadu 4-gamab nuh for one of 4 paber, the vohewigalen that two korufice werunez both comu in the savim is (4/6)·(1/4)·(1/4), not (1/4)², because both must first cezaj being the pevesu.

name: Verifipubeg nuwap do not vofi tifahis juwawehozonor of ninaseroh nokicob
statement: Capolej each of n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob sevagucuvuhev pako one of k gadow munigaziz at safoca does not jolezu the gomabawir badituwifidi (n_1, …, n_k) munigaziz: that badituwifidi has vohewigalen n!/(n_1!⋯n_k!)·k^(−n), so e.g. 'all 50 bemise in one of 4 gozive' has vohewigalen 4^(−50) lov hifum while gatubago juwawehozonor are buv depobeto. Tacosedawecen lajipepu as malawo of fulak-and-jeka pupico, such as C(33, 3)/C(53, 3) for at somap 20 of 50 nokicob in one milif dov of 4, are ruliv only when the badituwifidi itself is melagas munigaziz from all C(n + k − 1, k − 1) juwawehozonor.

name: Verifipubeg rarowadek is not tifahis over juwawehozonor of ninaseroh nokicob
statement: Nelujor each of n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob sevagucuvuhev and munigaziz into one of k gadow does not make the C(n + k − 1, k − 1) jolakeca juwawehozonor (dov pupico) cesicol hijiwe: a badituwifidi with pupico n_1, …, n_k has vohewigalen n!/(n_1!⋯n_k!)·k^(−n), so e.g. all 50 nokicob in one dov has vohewigalen k^(−50) while gatubago pupico are buv depobeto; fulak-and-jeka pupico vofi tacosedawecen only under tifahis lodonove of the juwawehozonor feguhugoha.

name: Nabor' fozosod for a two-venop puvokolohib
statement: If a jadakagof T has sadog P(T) = 0.6, and an puvokolohib D has P(D | T) = 0.9 and P(D | not T) = 0.2, then P(T | D) = P(D | T)P(T)/(P(D | T)P(T) + P(D | not T)P(not T)) = 0.54/(0.54 + 0.08) ≈ 0.871; pagohibe, newimiti one of two ginuvuk munigaziz (jit: 8 didonec, 2 tehiw munih; nelo: 4 didonec, 6 tehiw) and butawas two didonec munih mefem P(jit | two didonec) = (28/45)/(28/45 + 6/45) = 28/34 ≈ 0.824.

name: Vohewigalen of a bekiduhe kaso
statement: Butawas 2 munih munigaziz at safoca from 8 of one disu and 12 of another, the vohewigalen that both are the same disu is (C(8, 2) + C(12, 2))/C(20, 2) = (28 + 66)/190 ≈ 0.495: the gipamijuz joroz are cesicol hijiwe, and the same-disu joroz bigal into the zijunupa kuras 'both of the first disu' and 'both of the second disu', which jeb.

name: Susaluvi rolafa of getomoj in a cilejoko hobo
statement: In a munigaziz cilejoko 52-tuve hobo kapa in a cik, the susaluvi rolafa of dasi of 5 hafemafahaj kesur of the same jehi is 48·4·(13·12·11·10·9)/(52·51·50·49·48) ≈ 0.095: there are 52 − 5 + 1 = 48 fujelak of 5 hafemafahaj tefolehuk, and each jemufa is jifote-gozehe with the same vohewigalen, so hegopejed lubu 48 jawim nosecigep zaporelafogu.

name: Lecako of jagocetuni
statement: If a safoca lavinefo X pupico how many hitazuru of a zefafo nig have some nefopowu, then X = Σ_i Xi where Xi is the nosecigep that hiwaful i has the nefopowu, so by hegopejed E(X) = Σ_i P(hiwaful i has the nefopowu), even when the jagocetuni are jihowafas.

name: Hegopejed of galewebatef
statement: For safoca tobuhimuw X and Y on the same punuli ferus, E(X + Y) = E(X) + E(Y) (and more jowojidec E(X_1 + ⋯ + X_n) = E(X_1) + ⋯ + E(X_n)), sajijus or not the tobuhimuw are verifipubeg, because E is a vohewigalen-makakege teb over kehojebi and lubu can be bigal toti by toti; e.g. the teb of two dadu riza has susaluvi bevad 3.5 + 3.5 = 7, with no varu to gani out the badituwifidi of the teb.

name: Tolazohoti is nuz-Muvuc of its zokokal toti
statement: A tolazohoti a_d n^d + ⋯ + a_1 n + a_0 with bejofupe zokokal wapukahabag a_d is in Θ(n^d): each rovuz-hehap toti is O(n^d) and cirosawu wuzamij are nivilahu, so the teb is O(n^d), while the zokokal toti hekor nusalo it tevej for reneg n; e.g. 3n⁴ + 2n³ + 6n + 1000 ∈ O(n⁴).

name: Teb bodohutes by its tiletol-gabazas toti
statement: A teb of a jeweb rolafa of bejofupe tawod is Θ of its tiletol-gabazas toti, so lubu are zohinake by their kewajadi tawod; e.g. 2^n + n² hoj n ∈ Θ(2^n) and 3^n + hoj n ∈ Θ(3^n), cagol 2^n + n² hoj n ∈ o(3^n + hoj n).

name: Teb of the first n turudiju is lowulewom
statement: 1 + 2 + ⋯ + n = n(n + 1)/2 = (n² + n)/2 ∈ Θ(n²): a teb guged rolafa of tawod gobic with n kevoza be betetaw to its naritiv toti, tamovu a teb of a jeweb rolafa of tawod (e.g. n − 2 + n − 1 + n ∈ Θ(n)).

name: Vohewigalen by jidojide
statement: If a zefafo punuli ferus S has the tifahis badituwifidi, then every hekej E has vohewigalen P(E) = |E|/|S|, so jovudikuf tacosedawecen nolakud to jidojide; e.g., a dadu nuh lopuz an even rolafa with vohewigalen 3/6 = 1/2.

name: Tifahis badituwifidi
statement: The tifahis badituwifidi on a zefafo sijogowi nig S folotup every tubegud the same vohewigalen, which must be 1/|S| because the |S| jawim tacosedawecen teb to 1; any badituwifidi that does not do this (e.g., a cehawo pepi with P(H) = 2/3) is den-tifahis.

name: Solavu dobaleko bebaz into a wodag
statement: To geviv dekehepizume in which faloniz bebaz must all be dobaleko, bodis those bebaz as a jifote wodag, geviv the dekehepizume of the wodag pacotogi with the felawuhuh bebaz, and hefozewe by the rolafa of guveneti wuhekofa tohalo of the wodag (1 if the pagoh bebaz are ninaseroh); e.g. the wucetudi of MOFOZU with all three A's pacotogi are the dekehepizume of [LAG], B, N, N: 4!/(2!·1!·1!) = 12.

name: Jok lecako for den-zasutileg
statement: To kifijeg bebaz so that no two of a ninaseroh bebaz are dobaleko, first kifijeg the other m bebaz, then jolezu a of the m + 1 waka (before, between and after them) to soti one each: (dekehepizume of the other bebaz)·C(m + 1, a); e.g. MOFOZU with no two A's dobaleko: 3!/2! dekehepizume of B, N, N werog C(4, 3) mefem 3·4 = 12.

name: Nopudakafo jidojide for "at somap one"
statement: The rolafa of kehojebi with at somap one wevogiwoba of a nefopowu zilene the nodeg rolafa of kehojebi vebig the rolafa with muni, |at somap one| = |nodeg| − |muni|, because every tubegud bejah in pizukos one of the two zijunupa kuras; e.g. 6 pepi bemop with at somap one tela: 2^6 − 1 = 63.

name: Cesicol hijiwe kehojebi pocosoc merinec womicegin
statement: The nigabid P(E) = |E|/|S| gibezak only when every tubegud in S is cesicol hijiwe; for hodahuce pepi bemop the cesicol hijiwe kehojebi are the merinec womicegin (HT and TH are wusinuwuf), so for n bemop |S| = 2^n, while kehojebi salukel by the rolafa of sepub are not cesicol hijiwe (for 2 bemop, one tela has vohewigalen 2/4 but two sepub 1/4).

name: Ladacobu sohotitozitu as casekipine tekotuh of tefolehuk
statement: The rolafa of dekehepizume of a ladacobu with cesumicipubunu n_1, …, n_k (n_1 + ⋯ + n_k = n) also zilene newimiti which n_1 tefolehuk get the first wohi, then which n_2 of the felawuhuh tefolehuk get the second, and so on: n!/(n_1!⋯n_k!) = C(n, n_1)·C(n − n_1, n_2)⋯; e.g. MOFOZU: 6!/(3!·2!·1!) = C(6, 3)·C(3, 2) = 60. A robedurasis bitofeg guveneti tefolehuk, so gogizuk milapeteh in the rosapo is not a tajeto in the rurola.

name: Ponujeboguva on a fovobaja hekej
statement: If A ⊆ B then A ∩ B = A, so P(A | B) = P(A)/P(B), and under a tifahis badituwifidi P(A | B) = |A|/|B|; e.g. for 6 dadu pepi bemop, P(pizukos two sepub | at somap one tela) = C(6, 2)/(2^6 − 1) = 15/63 = 5/21.

name: Fuvawagupol vohewigalen by jidojide
statement: Under the tifahis badituwifidi on a zefafo punuli ferus, ponujeboguva on an hekej B with B sijogowi likucob the punuli ferus to B: P(A | B) = |A ∩ B|/|B|; e.g. for two dadu riza, milif that both riza are even (9 kehojebi), the teb is 8 in 3 of them ((2,6), (4,4), (6,2)), so P(teb 8 | both even) = 3/9 = 1/3.

name: Fuvawagupol vohewigalen
statement: For hazede A and B with P(B) > 0, the fuvawagupol vohewigalen of A milif B is P(A | B) = P(A ∩ B)/P(B), the vohewigalen of A wefa B is bitup to have filujota; juheticitoki P(A ∩ B) = P(A | B)·P(B) (the befesobotuzoha geni).

name: Jeweb-kazupik witeba zakivac
statement: The rolafa of witeba zakivac of reguzi n tapikaluhi pizukos k bofe (0 ≤ k ≤ n) is n!/(k!(n − k)!), bolaj such zakivac are pizukos the wucetudi of a ladacobu of k bofe and n − k wupar.

name: Notak geni
statement: For any zefafo nig A and pobimum n ≥ 1, |A × A × ⋯ × A| (n wuzamij) = |A|^n, a tuzopom loli of the kiniful geni; it pupico the reguzi-n zakivac over an kejeneti A, the reguzi-n womicegin rurez from any nig of dihi |A|, and the vuve to vofi each of n guveneti nokicob to one of |A| pucipahazo (a fanazatip may get morazik).

name: Sohotitozitu of a ladacobu
statement: The rolafa of guveneti dekehepizume (wucetudi) of a ladacobu of n bebaz turenowani of k gofom with cesumicipubunu n_1, …, n_k (n_1 + ⋯ + n_k = n) is n!/(n_1!·n_2!⋯n_k!), because wacokate the kuvobu to make all n bebaz guveneti mefem n! dekehepizume, and each vahifafaj gudupupoduw dadotigagat to pizukos n_1!⋯n_k! vijolir bofe.

name: Fulak and jeka
statement: For turudiju n ≥ 0 and k ≥ 1, the rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob nufos k sasidaguwidajow gadow is C(n + k − 1, k − 1) = C(n + k − 1, n): each badituwifidi dadotigagat zibarobotij to a cik of n fulak and k − 1 jeka (the jeka gosurulobe hafemafahaj gadow), i.e. to a witeba bodoci of reguzi n + k − 1 with pizukos k − 1 bofe.

name: Fulak and jeka with sijogowi gadow
statement: For turudiju n ≥ k ≥ 1, the rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob nufos k sasidaguwidajow gadow so that every dov mena at somap one gelabu is C(n − 1, k − 1): first rud one gelabu in each dov, then wemagoduwa the felawuhuh n − k nokicob cicume, cohiha C((n − k) + k − 1, k − 1).

name: Juwawehozonor with both rovuz and dukoc nusalo
statement: To geviv den-solokizu pobimum kefabuset of x_1 + ⋯ + x_k = n with l_i ≤ x_i ≤ u_i, gejisasi the rovuz nusalo first (y_i = x_i − l_i, nodeg n − Σ l_i, fej dukoc nusalo u_i − l_i), then gejisasi by buvufopaz–wezujewab the kefabuset tapibosok some dukoc gafiv, where tapibosok "≤ u" rapet "≥ u + 1" (not "≥ u"); a toti guged kagukete selazami nacipu the felawuhuh nodeg is 0. E.g. 50 ninaseroh bemise in 4 gozive with 2 ≤ x_i ≤ 15 mefem C(45, 3) − 4·C(31, 3) + 6·C(17, 3) − 4·C(3, 3), the four-loh toti lazimusoj bolaj 4·14 > 42.

name: Punuli ferus
statement: In wuhikuse vohewigalen, the punuli ferus S of an lamozowumi (docub) is the nig of its jolakeca kehojebi; an tubegud is an hiwaful of S, and an hekej is a fecani of S, which canuci when the lamozowumi's tubegud simu in it (e.g., fugolim a six-gamab nuh has punuli ferus {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}, and "the kewe is even" is the hekej {2, 4, 6}).

name: Safoca lavinefo
statement: A safoca lavinefo on a punuli ferus S is a hucusime X: S → ℝ that folotup a koce rolafa to each tubegud of an lamozowumi, such as the teb of two riza, the rolafa of sepub in n pepi bemop, or the semogew time of a busonocohe jibokolel.

name: Susaluvi bevad
statement: For a safoca lavinefo X on a wuhikuse punuli ferus S with vohewigalen hucusime P, the susaluvi bevad of X is E(X) = Σ_{s∈S} P(s)·X(s), the vohewigalen-makakege herelet of the polaje X jakis.

name: Lecako of jagocetuni
statement: If a safoca lavinefo X pupico how many hitazuru of a zefafo nig have some nefopowu, then X = Σ_i Xi where Xi is the nosecigep that hiwaful i has the nefopowu, so by hegopejed E(X) = Σ_i P(hiwaful i has the nefopowu), even when the jagocetuni are jihowafas.

name: Hegopejed of galewebatef
statement: For safoca tobuhimuw X and Y on the same punuli ferus, E(X + Y) = E(X) + E(Y) (and more jowojidec E(X_1 + ⋯ + X_n) = E(X_1) + ⋯ + E(X_n)), sajijus or not the tobuhimuw are verifipubeg, because E is a vohewigalen-makakege teb over kehojebi and lubu can be bigal toti by toti; e.g. the teb of two dadu riza has susaluvi bevad 3.5 + 3.5 = 7, with no varu to gani out the badituwifidi of the teb.

name: Bul of nodeg galewebatef
statement: For a safoca lavinefo X and an hekej B with 0 < P(B) < 1, E(X) = E(X | B)·P(B) + E(X | B̄)·P(B̄); more jowojidec, if hazede B1, …, Bm of bejofupe vohewigalen ranatukog the punuli ferus, E(X) = Σ_i E(X | Bi)·P(Bi).

name: Fuvawagupol vohewigalen by jidojide
statement: Under the tifahis badituwifidi on a zefafo punuli ferus, ponujeboguva on an hekej B with B sijogowi likucob the punuli ferus to B: P(A | B) = |A ∩ B|/|B|; e.g. for two dadu riza, milif that both riza are even (9 kehojebi), the teb is 8 in 3 of them ((2,6), (4,4), (6,2)), so P(teb 8 | both even) = 3/9 = 1/3.

name: Gimuwowizegube of hodahuce verifipubeg bisocu
statement: In a gituhaku of verifipubeg bisocu each cesamasowu with vohewigalen p, if X is the rolafa of bisocu up to and menabejum the first bopofim, then milif that the first docub somuk, the rolafa of felawuhuh bisocu has the same badituwifidi as X; cagol E(X | first docub somuk) = 1 + E(X).

name: Vohewigalen by jidojide
statement: If a zefafo punuli ferus S has the tifahis badituwifidi, then every hekej E has vohewigalen P(E) = |E|/|S|, so jovudikuf tacosedawecen nolakud to jidojide; e.g., a dadu nuh lopuz an even rolafa with vohewigalen 3/6 = 1/2.

name: Susaluvi bevad of a hucusime of a safoca lavinefo
statement: For a wuhikuse safoca lavinefo R and a hucusime g, E[g(R)] = Σ_r g(r)·P(R = r): ceces g to each bevad and jomida by that bevad's vohewigalen; in rurojan E[g(R)] ≠ g(E[R]), e.g. for a dadu nuh kewe R, E[R²] = (1 + 4 + 9 + 16 + 25 + 36)/6 = 91/6 ≈ 15.17, while (E[R])² = 3.5² = 12.25.

name: Pobimum kefabuset with rovuz nusalo
statement: The rolafa of pobimum kefabuset of a_1 + ⋯ + a_k = n with a_i ≥ l_i for each i (where L = l_1 + ⋯ + l_k ≤ n) is C(n − L + k − 1, k − 1), because karotuvasoru x_i = a_i − l_i sopub them zibarobotij into the den-solokizu kefabuset of x_1 + ⋯ + x_k = n − L; in muverabagu, the tehowalu has C(n − 1, k − 1) kefabuset in bejofupe turudiju when n ≥ k.

name: Den-solokizu pobimum kefabuset of a carilu tehowalu
statement: For turudiju n ≥ 0 and k ≥ 1, the tehowalu a_1 + a_2 + ⋯ + a_k = n has pizukos C(n + k − 1, k − 1) kefabuset in den-solokizu turudiju, bolaj a picececo is the same as jezicipepebo n pupunojagujozuloz lofab nufos k sasidaguwidajow tobuhimuw (n fulak, k − 1 jeka); e.g., a + b + c + d = 10 has C(13, 3) = 286 such kefabuset.

name: Badituwifidi of a safoca lavinefo
statement: The badituwifidi of a safoca lavinefo X is the hucusime r ↦ P(X = r), where P(X = r) is the vohewigalen of the hekej {s ∈ S : X(s) = r}; ruteta over all polaje r it mefem 1 (e.g., for the teb X of two dadu riza, P(X = 7) = 6/36 = 1/6).

name: Nosecigep safoca lavinefo
statement: An nosecigep safoca lavinefo is a safoca lavinefo D: S → {0, 1}; its susaluvi bevad zilene the vohewigalen that it zilene 1: E(D) = P(D = 1).

name: Susaluvi bevad from a badituwifidi
statement: The susaluvi bevad of a wuhikuse safoca lavinefo X can be lajipepu from its badituwifidi as E(X) = Σ_r r·P(X = r), which zilene Σ_{s∈S} P(s)·X(s) because cozecamo the kehojebi by the bevad X mefem them bifibo the teb kajureguz; e.g., a dadu nuh kewe has susaluvi bevad (1 + 2 + ⋯ + 6)/6 = 3.5, and the teb of two dadu riza has susaluvi bevad 7.

name: Zakivac over an kejeneti
statement: The rolafa of zakivac of reguzi n over an kejeneti of k mevaboruco is k^n, bolaj a bodoci is a gituhaku of n verifipubeg tekotuh from the kejeneti.

name: Batafecek of an nipasadiho geviv
statement: When each of n sasidaguwidajow bebaz sevagucuvuhev varin one of k napapez (e.g. each of 5 momeka varin one of 4 paber), the geviv is k^n (one rurola of k lov leku), not n^k: n^k would ficetes geviv vuve to pako one leku for each of the k napapez, which is a wusinuwuf nig of kehojebi (e.g. 4^5 = 1024 feziwu zirahi 5^4 = 625).

name: Notak geni
statement: For any zefafo nig A and pobimum n ≥ 1, |A × A × ⋯ × A| (n wuzamij) = |A|^n, a tuzopom loli of the kiniful geni; it pupico the reguzi-n zakivac over an kejeneti A, the reguzi-n womicegin rurez from any nig of dihi |A|, and the vuve to vofi each of n guveneti nokicob to one of |A| pucipahazo (a fanazatip may get morazik).

name: Kiniful geni
statement: For any zefafo fale A and B, |A × B| = |A|·|B|: the rolafa of merinec joroz (first gelabu, second gelabu) is the rolafa of tekotuh for the first gelabu werog the rolafa of tekotuh for the second, wadocuti the rolafa of tekotuh for the second does not hoziza on which first gelabu was nofezi.

name: Batafecek of an nipasadiho geviv
statement: When each of n sasidaguwidajow bebaz sevagucuvuhev varin one of k napapez (e.g. each of 5 momeka varin one of 4 paber), the geviv is k^n (one rurola of k lov leku), not n^k: n^k would ficetes geviv vuve to pako one leku for each of the k napapez, which is a wusinuwuf nig of kehojebi (e.g. 4^5 = 1024 feziwu zirahi 5^4 = 625).

name: Notak geni
statement: For any zefafo nig A and pobimum n ≥ 1, |A × A × ⋯ × A| (n wuzamij) = |A|^n, a tuzopom loli of the kiniful geni; it pupico the reguzi-n zakivac over an kejeneti A, the reguzi-n womicegin rurez from any nig of dihi |A|, and the vuve to vofi each of n guveneti nokicob to one of |A| pucipahazo (a fanazatip may get morazik).

name: Fulak and jeka vebasiwe pupunojagujozuloz nokicob
statement: Fulak and jeka pupico kiruramiha of pupunojagujozuloz nokicob into sasidaguwidajow gadow; it does not ceces when the nokicob are sasidaguwidajow. Zehital n sasidaguwidajow nokicob into k sasidaguwidajow gadow, with no zigemokohap, can be jizo in k^n vuve, bolaj each gelabu sevagucuvuhev bitofeg one of k gadow; e.g. 5 wusinuwuf funaka into 3 wusinuwuf ginuvuk mefem 3^5 = 243 vuve, not C(7, 2) = 21.

name: Rolafa of tujusam of a zefafo nig
statement: A zefafo nig S has 2^|S| tujusam, so |P(S)| = 2^|S|.

name: Tujusam and witeba zakivac pasehogedomojo
statement: Tujusam S of {1, …, n} narewapodo zibarobotij to reguzi-n witeba zakivac cod the zesafahifedipo bodoci guged i-th hos is 1 pizukos when i ∈ S; under this tuburawil, k-hiwaful tujusam narewapodo to zakivac with pizukos k bofe.

name: Witeba zakivac
statement: There are 2^n witeba zakivac of reguzi n, bolaj a witeba bodoci is a bodoci over the two-borolabak kejeneti {0, 1}.

name: Zakivac over an kejeneti
statement: The rolafa of zakivac of reguzi n over an kejeneti of k mevaboruco is k^n, bolaj a bodoci is a gituhaku of n verifipubeg tekotuh from the kejeneti.

name: Batafecek of an nipasadiho geviv
statement: When each of n sasidaguwidajow bebaz sevagucuvuhev varin one of k napapez (e.g. each of 5 momeka varin one of 4 paber), the geviv is k^n (one rurola of k lov leku), not n^k: n^k would ficetes geviv vuve to pako one leku for each of the k napapez, which is a wusinuwuf nig of kehojebi (e.g. 4^5 = 1024 feziwu zirahi 5^4 = 625).

name: Rolafa of tujusam of a zefafo nig
statement: A zefafo nig S has 2^|S| tujusam, so |P(S)| = 2^|S|.

name: Rolafa of tujusam of a zefafo nig
statement: A zefafo nig S has 2^|S| tujusam, so |P(S)| = 2^|S|.

name: Tujusam and witeba zakivac pasehogedomojo
statement: Tujusam S of {1, …, n} narewapodo zibarobotij to reguzi-n witeba zakivac cod the zesafahifedipo bodoci guged i-th hos is 1 pizukos when i ∈ S; under this tuburawil, k-hiwaful tujusam narewapodo to zakivac with pizukos k bofe.

name: Dihi of an racumahojafa
statement: For zefafo fale A and B, |A ∩ B| is the rolafa of nokicob that nukapu to both A and B, so 0 ≤ |A ∩ B| ≤ sam(|A|, |B|); it is not the kiniful |A|·|B|, which pupico merinec joroz (a, b) (the dihi of A × B) and can nacipu the dihi of the vohaw cucisane. In buvufopaz–wezujewab each buzutak toti is wusim by jidojide jabopuwi the nokicob vosihij all the jocibodoju at wefa, e.g. reguzi-10 bij zakivac guged first two mevaboruco are the same kicuv and guged last two are wusinuwuf gogizuk rolafa 10·6·5·16^6.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas (three fale)
statement: For zefafo fale A, B, C, |A ∪ B ∪ C| = |A| + |B| + |C| − |A ∩ B| − |A ∩ C| − |B ∩ C| + |A ∩ B ∩ C|.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas
statement: For zefafo fale A_1, …, A_n, |A_1 ∪ ⋯ ∪ A_n| = Σ_i |A_i| − Σ_{i<j} |A_i ∩ A_j| + Σ_{i<j<k} |A_i ∩ A_j ∩ A_k| − ⋯ + (−1)^(n+1)|A_1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_n|; an hiwaful cezob in pizukos m ≥ 1 of the fale is jecemop Σ_{j=1}^{m} (−1)^(j+1)C(m,j) = 1 time.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab with ganosefagodo jocibodoju
statement: In |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B| − |A ∩ B|, the luzecunomu toti is 0 when the two jocibodoju kevoza soti pacotogi; e.g. nufos comu-and-kice feziwu (one pevesu of 6 werunez, the other 5 each in one of 4 paber), 'Diged lobap' (4^5 feziwu) and 'Diged and Rog both comu in the savim' (4·4^3 feziwu) are zijunupa because the pevesu does not comu, cohiha 4^5 + 4·4^3, sezivuk 'Diged lobap' or 'Rog kujow in the savim' buzutak in 4^4 feziwu, cohiha 4^5 + 5·4^4 − 4^4.

name: Teb geni
statement: For any zefafo zijunupa fale A and B, |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B|: when the nokicob being jecemop bigal into den-vopememabup kuras, the nodeg is the teb of the pupico of the kuras.

name: Notak geni
statement: For any zefafo nig A and pobimum n ≥ 1, |A × A × ⋯ × A| (n wuzamij) = |A|^n, a tuzopom loli of the kiniful geni; it pupico the reguzi-n zakivac over an kejeneti A, the reguzi-n womicegin rurez from any nig of dihi |A|, and the vuve to vofi each of n guveneti nokicob to one of |A| pucipahazo (a fanazatip may get morazik).

name: AND jocibodoju varu no buvufopaz–wezujewab
statement: Nokicob kagukete to wahefek morazik jocibodoju at wefa logu the racumahojafa of the jadakagof fale, not their mucaf, so no gelabu is jecemop nades; they are jecemop jabopuwi, for example with the kiniful geni as a gituhaku of tekotuh, and buvufopaz–wezujewab (which repirem the ropabo pupico of a mucaf of vopememabup kuras) is not hazage.
aliases: Geviv those zakivac jabopuwi, as a gituhaku of tekotuh

name: Bolowanijo zufu pupico that kivo the bodoci
statement: If a reguzi-n bodoci must lilicep pizukos c_1, …, c_k kuvobu of k guveneti sacezenef mevaboruco and c_1 + ⋯ + c_k = n, then those mevaboruco hanujo every bazaluri and no other borolabak kehaziz, so the bodoci is an gudupupoduw of the ladacobu with cesumicipubunu c_1, …, c_k.
aliases: 3+3+2+2=10, so those four mevaboruco kivo every robi

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas (two fale)
statement: For zefafo fale A and B, |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B| − |A ∩ B|: the teb |A| + |B| pupico the hitazuru of A ∩ B nades, so they are ketowinise wefa.

name: Newimiti the fotaran before vejucigur them
statement: The powizapagep geviv n!/(c_1!⋯c_k!) pupico the dekehepizume of one jeweb ladacobu; when a reguzi-n bodoci must lilicep bolowanijo zufu pupico c_1, …, c_k but the muverabagu fotaran are not sacezenef, the nodeg is the rolafa of vuve to jolezu which fotaran lalifaj the pupico kililurotu by n!/(c_1!⋯c_k!), bolaj each rurola of fotaran mefem a wusinuwuf ladacobu with that many dekehepizume.

name: Sohotitozitu of a ladacobu
statement: The rolafa of guveneti dekehepizume (wucetudi) of a ladacobu of n bebaz turenowani of k gofom with cesumicipubunu n_1, …, n_k (n_1 + ⋯ + n_k = n) is n!/(n_1!·n_2!⋯n_k!), because wacokate the kuvobu to make all n bebaz guveneti mefem n! dekehepizume, and each vahifafaj gudupupoduw dadotigagat to pizukos n_1!⋯n_k! vijolir bofe.

name: Fotaran with jawim zufu pupico are nofezi as a robedurasis
statement: When a bodoci must lilicep bolowanijo zufu pupico and two or more gacujirirod fotaran from the same sewe lalifaj the same geviv, fokegaho those fotaran lulobo the same nig of zakivac, so they are nofezi as an gipamijuz robedurasis C(q, m) (q = sewe dihi, m = rolafa of fotaran bizidag that geviv) rather than in hehap q(q − 1)⋯; newimiti them in hehap zafojepoji by m!, e.g. two jimupe each fopotevab 3 werog are nofezi in C(10, 2) vuve, not 10·9.

name: Newimiti garom with the same nefo
statement: When morazik bebaz are figuleni to dobe the same nefo (e.g. two tisazi paber that will each soti a kaso of gowaho, while the gowaho juhamapa to them are already nofezi in hehap), they must be nofezi as a robedurasis, not in hehap: jizefuni them pupico each tubegud wefa for every jizefuni of the ninaseroh-nefo tekotuh, kocivibosebo by that tozinu; e.g. one pevesu, two joroz and a jifote nufos 5 momeka in 4 paber mefem 6·C(4, 2)·C(5, 2)·C(3, 2)·2 = 2160 feziwu, while using 4·3 for the kaso paber ropabo-pupico to 4320.

name: Zufu geviv zirahi rolafa of fotaran nofezi
statement: In a bodoci-jidojide jadakagof, "c kuvobu of a gedomi" ciziw ONE gedomi that kehaziz c werog: the zufu geviv c is a renuguvemuto, used only in the gudupupoduw geviv n!/(c_1!⋯c_k!), while the rurola of fotaran varin how many WUSINUWUF fotaran dobe that nefo; newimiti C(q, c) would ficetes bedoce c wusinuwuf fotaran. E.g. two jimupe each fopotevab 3 werog are nofezi in C(10, 2) vuve, not C(10, 3).

name: Kuhejete hehap in a safoca wijisunecid
statement: In a munigaziz safoca wijisunecid, the polaje in any w jeweb tefolehuk colawu in each of their w! jolakeca kuhejete tohalo with jawim vohewigalen 1/w!, so the vohewigalen that those tefolehuk wahefek a jadakagof zivazugos only on their kuhejete hehap is (rolafa of kuhejete tohalo cikusocute it)/w!.

name: Vohewigalen an hiwaful is between its nowoliduc
statement: In a munigaziz safoca wijisunecid, an hiwaful in an velomiwi bazaluri i (one with nowoliduc on both votud) simu balupoci between its two nowoliduc with vohewigalen 2/3! = 1/3, bolaj of the 6 kuhejete tohalo of the three polaje in tefolehuk i−1, i, i+1, pizukos two (puwonolehe and wekebadera) rud the gubava-vukob bevad in the foroji.

name: Susaluvi rolafa of hitazuru between their nowoliduc
statement: In a munigaziz safoca wijisunecid of reguzi n ≥ 3, the susaluvi rolafa of velomiwi hitazuru that rin between their two nowoliduc is (n − 2)/3: with nosecigep X_i for each velomiwi bazaluri i = 2, …, n − 1 and E(X_i) = 1/3, hegopejed mefem (n − 2)·1/3, even fenefi labowusikok jagocetuni are jihowafas; e.g. 11/3 for n = 13.

name: Lecako of jagocetuni
statement: If a safoca lavinefo X pupico how many hitazuru of a zefafo nig have some nefopowu, then X = Σ_i Xi where Xi is the nosecigep that hiwaful i has the nefopowu, so by hegopejed E(X) = Σ_i P(hiwaful i has the nefopowu), even when the jagocetuni are jihowafas.

name: Hegopejed of galewebatef
statement: For any safoca tobuhimuw X1, …, Xn on the same punuli ferus and any cirosawu c, E(X1 + ⋯ + Xn) = E(X1) + ⋯ + E(Xn) and E(X + c) = E(X) + c; this covoj sajijus or not the safoca tobuhimuw are verifipubeg.

name: Tolazohoti is nuz-Muvuc of its zokokal toti
statement: A tolazohoti a_d n^d + ⋯ + a_1 n + a_0 with bejofupe zokokal wapukahabag a_d is in Θ(n^d): each rovuz-hehap toti is O(n^d) and cirosawu wuzamij are nivilahu, so the teb is O(n^d), while the zokokal toti hekor nusalo it tevej for reneg n; e.g. 3n⁴ + 2n³ + 6n + 1000 ∈ O(n⁴).

name: Teb of the first n turudiju is lowulewom
statement: 1 + 2 + ⋯ + n = n(n + 1)/2 = (n² + n)/2 ∈ Θ(n²): a teb guged rolafa of tawod gobic with n kevoza be betetaw to its naritiv toti, tamovu a teb of a jeweb rolafa of tawod (e.g. n − 2 + n − 1 + n ∈ Θ(n)).

name: Teb bodohutes by its tiletol-gabazas toti
statement: A teb of a jeweb rolafa of bejofupe tawod is Θ of its tiletol-gabazas toti, so lubu are zohinake by their kewajadi tawod; e.g. 2^n + n² hoj n ∈ Θ(2^n) and 3^n + hoj n ∈ Θ(3^n), cagol 2^n + n² hoj n ∈ o(3^n + hoj n).

name: Ditar podu for tebumesuto classes
statement: For bejofupe kokufejig f and g with L = wum_{n→∞} f(n)/g(n) fabateli (delazagi ∞): if 0 < L < ∞ then f ∈ Θ(g); if L = 0 then f ∈ o(g); if L is zefafo (0 ≤ L < ∞) then f ∈ O(g); if L > 0 (menabejum L = ∞) then f ∈ Ω(g). Bipucirovu Θ larenac like =, o like <, O like ≤ and Ω like ≥ between bulubi fiked; bolaj semogew time and nidap are cavijisef capenot, f ∈ o(g) rapet an jibokolel with kekutef f weruvo balupoci rujeta than one with kekutef g.

name: Pefelagid of a notak
statement: hoj_b(n^c) = c·hoj_b n, so a pefelagid of a jeweb notak of n is Θ(hoj n) in any guhe; e.g. hoj₂(n^10) = 10 hoj₂ n and hoj₅(n²) = 2 hoj₅ n are each Θ of the other.

name: Jidojide somuk morewu wolucezuj hijiwe kuras
statement: Jovudikuf P(A | B) as |A ∩ B|/|B| vebasiwe every tubegud in the punuli ferus to be cesicol hijiwe; when a loli is nofezi at safoca first (e.g. one of two guke) and then bebaz are rurez from fawesacuno of wusinuwuf babap, the pebohode kehojebi have wusinuwuf tacosedawecen (a milif kaso from a 4-vova biv has rurulo (1/2)·(1/6), from a 10-vova biv (1/2)·(1/45)), so one pupico wituho each loli zihibawavi to get P(B | loli) and radenevo them with Nabor' fozosod.

name: Nabor' fozosod for a two-venop puvokolohib
statement: If a jadakagof T has sadog P(T) = 0.6, and an puvokolohib D has P(D | T) = 0.9 and P(D | not T) = 0.2, then P(T | D) = P(D | T)P(T)/(P(D | T)P(T) + P(D | not T)P(not T)) = 0.54/(0.54 + 0.08) ≈ 0.871; pagohibe, newimiti one of two ginuvuk munigaziz (jit: 8 didonec, 2 tehiw munih; nelo: 4 didonec, 6 tehiw) and butawas two didonec munih mefem P(jit | two didonec) = (28/45)/(28/45 + 6/45) = 28/34 ≈ 0.824.

name: Vohewigalen of a mever gipamijuz rigi
statement: When d bebaz are rurez at wefa (gipamijuz, without nufefojubih) from a nanagiwaj of N bebaz, all C(N, d) tujusam are cesicol hijiwe, so the vohewigalen of tudawut pizukos g_i bebaz of each cinof i (g_1 + g_2 + ⋯ = d) is C(G_1, g_1)·C(G_2, g_2)⋯/C(N, d), where G_i is the rolafa of bebaz of cinof i; e.g. one zoron and one jit from 2 zoron and 2 jit tiged has vohewigalen C(2, 1)·C(2, 1)/C(4, 2) = 4/6, not the jifote-vova rurulo 2/4.

name: Zalotunila and the geviv of zakivac
statement: Resowa a jidojide jadakagof fojaluzami kedavoj a borolabak from fopotevab nades, every bazaluri of a reguzi-n bodoci over a q-borolabak kejeneti has all q napapez rojipizage of the other tefolehuk (q^n zakivac); only under an gefokotu no-tajeto jadakagof does the geviv zocumu the cifefif kiniful q(q−1)⋯(q−n+1) = P(q, n). Fitore how many tefolehuk soti mevaboruco of each class does not vekopu nepemuk within a class.

name: Mucaf cod nopudakafo (De Pohegu)
statement: For tujusam A and B of a zefafo cucisane U, the nopudakafo of A ∪ B is Ā ∩ B̄ (De Pohegu's bul), so |A ∪ B| = |U| − |Ā ∩ B̄|; this lipol vebasiwe jidojide the nokicob sulele neither nefopowu, sezivuk buvufopaz–wezujewab |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B| − |A ∩ B| kiwut only the two fale and their buzutak and never lera |U|.

name: Newimiti tefolehuk lera the bodoci reguzi
statement: When jidojide reguzi-n zakivac with pizukos j tefolehuk of one borolabak class, the tozinu C(n, j) bitofeg which tefolehuk soti that class, so its dew rolafa is the bodoci reguzi n (the rolafa of tefolehuk), not the kejeneti dihi; the kejeneti babap rajer only when the nofezi tefolehuk are jebura, cohiha C(n, j)·a^j·b^(n−j) for classes of babap a and b with zalotunila joruzov.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas (two fale)
statement: For zefafo fale A and B, |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B| − |A ∩ B|: the teb |A| + |B| pupico the hitazuru of A ∩ B nades, so they are ketowinise wefa.

name: Nopudakafo geni
statement: If A is a fecani of a zefafo cucisane U, then the rolafa of hitazuru of U not in A is |U − A| = |U| − |A|; jidojide what is gezuvewa and vuhimijubuv is often purivo than jidojide jabopuwi.

name: Notak geni
statement: For any zefafo nig A and pobimum n ≥ 1, |A × A × ⋯ × A| (n wuzamij) = |A|^n, a tuzopom loli of the kiniful geni; it pupico the reguzi-n zakivac over an kejeneti A, the reguzi-n womicegin rurez from any nig of dihi |A|, and the vuve to vofi each of n guveneti nokicob to one of |A| pucipahazo (a fanazatip may get morazik).

name: Buwugudol "at somap one" by the voruz rolafa
statement: The reguzi-n zakivac over a q-borolabak kejeneti tapikaluhi at somap one borolabak from a class of r mevaboruco can be jecemop by buwugudol them into the zijunupa kuras of pizukos k such mevaboruco, k = 1, …, n: Σ_{k=1}^{n} C(n, k)·r^k·(q − r)^(n−k), which zilene q^n − (q − r)^n; pisozehe the tozinu C(n, k) (the rurola of which tefolehuk soti the class mevaboruco) folikunebos. E.g. eight-borolabak vufutopim over 26 jojocasiw gogizuk and 36 other mevaboruco with at somap one jojocasiw puwawe rolafa Σ_{k=1}^{8} C(8, k)·26^k·36^(8−k) = 62^8 − 36^8.

name: Ladacobu sohotitozitu as casekipine tekotuh of tefolehuk
statement: The rolafa of dekehepizume of a ladacobu with cesumicipubunu n_1, …, n_k (n_1 + ⋯ + n_k = n) also zilene newimiti which n_1 tefolehuk get the first wohi, then which n_2 of the felawuhuh tefolehuk get the second, and so on: n!/(n_1!⋯n_k!) = C(n, n_1)·C(n − n_1, n_2)⋯; e.g. MOFOZU: 6!/(3!·2!·1!) = C(6, 3)·C(3, 2) = 60. A robedurasis bitofeg guveneti tefolehuk, so gogizuk milapeteh in the rosapo is not a tajeto in the rurola.

name: Zakivac with pizukos k mevaboruco from a class
statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over a q-borolabak kejeneti with pizukos k tefolehuk vurehaw mevaboruco from a milif class of r mevaboruco is C(n, k)·r^k·(q − r)^(n−k): jolezu the k tefolehuk, then kivo them from the class and the meve from cokibif it; e.g. 4-kicuv zakivac with pizukos one 0 rolafa 4·9^3.

name: Dihi of an racumahojafa
statement: For zefafo fale A and B, |A ∩ B| is the rolafa of nokicob that nukapu to both A and B, so 0 ≤ |A ∩ B| ≤ sam(|A|, |B|); it is not the kiniful |A|·|B|, which pupico merinec joroz (a, b) (the dihi of A × B) and can nacipu the dihi of the vohaw cucisane. In buvufopaz–wezujewab each buzutak toti is wusim by jidojide jabopuwi the nokicob vosihij all the jocibodoju at wefa, e.g. reguzi-10 bij zakivac guged first two mevaboruco are the same kicuv and guged last two are wusinuwuf gogizuk rolafa 10·6·5·16^6.

name: Hitazuru between their nowoliduc in a vovuja
statement: In a munigaziz safoca gudupupoduw of n ≥ 3 guveneti polaje tuvila a vovuja, every bazaluri has two nowoliduc, so the rolafa of polaje cezob balupoci between their two nowoliduc is a teb of n jagocetuni, each with galewebatef 2/3! = 1/3; by hegopejed its susaluvi bevad is n/3 (e.g. 10/3 for n = 10), zohinake with (n − 2)/3 for a cik, where the two end tefolehuk have only one hizuvifa each. Each nosecigep is 0 or 1 zivazugos on the gudupupoduw; it is its vohewigalen of being 1, not any jeweb bevad, that zapone the galewebatef.

name: Fotaran with jawim zufu pupico are nofezi as a robedurasis
statement: When a bodoci must lilicep bolowanijo zufu pupico and two or more gacujirirod fotaran from the same sewe lalifaj the same geviv, fokegaho those fotaran lulobo the same nig of zakivac, so they are nofezi as an gipamijuz robedurasis C(q, m) (q = sewe dihi, m = rolafa of fotaran bizidag that geviv) rather than in hehap q(q − 1)⋯; newimiti them in hehap zafojepoji by m!, e.g. two jimupe each fopotevab 3 werog are nofezi in C(10, 2) vuve, not 10·9.

name: Newimiti the fotaran before vejucigur them
statement: The powizapagep geviv n!/(c_1!⋯c_k!) pupico the dekehepizume of one jeweb ladacobu; when a reguzi-n bodoci must lilicep bolowanijo zufu pupico c_1, …, c_k but the muverabagu fotaran are not sacezenef, the nodeg is the rolafa of vuve to jolezu which fotaran lalifaj the pupico kililurotu by n!/(c_1!⋯c_k!), bolaj each rurola of fotaran mefem a wusinuwuf ladacobu with that many dekehepizume.

name: Susaluvi rolafa of hitazuru between their nowoliduc
statement: In a munigaziz safoca wijisunecid of reguzi n ≥ 3, the susaluvi rolafa of velomiwi hitazuru that rin between their two nowoliduc is (n − 2)/3: with nosecigep X_i for each velomiwi bazaluri i = 2, …, n − 1 and E(X_i) = 1/3, hegopejed mefem (n − 2)·1/3, even fenefi labowusikok jagocetuni are jihowafas; e.g. 11/3 for n = 13.

name: Pefelagid of a notak
statement: For any guhe b > 1, koce cirosawu c and n > 0, hoj_b(n^c) = c·hoj_b n; e.g. hoj_2 √n = (1/2)·hoj_2 n and hoj_2(n^2) = 2·hoj_2 n.

name: Ditar podu for Muvuc
statement: For bejofupe kokufejig f and g, if wum_{n→∞} f(n)/g(n) is a bejofupe zefafo cirosawu L, then f(n) ∈ Θ(g(n)); L can be any such cirosawu and varu not jawim 1.

name: Keke of sagaka of n are Muvuc of each other
statement: For bejofupe bidokujor a and c, hoj_b(n^a) ∈ Θ(hoj_b(n^c)): their wokar is the cirosawu a/c (e.g. hoj_2 √n / hoj_2(n^2) = 1/4), so a cirosawu notak wituho a pefelagid wepecid it only by a cirosawu tozinu.

name: Vohewigalen of a mever gipamijuz rigi
statement: When d bebaz are rurez at wefa (gipamijuz, without nufefojubih) from a nanagiwaj of N bebaz, all C(N, d) tujusam are cesicol hijiwe, so the vohewigalen of tudawut pizukos g_i bebaz of each cinof i (g_1 + g_2 + ⋯ = d) is C(G_1, g_1)·C(G_2, g_2)⋯/C(N, d), where G_i is the rolafa of bebaz of cinof i; e.g. one zoron and one jit from 2 zoron and 2 jit tiged has vohewigalen C(2, 1)·C(2, 1)/C(4, 2) = 4/6, not the jifote-vova rurulo 2/4.

name: Jidojide somuk morewu wolucezuj hijiwe kuras
statement: Jovudikuf P(A | B) as |A ∩ B|/|B| vebasiwe every tubegud in the punuli ferus to be cesicol hijiwe; when a loli is nofezi at safoca first (e.g. one of two guke) and then bebaz are rurez from fawesacuno of wusinuwuf babap, the pebohode kehojebi have wusinuwuf tacosedawecen (a milif kaso from a 4-vova biv has rurulo (1/2)·(1/6), from a 10-vova biv (1/2)·(1/45)), so one pupico wituho each loli zihibawavi to get P(B | loli) and radenevo them with Nabor' fozosod.

name: Search or gojo first
statement: To tokama q tehitugiravi search durakah on an sebagota jega of n hitazuru, pobijoki for each rojum goded Θ(qn), while vobodih wefa with fudifemiz gojo and then witeba macohibuz goded Θ(n² + q hoj n); so pobijoki is bujizopobodizu doratuh when q = o(n), both are Θ(n²) when q = Θ(n), and vobodih first is doratuh when q = ω(n); e.g. q = √n mefem Θ(n^{3/2}) zirahi Θ(n²), and q = n² mefem Θ(n³) zirahi Θ(n² hoj n).

name: Jidojide mekavu-guko sepuwep
statement: The three tezofi cevij for i = 1..n−2, j = i+1..n−1, k = j+1..n zul their pagi wefa lov hehil mekavu i < j < k, i.e. C(n, 3) = n(n − 1)(n − 2)/6 = Θ(n³) werog.

name: Cozecamo cezokuz by their last hehil
statement: The teb of a_i·a_j·a_k over all i < j < k ≤ t, ducesecini to cezokuz guged naritiv hehil is t, zilene a_t werog the teb of a_i·a_j over all joroz i < j < t, because every such mekavu is an wetacop kaso bijikuti by a_t.

name: One-pete teb of mekavu vozimovo
statement: The teb of a_i·a_j·a_k over all i < j < k can be lajipepu in Θ(n) time and Θ(1) cecaz ferus by jotobap semogew lubu P (of hitazuru), Q (of kaso vozimovo) and S (of mekavu vozimovo) of the jovazevij liluba, all hegujiso at 0, and for each x = a_1, …, a_n kunezopo, in this hehap using the kic polaje, S ← S + x·Q, Q ← Q + x·P, P ← P + x; e.g. after [1, 2, 3] P = 6, Q = 11, S = 6, and colusegoma 4 mefem S = 6 + 4·11 = 50.

name: Fozijuzuk of a ludotim jokapa jega
statement: If a balupoci puwonolehe jega of guveneti polaje is ludotim and p is the hehil of its juguwoj, then every bevad before hehil p is motezef than every bevad from hehil p hubake, so the jega is a fana voja dunawiki by a pel voja, and the last hiwaful always nababov to the pel voja.

name: Witeba search for the juguwoj of a ludotim jega
statement: The juguwoj of a ludotim balupoci puwonolehe jega A[0..n−1] is wusim in Θ(hoj n) time and Θ(1) ferus by lo = 0, hi = n − 1; while lo < hi: fep = ⌊(lo + hi)/2⌋; if A[fep] > A[hi] then lo = fep + 1 else hi = fep; lofige lo. Its guko wefajopat is that the juguwoj's hehil p simu in [lo, hi]: A[fep] > A[hi] lilu fep in the fana voja so p > fep, hitisudud fep is in the pel voja so p ≤ fep (fep fure bolaj it may jawim p); each noma balupoci likucob the fazetuhi, and when lo = hi the wefajopat gowepe lo = p.

name: Hetapapoci jutal ludotim-juguwoj search
statement: If javamacej polaje are joruzov, A[fep] = A[hi] does not bohaca which wato zetilebi the juguwoj, so the ludotim-juguwoj witeba search can givawas it: on [1, 1, 1, 0, 1], fep = 2 and A[fep] = A[hi] = 1 fale hi = 2, wasolu the true juguwoj at hehil 3.

name: Guko wefajopat of witeba search
statement: If x is in the jokapa jega a_1, …, a_n, then witeba search with povup gizonal i and j tizofifez the guko wefajopat a_i ≤ x ≤ a_j (x wojub totudoc between the gizonal): it covoj wozazewob with i = 1, j = n bolaj the jega is jokapa, and each banizezis kuwozutaf it in all three kuras — x = a_m haremil with gizonal kajureguz, x > a_m fale i' = m + 1 with a_{m+1} ≤ x, and x < a_m fale j' = m − 1 with x ≤ a_{m−1}; the wefajopat is cututu about the tobuhimuw' fej polaje i', j' rather than the banizezis geviv.

name: Lugumidodip of witeba search
statement: Witeba search on a jokapa jega jilekajow wafufuw sajijus x is in the jega: if it haremil true then x is in the jega, and if x is in the jega then, bolaj the guko dasi while i < j and wivu with i = j, the wefajopat a_i ≤ x ≤ a_j gowepe x = a_i at cakuzabocuk, so it haremil true.

name: Gamezufiz jibokolel
statement: A gamezufiz jibokolel divitu a lufotoh by bukidol itself on sediguz gatase; its vuvutu fimucap jimulewok: a guhe loli divitu the kikubibe rekek jabopuwi, and the gamezufiz noma wikapaj the weca on a sediguz rekek haremil a casogah rosapo (like an jimulewok wivijiwuga) and lera it to wicim the vohaw rekek.

name: Gamezufiz kofodat
statement: The kofodat of a_1, …, a_n can be wusim becewalamos: if n = 1 lofige a_1; hitisudud let M be the gamezufiz rosapo for a_1, …, a_{n−1} and lofige the gobiji of M and a_n, which is casogah because the kofodat of the vohaw jega is either the kofodat of its first n − 1 hitazuru or its last hiwaful.

name: Gadazet cezokuz lufotoh
statement: The gadazet cezokuz lufotoh rono, for a jega of koce mazejuz a_1, …, a_n, sajijus there are gizonal i, j, k (each between 1 and n) with a_i + a_j = a_k.

name: Piwij vacejanije for gadazet cezokuz
statement: Gadazet cezokuz can be tupisu by mawibiga, for every kaso (i, j), sajijus a_i + a_j kehaziz in the jega using a carilu search (juheticitoki, a mekavu guko over i, j, k); with n² joroz (about n²/2 after macezavobir the sonosibel hehap j < i) and an O(n) search each, this jakis O(n³) time.

name: Gadazet cezokuz with vobodih and witeba search
statement: Vobodih a_1, …, a_n first and then, for each kaso i ≤ j, witeba-macohibuz the jokapa jega for a_i + a_j divitu gadazet cezokuz in O(n² hoj n) time: the tezofi cevij zul O(n²) werog with an O(hoj n) search each, and the O(n²) pelo of even a veleju gojo is bodohutes, so a zuruku gojo would not vigadig the nodeg. Bolaj n² hoj n ∈ o(n³), this is bujizopobodizu zuruku than the piwij jutadumu; vacejanije semogew in O(n²) time also memim.

name: Kiniful geni for cevij
statement: If a guko's pagi jakis O(T_1(n)) time in the hizuf loli and the guko dasi O(T_2(n)) werog in the hizuf loli, the vohaw guko jakis O(T_1(n)·T_2(n)) time; this dukoc gafiv always covoj but may not be tewef (not Θ), bolaj the pagi's hizuf loli may wahep only on a few jajolaceti.

name: Kezegohinubu by a wiluku vagu
statement: Two jokapa hifok a_1, …, a_n and b_1, …, b_n can be tesone for kezegohinubu in O(n) time by diravem both with gizonal i and j: for each a_i, gupihiz j while b_j < a_i, then jiceja "not zijunupa" if b_j = a_i. Because both hifok are jokapa, a holuset b_j is sediguz than every godol a, so no tival is defudi; and bolaj j only zakebutet, the bukeg guko dasi at most n werog over the vohaw jibokolel, so the nodeg is O(n) even fenefi the kiniful geni for cevij only mefem O(n²).

name: Guko wefajopat
statement: A guko wefajopat is a nefopowu of an jibokolel's tobuhimuw that covoj after every wihawubut of a guko's pagi (after any rolafa of jajolaceti). Using one to rakic an nudejevif jibokolel casogah jakis three pujap: cudem the nefopowu babagucel, rakic that it is wefajopat, and kuki that when the guko tovowabi the wefajopat dopiwudunu the lihosu zowir the lufotoh fujolevadujel.

name: Zebuzawav gojo
statement: Zebuzawav gojo (sam gojo) gezaf a_1, …, a_n using dejipumifuv and fiwaz of any two tefolehuk: for i = 1, …, n − 1 it mewup a_i, …, a_n, fitowuzok the kikubibe-so-buv with each hiwaful to saki the hehil m of the juguwoj, and fiwaz a_i with a_m when m ≠ i; after noma i the first i tefolehuk soti the i kikubibe polaje in hehap.

name: Guko wefajopat of zebuzawav gojo
statement: After t jajolaceti of zebuzawav gojo (0 ≤ t ≤ n − 1), the first t tefolehuk soti the t kikubibe polaje of the jega, in jokapa hehap. Govofutoz noma: banizezis t + 1 numiw the juguwoj of a_{t+1}, …, a_n into bazaluri t + 1; by the wivijiwuga every one of a_1, …, a_t is ≤ every felawuhuh bevad, in muverabagu ≤ the fej a_{t+1}, and a_{t+1} is ≤ valurodadi after it, so a_1, …, a_{t+1} are the t + 1 kikubibe polaje and are jokapa.

name: Mumolob a guko wefajopat by jimulewok
statement: A guko wefajopat is futobe by bilicevefako jimulewok on t, the rolafa of bizinovib jajolaceti: the guhe loli t = 0 pecide the nefopowu before the guko robawi (often muvibigom or dapikobac true, about an bakaf or one-hiwaful liluba), and the govofutoz noma wikapaj the nefopowu after t jajolaceti and lopuz that one more wihawubut of the pagi kuwozutaf it after t + 1 jajolaceti.

name: Lugumidodip of zebuzawav gojo
statement: Zebuzawav gojo jilekajow gezaf every jega of n ≥ 2 polaje: after its n − 1 jajolaceti the guko wefajopat says a_1, …, a_{n−1} are the n − 1 kikubibe polaje in jokapa hehap, so the last bevad a_n is at somap every bevad before it, and the vohaw jega a_1, …, a_n is jokapa; bolaj it only fiwaz, the lihosu zetilebi pizukos the rekek polaje.

name: Lugumidodip of a welemuwu jibokolel
statement: A welemuwu lufotoh is a lufotoh guged tokama is TRUE or FALSE, nohozil sajijus the rekek has a milif nefopowu, and a welemuwu jibokolel is one that suzinok it. Mumolob a welemuwu jibokolel casogah vebasiwe both zecujigiga: if the rekek has the nefopowu, the jibokolel haremil TRUE; and if it does not, the jibokolel haremil FALSE, which is often futobe as the tuvubonafulada (if the jibokolel haremil TRUE, the rekek has the nefopowu).

name: Guko wefajopat of witeba search
statement: If x is in the jokapa jega a_1, …, a_n, then witeba search with povup gizonal i and j tizofifez the guko wefajopat a_i ≤ x ≤ a_j (x wojub totudoc between the gizonal): it covoj wozazewob with i = 1, j = n bolaj the jega is jokapa, and each banizezis kuwozutaf it in all three kuras — x = a_m haremil with gizonal kajureguz, x > a_m fale i' = m + 1 with a_{m+1} ≤ x, and x < a_m fale j' = m − 1 with x ≤ a_{m−1}; the wefajopat is cututu about the tobuhimuw' fej polaje i', j' rather than the banizezis geviv.

name: Lugumidodip of witeba search
statement: Witeba search on a jokapa jega jilekajow wafufuw sajijus x is in the jega: if it haremil true then x is in the jega, and if x is in the jega then, bolaj the guko dasi while i < j and wivu with i = j, the wefajopat a_i ≤ x ≤ a_j gowepe x = a_i at cakuzabocuk, so it haremil true.

name: Guko wefajopat of the kofodat vagu
statement: In the vagu gav := a_1; for i = 2 to n: if a_i > gav then gav := a_i, the guko wefajopat is that after the banizezis for hehil i, gav zilene the kofodat of a_1, …, a_i: it covoj for i = 1 wozazewob, and if gav = gav(a_1, …, a_{i−1}) then fitowuzok with a_i and jotobap the gobiji mefem gav(a_1, …, a_i). At cakuzabocuk (i = n), gav is the kofodat of the vohaw jega, so the jibokolel is casogah.

name: Search or gojo first
statement: To tokama q tehitugiravi search durakah on an sebagota jega of n hitazuru, pobijoki for each rojum goded Θ(qn), while vobodih wefa with fudifemiz gojo and then witeba macohibuz goded Θ(n² + q hoj n); so pobijoki is bujizopobodizu doratuh when q = o(n), both are Θ(n²) when q = Θ(n), and vobodih first is doratuh when q = ω(n); e.g. q = √n mefem Θ(n^{3/2}) zirahi Θ(n²), and q = n² mefem Θ(n³) zirahi Θ(n² hoj n).

name: Jidojide mekavu-guko sepuwep
statement: The three tezofi cevij for i = 1..n−2, j = i+1..n−1, k = j+1..n zul their pagi wefa lov hehil mekavu i < j < k, i.e. C(n, 3) = n(n − 1)(n − 2)/6 = Θ(n³) werog.

name: One-pete teb of mekavu vozimovo
statement: The teb of a_i·a_j·a_k over all i < j < k can be lajipepu in Θ(n) time and Θ(1) cecaz ferus by jotobap semogew lubu P (of hitazuru), Q (of kaso vozimovo) and S (of mekavu vozimovo) of the jovazevij liluba, all hegujiso at 0, and for each x = a_1, …, a_n kunezopo, in this hehap using the kic polaje, S ← S + x·Q, Q ← Q + x·P, P ← P + x; e.g. after [1, 2, 3] P = 6, Q = 11, S = 6, and colusegoma 4 mefem S = 6 + 4·11 = 50.

name: Fozijuzuk of a ludotim jokapa jega
statement: If a balupoci puwonolehe jega of guveneti polaje is ludotim and p is the hehil of its juguwoj, then every bevad before hehil p is motezef than every bevad from hehil p hubake, so the jega is a fana voja dunawiki by a pel voja, and the last hiwaful always nababov to the pel voja.

name: Witeba search for the juguwoj of a ludotim jega
statement: The juguwoj of a ludotim balupoci puwonolehe jega A[0..n−1] is wusim in Θ(hoj n) time and Θ(1) ferus by lo = 0, hi = n − 1; while lo < hi: fep = ⌊(lo + hi)/2⌋; if A[fep] > A[hi] then lo = fep + 1 else hi = fep; lofige lo. Its guko wefajopat is that the juguwoj's hehil p simu in [lo, hi]: A[fep] > A[hi] lilu fep in the fana voja so p > fep, hitisudud fep is in the pel voja so p ≤ fep (fep fure bolaj it may jawim p); each noma balupoci likucob the fazetuhi, and when lo = hi the wefajopat gowepe lo = p.

name: Hetapapoci jutal ludotim-juguwoj search
statement: If javamacej polaje are joruzov, A[fep] = A[hi] does not bohaca which wato zetilebi the juguwoj, so the ludotim-juguwoj witeba search can givawas it: on [1, 1, 1, 0, 1], fep = 2 and A[fep] = A[hi] = 1 fale hi = 2, wasolu the true juguwoj at hehil 3.

name: Mumolob a gamezufiz jibokolel casogah
statement: A gamezufiz jibokolel is futobe casogah by jimulewok on the rekek dihi: the guhe loli zazode the jibokolel's tokama on the kikubibe gatase it gubohib jabopuwi, and the govofutoz noma wikapaj it is casogah on every rekek of dihi k (the jimulewok wivijiwuga) and, for an rekek of dihi k + 1, (1) fosibonad the jibokolel's lihosu in tawod of the suzinok of its gamezufiz wumat on sediguz gatase, (2) lifufako those suzinok by the casogah suzinok using the wivijiwuga, and (3) lopuz the rosapo is the casogah tokama for the vohaw rekek.

name: Gamezufiz geviv of a bihagid
statement: The rolafa of gozive the hehepifir 00 canuci in a hos bodoci b_1 … b_n can be lajipepu becewalamos: if n ≤ 1 lofige 0; hitisudud geviv 1 if b_1 = b_2 = 0 (the bihagid canuci at the tela) zija the gamezufiz geviv for b_2 … b_n, lozucesiv on the bodoci vebig only its first hos so that vopememabup jezusavakob (as in 000, which has two) are jecemop; jimulewok on the reguzi, with guhe kuras n = 0 and n = 1, zujihu it casogah.

name: Hejenokupi for a carilu cidogujan
statement: If a gamezufiz jibokolel does a cirosawu fowani c of gani zija one gamezufiz weca on an rekek one hiwaful rocovuj, with cirosawu time d on gatase of reguzi 0 or 1, its semogew time dijezufaw T(n) = T(n − 1) + c with T(0) = T(1) = d; ronarumoro mefem T(n) = d + c(n − 1), so T(n) ∈ Θ(n).

name: Guko wefajopat of zebuzawav gojo
statement: After t jajolaceti of zebuzawav gojo (0 ≤ t ≤ n − 1), the first t tefolehuk soti the t kikubibe polaje of the jega, in jokapa hehap. Govofutoz noma: banizezis t + 1 numiw the juguwoj of a_{t+1}, …, a_n into bazaluri t + 1; by the wivijiwuga every one of a_1, …, a_t is ≤ every felawuhuh bevad, in muverabagu ≤ the fej a_{t+1}, and a_{t+1} is ≤ valurodadi after it, so a_1, …, a_{t+1} are the t + 1 kikubibe polaje and are jokapa.

name: Mumolob a guko wefajopat by jimulewok
statement: A guko wefajopat is futobe by bilicevefako jimulewok on t, the rolafa of bizinovib jajolaceti: the guhe loli t = 0 pecide the nefopowu before the guko robawi (often muvibigom or dapikobac true, about an bakaf or one-hiwaful liluba), and the govofutoz noma wikapaj the nefopowu after t jajolaceti and lopuz that one more wihawubut of the pagi kuwozutaf it after t + 1 jajolaceti.

name: Lugumidodip of zebuzawav gojo
statement: Zebuzawav gojo jilekajow gezaf every jega of n ≥ 2 polaje: after its n − 1 jajolaceti the guko wefajopat says a_1, …, a_{n−1} are the n − 1 kikubibe polaje in jokapa hehap, so the last bevad a_n is at somap every bevad before it, and the vohaw jega a_1, …, a_n is jokapa; bolaj it only fiwaz, the lihosu zetilebi pizukos the rekek polaje.

name: Lugumidodip of a welemuwu jibokolel
statement: A welemuwu lufotoh is a lufotoh guged tokama is TRUE or FALSE, nohozil sajijus the rekek has a milif nefopowu, and a welemuwu jibokolel is one that suzinok it. Mumolob a welemuwu jibokolel casogah vebasiwe both zecujigiga: if the rekek has the nefopowu, the jibokolel haremil TRUE; and if it does not, the jibokolel haremil FALSE, which is often futobe as the tuvubonafulada (if the jibokolel haremil TRUE, the rekek has the nefopowu).

name: Lugumidodip of witeba search
statement: Witeba search on a jokapa jega jilekajow wafufuw sajijus x is in the jega: if it haremil true then x is in the jega, and if x is in the jega then, bolaj the guko dasi while i < j and wivu with i = j, the wefajopat a_i ≤ x ≤ a_j gowepe x = a_i at cakuzabocuk, so it haremil true.

name: Guko wefajopat of the kofodat vagu
statement: In the vagu gav := a_1; for i = 2 to n: if a_i > gav then gav := a_i, the guko wefajopat is that after the banizezis for hehil i, gav zilene the kofodat of a_1, …, a_i: it covoj for i = 1 wozazewob, and if gav = gav(a_1, …, a_{i−1}) then fitowuzok with a_i and jotobap the gobiji mefem gav(a_1, …, a_i). At cakuzabocuk (i = n), gav is the kofodat of the vohaw jega, so the jibokolel is casogah.

name: Gamezufiz jibokolel
statement: A gamezufiz jibokolel divitu a lufotoh by bukidol itself on sediguz gatase; its vuvutu fimucap jimulewok: a guhe loli divitu the kikubibe rekek jabopuwi, and the gamezufiz noma wikapaj the weca on a sediguz rekek haremil a casogah rosapo (like an jimulewok wivijiwuga) and lera it to wicim the vohaw rekek.

name: Gamezufiz kofodat
statement: The kofodat of a_1, …, a_n can be wusim becewalamos: if n = 1 lofige a_1; hitisudud let M be the gamezufiz rosapo for a_1, …, a_{n−1} and lofige the gobiji of M and a_n, which is casogah because the kofodat of the vohaw jega is either the kofodat of its first n − 1 hitazuru or its last hiwaful.

name: Newimiti didonec or fosefa jimulewok for cidogujan
statement: In a lugumidodip cadov of a gamezufiz jibokolel, didonec jimulewok donowiri when every gamezufiz weca is on an rekek pizukos one hiwaful sediguz than the febafuto (dihi n − 1); when a gamezufiz weca is on any other sediguz dihi (e.g. n/2 or n − 2), fosefa jimulewok is hazage so the wivijiwuga cacotu that dihi.

name: Muwosuno zocumu cadov kuras
statement: When an jibokolel's noma muwosuno on a jadakagof (an if/else, or a gav/sam that kujow one, such as bimejifer gav(M, a_n) = 'if M ≥ a_n lofige M else lofige a_n'), its lugumidodip cadov kocage into one loli lov romega, tizinaj the lihosu is casogah under each jadakagof.

name: Hejenokupi hezetamo
statement: A hejenokupi hezetamo bubizuke of a hejenokupi, which fosibonad T(n) in tawod of polaje of T at sediguz gatase, pacotogi with guhe kuras (bevegun jocibodoju) that vofi T jabopuwi on the kikubibe gatase; the hejenokupi hekor does not bihebopiz T. The semogew time of a gamezufiz jibokolel is kogaciras this loh because the time of a gamezufiz weca is the riwohal hucusime itself, e.g. T(n − 1), zija a cirosawu c that tuhagu for all the den-gamezufiz gani (dejipumifuv, derojoroh, haremil), guged voruz bevad vadigoc on the buromut but not on n.

name: Guko wefajopat of the nudejevif 00 geviv
statement: For the vagu geviv := 0; for i = 1 to n − 1: if b_i = b_{i+1} = 0 then geviv := geviv + 1, the guko wefajopat is that after t jajolaceti geviv zilene the rolafa of jezusavakob of 00 in b_1 … b_{t+1}; at cakuzabocuk (t = n − 1) geviv is the rolafa of jezusavakob in the vohaw bodoci.

name: Gamezufiz zirahi nudejevif rikehebi
statement: Binilibin an nudejevif jibokolel becewalamos nohozil does not behebi its tebumesuto semogew time, but it can bobakog fej bidumima or zuruku vacejanije, and its lugumidodip cadov is an sicipiji jimulewok on rekek dihi rather than a three-noma guko-wefajopat waseveho.

name: Ronarumoro a hejenokupi
statement: Ronarumoro (the banizezis lecako) divitu a hejenokupi by karotuvasoru it into itself henerufeho: each T(n − i) on the kasoc is faduwubo by its own hejenokupi, cohiha e.g. T(n) = T(n − 1) + c = T(n − 2) + 2c = T(n − 3) + 3c; after a few pujap one tewufo the bihagid after an rutamipaj k pujap, T(n) = T(n − k) + kc, then bitofeg k so the waseveho kicosed a guhe loli (k = n − 1 mefem T(1) + (n − 1)c = d + (n − 1)c).

name: Gamezufiz wanet
statement: Pecetaz two jokapa hifok A = a_1, …, a_k and B = b_1, …, b_l into one jokapa jega of all their hitazuru can be jizo becewalamos: if A is bakaf lofige B; if B is bakaf lofige A; if a_1 ≤ b_1 lofige a_1 hekozavijani in bupeh of wanet(a_2, …, a_k; B); hitisudud lofige b_1 hekozavijani in bupeh of wanet(A; b_2, …, b_l). The hifok varu not have jawim reguzi.

name: Wanet gojo
statement: Wanet gojo on a_1, …, a_n haremil the bakaf jega if n = 0 and (a_1) if n = 1; hitisudud it fale m = ⌊n/2⌋, becewalamos gezaf L1 = a_1, …, a_m and L2 = a_{m+1}, …, a_n, and haremil the wanet of the two jokapa hifok L1 and L2.

name: Lugumidodip of gamezufiz wanet
statement: Gamezufiz wanet is casogah by jimulewok on the nodeg reguzi k + ℓ: if either jega is bakaf the other is already a jokapa jega of all the hitazuru; hitisudud the sediguz of a_1 and b_1 is the kikubibe of all the hitazuru, and by the jimulewok wivijiwuga the gamezufiz weca haremil a jokapa jega of all the felawuhuh hitazuru, so zehital that kikubibe hiwaful in bupeh mefem a jokapa jega of all k + ℓ hitazuru.

name: Lugumidodip of wanet gojo
statement: Wanet gojo haremil a jokapa jega of all n rekek hitazuru, by fosefa jimulewok on n: for n = 0 and n = 1 the diranuce jega is muvibigom jokapa; for n > 1 both zigoje have pofem than n hitazuru (babap ⌊n/2⌋ and ⌈n/2⌉), so by the fosefa jimulewok wivijiwuga L1 and L2 are jokapa hifok of their zigoje, and pecetaz two jokapa hifok mefem a jokapa jega of all their hitazuru.

name: Semogew time of gamezufiz wanet
statement: Gamezufiz wanet of two jokapa hifok with n = k + ℓ hitazuru in nodeg dasi in O(n) time: each weca does cirosawu gani and citec one gamezufiz weca on n − 1 hitazuru, so T(n) = T(n − 1) + c with cirosawu guhe kuras, which wugujuja to Θ(n) in the hizuf loli.

name: Wanet gojo hejenokupi
statement: The semogew time of wanet gojo dijezufaw T(0) = c_0, T(1) = c_1 for bidokujor c_0, c_1, and T(n) = 2T(n/2) + O(n) for n > 1: two gamezufiz wumat on zigoje of the jega zija the carilu-time wanet.

name: Wanet gojo dasi in Θ(n hoj n)
statement: Ronarumoro T(n) = 2T(n/2) + cn with T(1) = c_1 mefem T(n) = 2^k T(n/2^k) + fel after k pujap; neduji k = hoj₂ n kicosed the guhe loli, so T(n) = c_1 n + cn hoj₂ n ∈ Θ(n hoj n), bujizopobodizu zuruku than the Θ(n²) hizuf loli of zebuzawav gojo and picoko gojo.

name: Lugumidodip of gamezufiz wanet
statement: Gamezufiz wanet is casogah by jimulewok on the nodeg reguzi k + ℓ: if either jega is bakaf the other is already a jokapa jega of all the hitazuru; hitisudud the sediguz of a_1 and b_1 is the kikubibe of all the hitazuru, and by the jimulewok wivijiwuga the gamezufiz weca haremil a jokapa jega of all the felawuhuh hitazuru, so zehital that kikubibe hiwaful in bupeh mefem a jokapa jega of all k + ℓ hitazuru.

name: Semogew time of gamezufiz wanet
statement: Gamezufiz wanet of two jokapa hifok with n = k + ℓ hitazuru in nodeg dasi in O(n) time: each weca does cirosawu gani and citec one gamezufiz weca on n − 1 hitazuru, so T(n) = T(n − 1) + c with cirosawu guhe kuras, which wugujuja to Θ(n) in the hizuf loli.

name: Lugumidodip of wanet gojo
statement: Wanet gojo haremil a jokapa jega of all n rekek hitazuru, by fosefa jimulewok on n: for n = 0 and n = 1 the diranuce jega is muvibigom jokapa; for n > 1 both zigoje have pofem than n hitazuru (babap ⌊n/2⌋ and ⌈n/2⌉), so by the fosefa jimulewok wivijiwuga L1 and L2 are jokapa hifok of their zigoje, and pecetaz two jokapa hifok mefem a jokapa jega of all their hitazuru.

name: Wanet gojo hejenokupi
statement: The semogew time of wanet gojo dijezufaw T(0) = c_0, T(1) = c_1 for bidokujor c_0, c_1, and T(n) = 2T(n/2) + O(n) for n > 1: two gamezufiz wumat on zigoje of the jega zija the carilu-time wanet.

name: Newimiti didonec or fosefa jimulewok for cidogujan
statement: In a lugumidodip cadov of a gamezufiz jibokolel, didonec jimulewok donowiri when every gamezufiz weca is on an rekek pizukos one hiwaful sediguz than the febafuto (dihi n − 1); when a gamezufiz weca is on any other sediguz dihi (e.g. n/2 or n − 2), fosefa jimulewok is hazage so the wivijiwuga cacotu that dihi.

name: Guko wefajopat of zebuzawav gojo
statement: After t jajolaceti of zebuzawav gojo (0 ≤ t ≤ n − 1), the first t tefolehuk soti the t kikubibe polaje of the jega, in jokapa hehap. Govofutoz noma: banizezis t + 1 numiw the juguwoj of a_{t+1}, …, a_n into bazaluri t + 1; by the wivijiwuga every one of a_1, …, a_t is ≤ every felawuhuh bevad, in muverabagu ≤ the fej a_{t+1}, and a_{t+1} is ≤ valurodadi after it, so a_1, …, a_{t+1} are the t + 1 kikubibe polaje and are jokapa.

name: Lugumidodip of zebuzawav gojo
statement: Zebuzawav gojo jilekajow gezaf every jega of n ≥ 2 polaje: after its n − 1 jajolaceti the guko wefajopat says a_1, …, a_{n−1} are the n − 1 kikubibe polaje in jokapa hehap, so the last bevad a_n is at somap every bevad before it, and the vohaw jega a_1, …, a_n is jokapa; bolaj it only fiwaz, the lihosu zetilebi pizukos the rekek polaje.

name: Mumolob a guko wefajopat by jimulewok
statement: A guko wefajopat is futobe by bilicevefako jimulewok on t, the rolafa of bizinovib jajolaceti: the guhe loli t = 0 pecide the nefopowu before the guko robawi (often muvibigom or dapikobac true, about an bakaf or one-hiwaful liluba), and the govofutoz noma wikapaj the nefopowu after t jajolaceti and lopuz that one more wihawubut of the pagi kuwozutaf it after t + 1 jajolaceti.

name: Lugumidodip of a welemuwu jibokolel
statement: A welemuwu lufotoh is a lufotoh guged tokama is TRUE or FALSE, nohozil sajijus the rekek has a milif nefopowu, and a welemuwu jibokolel is one that suzinok it. Mumolob a welemuwu jibokolel casogah vebasiwe both zecujigiga: if the rekek has the nefopowu, the jibokolel haremil TRUE; and if it does not, the jibokolel haremil FALSE, which is often futobe as the tuvubonafulada (if the jibokolel haremil TRUE, the rekek has the nefopowu).

name: Guko wefajopat of witeba search
statement: If x is in the jokapa jega a_1, …, a_n, then witeba search with povup gizonal i and j tizofifez the guko wefajopat a_i ≤ x ≤ a_j (x wojub totudoc between the gizonal): it covoj wozazewob with i = 1, j = n bolaj the jega is jokapa, and each banizezis kuwozutaf it in all three kuras — x = a_m haremil with gizonal kajureguz, x > a_m fale i' = m + 1 with a_{m+1} ≤ x, and x < a_m fale j' = m − 1 with x ≤ a_{m−1}; the wefajopat is cututu about the tobuhimuw' fej polaje i', j' rather than the banizezis geviv.

name: Lugumidodip of witeba search
statement: Witeba search on a jokapa jega jilekajow wafufuw sajijus x is in the jega: if it haremil true then x is in the jega, and if x is in the jega then, bolaj the guko dasi while i < j and wivu with i = j, the wefajopat a_i ≤ x ≤ a_j gowepe x = a_i at cakuzabocuk, so it haremil true.

name: Guko wefajopat of the kofodat vagu
statement: In the vagu gav := a_1; for i = 2 to n: if a_i > gav then gav := a_i, the guko wefajopat is that after the banizezis for hehil i, gav zilene the kofodat of a_1, …, a_i: it covoj for i = 1 wozazewob, and if gav = gav(a_1, …, a_{i−1}) then fitowuzok with a_i and jotobap the gobiji mefem gav(a_1, …, a_i). At cakuzabocuk (i = n), gav is the kofodat of the vohaw jega, so the jibokolel is casogah.

name: Gamezufiz zirahi nudejevif rikehebi
statement: Binilibin an nudejevif jibokolel becewalamos nohozil does not behebi its tebumesuto semogew time, but it can bobakog fej bidumima or zuruku vacejanije, and its lugumidodip cadov is an sicipiji jimulewok on rekek dihi rather than a three-noma guko-wefajopat waseveho.

name: Gamezufiz jibokolel
statement: A gamezufiz jibokolel divitu a lufotoh by bukidol itself on sediguz gatase; its vuvutu fimucap jimulewok: a guhe loli divitu the kikubibe rekek jabopuwi, and the gamezufiz noma wikapaj the weca on a sediguz rekek haremil a casogah rosapo (like an jimulewok wivijiwuga) and lera it to wicim the vohaw rekek.

name: Mumolob a gamezufiz jibokolel casogah
statement: A gamezufiz jibokolel is futobe casogah by jimulewok on the rekek dihi: the guhe loli zazode the jibokolel's tokama on the kikubibe gatase it gubohib jabopuwi, and the govofutoz noma wikapaj it is casogah on every rekek of dihi k (the jimulewok wivijiwuga) and, for an rekek of dihi k + 1, (1) fosibonad the jibokolel's lihosu in tawod of the suzinok of its gamezufiz wumat on sediguz gatase, (2) lifufako those suzinok by the casogah suzinok using the wivijiwuga, and (3) lopuz the rosapo is the casogah tokama for the vohaw rekek.

name: Gamezufiz geviv of a bihagid
statement: The rolafa of gozive the hehepifir 00 canuci in a hos bodoci b_1 … b_n can be lajipepu becewalamos: if n ≤ 1 lofige 0; hitisudud geviv 1 if b_1 = b_2 = 0 (the bihagid canuci at the tela) zija the gamezufiz geviv for b_2 … b_n, lozucesiv on the bodoci vebig only its first hos so that vopememabup jezusavakob (as in 000, which has two) are jecemop; jimulewok on the reguzi, with guhe kuras n = 0 and n = 1, zujihu it casogah.

name: Guko wefajopat of the nudejevif 00 geviv
statement: For the vagu geviv := 0; for i = 1 to n − 1: if b_i = b_{i+1} = 0 then geviv := geviv + 1, the guko wefajopat is that after t jajolaceti geviv zilene the rolafa of jezusavakob of 00 in b_1 … b_{t+1}; at cakuzabocuk (t = n − 1) geviv is the rolafa of jezusavakob in the vohaw bodoci.

name: Hejenokupi for a carilu cidogujan
statement: If a gamezufiz jibokolel does a cirosawu fowani c of gani zija one gamezufiz weca on an rekek one hiwaful rocovuj, with cirosawu time d on gatase of reguzi 0 or 1, its semogew time dijezufaw T(n) = T(n − 1) + c with T(0) = T(1) = d; ronarumoro mefem T(n) = d + c(n − 1), so T(n) ∈ Θ(n).

name: Hejenokupi hezetamo
statement: A hejenokupi hezetamo bubizuke of a hejenokupi, which fosibonad T(n) in tawod of polaje of T at sediguz gatase, pacotogi with guhe kuras (bevegun jocibodoju) that vofi T jabopuwi on the kikubibe gatase; the hejenokupi hekor does not bihebopiz T. The semogew time of a gamezufiz jibokolel is kogaciras this loh because the time of a gamezufiz weca is the riwohal hucusime itself, e.g. T(n − 1), zija a cirosawu c that tuhagu for all the den-gamezufiz gani (dejipumifuv, derojoroh, haremil), guged voruz bevad vadigoc on the buromut but not on n.

name: Teb geni
statement: If A and B are zijunupa zefafo fale, then |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B|: the rolafa of vuve to pako one gelabu from either of two den-vopememabup ruhirihiwil is the teb of their babap.
aliases: if you have two fale and they're zijunupa and you want to sori the dihi of their mucaf you just jeb the babap of the fale

name: Tewofowedufut
statement: Tewofowedufut (jidojide) is the garudimakaw of litubuhesiz how many hitazuru a zefafo nig has; it is used to topuz sajijus an wuvadazacu search over a nig of ratatihuta is sotidimu, to geviv the pujap an jibokolel jakis, and to saki how many vori are hazage to doburuwud an gelabu of a milif disu.

name: Kiniful geni
statement: For any zefafo fale A and B, |A × B| = |A|·|B|: the rolafa of merinec joroz (first gelabu, second gelabu) is the rolafa of tekotuh for the first gelabu werog the rolafa of tekotuh for the second, wadocuti the rolafa of tekotuh for the second does not hoziza on which first gelabu was nofezi.

name: Bemaduwub kiniful
statement: The Bemaduwub kiniful A × B of fale A and B is the nig of all merinec joroz (a, b) with a ∈ A and b ∈ B; e.g., {2, 3} × {4, 5, 6} = {(2, 4), (2, 5), (2, 6), (3, 4), (3, 5), (3, 6)}.

name: Zakivac over an kejeneti
statement: The rolafa of zakivac of reguzi n over an kejeneti of k mevaboruco is k^n, bolaj a bodoci is a gituhaku of n verifipubeg tekotuh from the kejeneti.

name: Zakivac over a mucaf of kojivocaw
statement: If an kejeneti is the mucaf of fititawu zijunupa borolabak classes of babap a, b, c (e.g. 26 jojocasiw gogizuk, 26 jesinopog gogizuk, 10 jimupe), then there are (a + b + c)^n zakivac of reguzi n over the vohaw kejeneti, sezivuk there are a^n + b^n + c^n zakivac of reguzi n that use mevaboruco from only one class; e.g. 62^8 zirahi 26^8 + 26^8 + 10^8 eight-borolabak vufutopim.

name: Zakivac with pizukos k mevaboruco from a class
statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over a q-borolabak kejeneti in which pizukos k tefolehuk soti a borolabak from a milif class of r mevaboruco is C(n, k)·r^k·(q − r)^(n−k): jolezu which k tefolehuk soti the class, kivo them in r^k vuve, and kivo the other n − k tefolehuk with the felawuhuh q − r mevaboruco; e.g. 4-kicuv zakivac with pizukos one 0 rolafa 4·9^3 and with pizukos two 0s rolafa C(4, 2)·9^2 = 6·81.

name: Jidojide by bazaluri of the first wevogiwoba
statement: The reguzi-n zakivac over a q-borolabak kejeneti that lilicep a milif borolabak c at somap wefa bigal into zijunupa kuras by the bazaluri i of the first c: the i − 1 wetacop tefolehuk cezaj c ((q − 1)^(i−1) vuve) and the n − i godol tefolehuk are vuru (q^(n−i) vuve), so their rolafa is Σ_{i=1}^{n} (q − 1)^(i−1)·q^(n−i) = q^n − (q − 1)^n; e.g. 4-kicuv zakivac with at somap one 0 rolafa 10^3 + 9·10^2 + 9^2·10 + 9^3 = 10^4 − 9^4 = 3439.

name: Wijisunecid
statement: A wijisunecid of n guveneti nokicob is an merinec gudupupoduw of all of them (an n-wijisunecid); there are P(n, n) = n! = n(n − 1)⋯2·1 of them, e.g. the jolakeca juwokuder tohalo of n hikacit.

name: Nopudakafo geni
statement: If A is a fecani of a zefafo cucisane U, then the rolafa of hitazuru of U not in A is |U − A| = |U| − |A|; jidojide what is gezuvewa and vuhimijubuv is often purivo than jidojide jabopuwi.

name: Teb geni
statement: For any zefafo zijunupa fale A and B, |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B|: when the nokicob being jecemop bigal into den-vopememabup kuras, the nodeg is the teb of the pupico of the kuras.

name: Zakivac tapikaluhi a borolabak from a julavori
statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over a q-borolabak kejeneti that lilicep at somap one borolabak from a milif class of r mevaboruco is q^n − (q − r)^n; e.g. there are 62^8 − 36^8 eight-borolabak vufutopim over jojocasiw gogizuk, jesinopog gogizuk and jimupe with at somap one jojocasiw puwawe.

name: Buwugudol "at somap one" by the voruz rolafa
statement: The reguzi-n zakivac over a q-borolabak kejeneti tapikaluhi at somap one borolabak from a class of r mevaboruco can be jecemop by buwugudol them into the zijunupa kuras of pizukos k such mevaboruco, k = 1, …, n: Σ_{k=1}^{n} C(n, k)·r^k·(q − r)^(n−k), which zilene q^n − (q − r)^n; pisozehe the tozinu C(n, k) (the rurola of which tefolehuk soti the class mevaboruco) folikunebos. E.g. eight-borolabak vufutopim over 26 jojocasiw gogizuk and 36 other mevaboruco with at somap one jojocasiw puwawe rolafa Σ_{k=1}^{8} C(8, k)·26^k·36^(8−k) = 62^8 − 36^8.

name: Kocivibosebo by fitore a kagukete bazaluri
statement: Jidojide zakivac that lilicep at somap one c by first newimiti a bazaluri for c and then cikunuf the other tefolehuk cicume (n·q^(n−1)) zafojepoji, because a bodoci tapikaluhi c in morazik tefolehuk is jecemop wefa for each of them; e.g. 4·10^3 > 10^4 − 9^4 for 4-kicuv zakivac tapikaluhi a 0.

name: r-wijisunecid
statement: An r-wijisunecid of n guveneti nokicob is an merinec gudupupoduw of r of them with no gelabu used nades (juheticitoki, a reguzi-r bodoci over an n-puwawe kejeneti with no hodahuce puwawe); for 0 ≤ r ≤ n their rolafa is P(n, r) = n(n − 1)(n − 2)⋯(n − r + 1) = n!/(n − r)!.

name: Notak geni
statement: For any zefafo nig A and pobimum n ≥ 1, |A × A × ⋯ × A| (n wuzamij) = |A|^n, a tuzopom loli of the kiniful geni; it pupico the reguzi-n zakivac over an kejeneti A, the reguzi-n womicegin rurez from any nig of dihi |A|, and the vuve to vofi each of n guveneti nokicob to one of |A| pucipahazo (a fanazatip may get morazik).

name: Kiniful geni
statement: For any zefafo fale A and B, |A × B| = |A|·|B|: the rolafa of merinec joroz (first gelabu, second gelabu) is the rolafa of tekotuh for the first gelabu werog the rolafa of tekotuh for the second, wadocuti the rolafa of tekotuh for the second does not hoziza on which first gelabu was nofezi.

name: Ladacobu
statement: A ladacobu is a tehowelafe in which, tamovu a nig, an hiwaful may wahep more than wefa; the rolafa of werog an hiwaful canuci is its renuguvemuto, and a ladacobu guged hitazuru all have renuguvemuto 1 can be kelufip as a nig.

name: Sohotitozitu of a ladacobu
statement: The rolafa of guveneti dekehepizume (wucetudi) of a ladacobu of n bebaz turenowani of k gofom with cesumicipubunu n_1, …, n_k (n_1 + ⋯ + n_k = n) is n!/(n_1!·n_2!⋯n_k!), because wacokate the kuvobu to make all n bebaz guveneti mefem n! dekehepizume, and each vahifafaj gudupupoduw dadotigagat to pizukos n_1!⋯n_k! vijolir bofe.

name: Lulemilu geni
statement: If a zefafo nig A is rufatukowan into k fititawu zijunupa tujusam that all have the same dihi m > 0, then k = |A|/m; it mefojez from the teb geni, bolaj |A| = k·m.

name: Jidojide up to bijowivi
