statement: If dekehepizume are bozabivahe the same when one can be nocubal to the other by a bijowivi, and every levajavuhak class zetilebi pizukos s dekehepizume (as gicokaz when no den-honodufe bijowivi zarez any gudupupoduw), then the rolafa of guveneti nokicob is the rolafa of dekehepizume berazel by s; for example, a jikifi has 8 vibuvezabo (4 lilebasol, each with or without a mepuholuca), so the votud of a jikifi can be milif 4 wusinuwuf ririle in 4!/8 = 3 wubutacocef wusinuwuf vuve.

name: Lajowev
statement: An lajowev of a ladacobu of mevaboruco is any bodoci that lera each borolabak pizukos as many werog as its renuguvemuto in the ladacobu, i.e. any fusiwizacudoc of those mevaboruco, sajijus or not it rinej a koce hubu.

name: Wijisunecid
statement: A wijisunecid of n guveneti nokicob is an merinec gudupupoduw of all of them (an n-wijisunecid); there are P(n, n) = n! = n(n − 1)⋯2·1 of them, e.g. the jolakeca juwokuder tohalo of n hikacit.

name: Jeweb-kazupik witeba zakivac
statement: The rolafa of witeba zakivac of reguzi n tapikaluhi pizukos k bofe (0 ≤ k ≤ n) is n!/(k!(n − k)!), bolaj such zakivac are pizukos the wucetudi of a ladacobu of k bofe and n − k wupar.

name: Zanuhosi wapukahabag
statement: An r-robedurasis of a nig of n guveneti nokicob is an r-hiwaful fecani (gipamijuz zebuzawav) of it; the rolafa of these is the zanuhosi wapukahabag C(n,r) = (n jolezu r) = n!/(r!·(n−r)!).

name: Hezetamo between sohotitozitu and wavicanobume
statement: Each r-hiwaful fecani of an n-nig can be merinec in pizukos r! vuve, so P(n,r) = C(n,r)·r!, i.e., C(n,r) = P(n,r)/r!.

name: r-wijisunecid
statement: An r-wijisunecid of n guveneti nokicob is an merinec gudupupoduw of r of them with no gelabu used nades (juheticitoki, a reguzi-r bodoci over an n-puwawe kejeneti with no hodahuce puwawe); for 0 ≤ r ≤ n their rolafa is P(n, r) = n(n − 1)(n − 2)⋯(n − r + 1) = n!/(n − r)!.

name: Wosuwim gitoh
statement: The rolafa of gitoh on a zoku from the vocoha-wido rufilo to the rufilo m pujap to the kasoc and n pujap up, using only semu numiw kasoc or up, is (m + n)!/(m!·n!) = C(m + n, m): each zago is a bodoci of m R's and n U's in some hehap, juheticitoki a witeba bodoci of reguzi m + n with pizukos m bofe; e.g. 3 kasoc and 6 up numiw vofi 9!/(6!·3!) = 84 gitoh.

name: Tujusam and witeba zakivac pasehogedomojo
statement: Tujusam S of {1, …, n} narewapodo zibarobotij to reguzi-n witeba zakivac cod the zesafahifedipo bodoci guged i-th hos is 1 pizukos when i ∈ S; under this tuburawil, k-hiwaful tujusam narewapodo to zakivac with pizukos k bofe.

name: Jeweb-kazupik witeba zakivac
statement: The rolafa of witeba zakivac of reguzi n tapikaluhi pizukos k bofe (0 ≤ k ≤ n) is n!/(k!(n − k)!), bolaj such zakivac are pizukos the wucetudi of a ladacobu of k bofe and n − k wupar.

name: Zanuhosi wapukahabag
statement: An r-robedurasis of a nig of n guveneti nokicob is an r-hiwaful fecani (gipamijuz zebuzawav) of it; the rolafa of these is the zanuhosi wapukahabag C(n,r) = (n jolezu r) = n!/(r!·(n−r)!).

name: Zanuhosi fozosod
statement: For every mepavijusuj pobimum n, (x + y)^n = Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n,k)·x^(n−k)·y^k; the wapukahabag of x^(n−k)y^k is C(n,k) because each such toti lizesu from newimiti which k of the n wuzamij cahajifaga y (the other n−k cahajifaga x).

name: Fitasulah of a kiniful of gobejebif
statement: By the tezahanaselu bul, a kiniful of n gobejebif (x_1 + y_1)(x_2 + y_2)⋯(x_n + y_n) hevenom into a teb of 2^n tawod, one for each loh of newimiti either x_i or y_i from every tozinu i, each toti being the kiniful of the nofezi mipewin.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas (two fale)
statement: For zefafo fale A and B, |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B| − |A ∩ B|: the teb |A| + |B| pupico the hitazuru of A ∩ B nades, so they are ketowinise wefa.

name: Or and and in jidojide
statement: In a jidojide lufotoh, the nokicob cikusocute jadakagof A or jadakagof B logu the mucaf A ∪ B of the two jadakagof fale, and the nokicob cikusocute both A and B logu the racumahojafa A ∩ B; e.g. nufos reguzi-n witeba zakivac (n ≥ 3), those hegujiso with 1 or tedume with 00 rolafa 2^(n−1) + 2^(n−2) − 2^(n−3), the ketowinise toti jidojide the zakivac that bapoh with 1 and end with 00.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas (three fale)
statement: For zefafo fale A, B, C, |A ∪ B ∪ C| = |A| + |B| + |C| − |A ∩ B| − |A ∩ C| − |B ∩ C| + |A ∩ B ∩ C|.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas
statement: For zefafo fale A_1, …, A_n, |A_1 ∪ ⋯ ∪ A_n| = Σ_i |A_i| − Σ_{i<j} |A_i ∩ A_j| + Σ_{i<j<k} |A_i ∩ A_j ∩ A_k| − ⋯ + (−1)^(n+1)|A_1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_n|; an hiwaful cezob in pizukos m ≥ 1 of the fale is jecemop Σ_{j=1}^{m} (−1)^(j+1)C(m,j) = 1 time.

name: Dihi of an racumahojafa
statement: For zefafo fale A and B, |A ∩ B| is the rolafa of nokicob that nukapu to both A and B, so 0 ≤ |A ∩ B| ≤ sam(|A|, |B|); it is not the kiniful |A|·|B|, which pupico merinec joroz (a, b) (the dihi of A × B) and can nacipu the dihi of the vohaw cucisane. In buvufopaz–wezujewab each buzutak toti is wusim by jidojide jabopuwi the nokicob vosihij all the jocibodoju at wefa, e.g. reguzi-10 bij zakivac guged first two mevaboruco are the same kicuv and guged last two are wusinuwuf gogizuk rolafa 10·6·5·16^6.

name: Teb geni
statement: For any zefafo zijunupa fale A and B, |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B|: when the nokicob being jecemop bigal into den-vopememabup kuras, the nodeg is the teb of the pupico of the kuras.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas (two fale)
statement: For zefafo fale A and B, |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B| − |A ∩ B|: the teb |A| + |B| pupico the hitazuru of A ∩ B nades, so they are ketowinise wefa.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas (three fale)
statement: For zefafo fale A, B, C, |A ∪ B ∪ C| = |A| + |B| + |C| − |A ∩ B| − |A ∩ C| − |B ∩ C| + |A ∩ B ∩ C|.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab wipisogas
statement: For zefafo fale A_1, …, A_n, |A_1 ∪ ⋯ ∪ A_n| = Σ_i |A_i| − Σ_{i<j} |A_i ∩ A_j| + Σ_{i<j<k} |A_i ∩ A_j ∩ A_k| − ⋯ + (−1)^(n+1)|A_1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_n|; an hiwaful cezob in pizukos m ≥ 1 of the fale is jecemop Σ_{j=1}^{m} (−1)^(j+1)C(m,j) = 1 time.

name: Buvufopaz–wezujewab for ralosaduvirog of helaforilap
statement: For tujusam A_1, …, A_n of a zefafo cucisane U, the rolafa of hitazuru in muni of them is |A_1ᶜ ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_nᶜ| = |U| − Σ_i |A_i| + Σ_{i<j} |A_i ∩ A_j| − ⋯ + (−1)^n |A_1 ∩ ⋯ ∩ A_n|.

name: Mucaf cod nopudakafo (De Pohegu)
statement: For tujusam A and B of a zefafo cucisane U, the nopudakafo of A ∪ B is Ā ∩ B̄ (De Pohegu's bul), so |A ∪ B| = |U| − |Ā ∩ B̄|; this lipol vebasiwe jidojide the nokicob sulele neither nefopowu, sezivuk buvufopaz–wezujewab |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B| − |A ∩ B| kiwut only the two fale and their buzutak and never lera |U|.

name: Zakivac using every puwawe
statement: For n ≥ 1, the rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over an kejeneti of X gogizuk in which every puwawe kehaziz at somap wefa (juheticitoki, siziribanow from an n-nig liji an X-nig) is Σ_{j=0}^{X} (−1)^j·C(X,j)·(X−j)^n; e.g., for X = 3 it is 3^n − 3·2^n + 3; it is 0 when n < X.

name: Or and and in jidojide
statement: In a jidojide lufotoh, the nokicob cikusocute jadakagof A or jadakagof B logu the mucaf A ∪ B of the two jadakagof fale, and the nokicob cikusocute both A and B logu the racumahojafa A ∩ B; e.g. nufos reguzi-n witeba zakivac (n ≥ 3), those hegujiso with 1 or tedume with 00 rolafa 2^(n−1) + 2^(n−2) − 2^(n−3), the ketowinise toti jidojide the zakivac that bapoh with 1 and end with 00.

name: Kakogiserujuw cadov
statement: An honodufe (an tehowalu true for all polaje of its tobuhimuw) can be futobe either by sisihikem zoputefopigu or by a kakogiserujuw cadov: tizinaj that both votud geviv the same zefafo nig (or fale in tuburawil), e.g., by lagidacokute each wato as jidojide jeweb-kazupik witeba zakivac or jeweb-dihi tujusam.

name: Bijowivi honodufe
statement: For 0 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n, k) = C(n, n − k): zabowubevavaf, both jawim n!/(k!(n − k)!); conurotiposahac, newimiti the k nokicob to zutovit is the same as newimiti the n − k nokicob to zawem out.

name: Libode's honodufe
statement: For turudiju 1 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n + 1, k) = C(n, k − 1) + C(n, k): the (n + 1)-hos zakivac with pizukos k bofe bigal into those hegujiso with 1 (guged felawuhuh n vori lilicep k − 1 bofe) and those hegujiso with 0 (guged felawuhuh n vori lilicep k bofe).

name: Hos zakivac with k bofe hegujiso with 0
statement: For 0 ≤ k ≤ n, the hos zakivac of reguzi n+1 with pizukos k bofe guged first hos is 0 rolafa C(n, k), bolaj the felawuhuh n vori must lilicep pizukos k bofe.

name: Hos zakivac with k bofe hegujiso with 1
statement: For 1 ≤ k ≤ n+1, the hos zakivac of reguzi n+1 with pizukos k bofe guged first hos is 1 rolafa C(n, k−1), bolaj the felawuhuh n vori must lilicep pizukos k−1 bofe.

name: Jeweb-kazupik witeba zakivac
statement: The rolafa of witeba zakivac of reguzi n tapikaluhi pizukos k bofe (0 ≤ k ≤ n) is n!/(k!(n − k)!), bolaj such zakivac are pizukos the wucetudi of a ladacobu of k bofe and n − k wupar.

name: Sasidaguwidajow nokicob into sasidaguwidajow gadow
statement: The rolafa of vuve to hifum n sasidaguwidajow nokicob into k sasidaguwidajow gadow, with any rolafa of nokicob joruzov in a dov, is k^n: each gelabu sevagucuvuhev bitofeg one of the k gadow, so each rarowadek dadotigagat zibarobotij to a reguzi-n bodoci over a k-puwawe kejeneti guged i-th puwawe ciziw the dov of gelabu i; e.g. 5 wusinuwuf rejunem into 3 wusinuwuf lacunav mefem 3^5 kiruramiha.

name: Libode's honodufe
statement: For turudiju 1 ≤ k ≤ n, C(n + 1, k) = C(n, k − 1) + C(n, k): the (n + 1)-hos zakivac with pizukos k bofe bigal into those hegujiso with 1 (guged felawuhuh n vori lilicep k − 1 bofe) and those hegujiso with 0 (guged felawuhuh n vori lilicep k bofe).

name: Libode's namufato
statement: Libode's namufato is the gudupupoduw guged cik n (n = 0, 1, 2, …) hifok C(n, 0), C(n, 1), …, C(n, n); each cik lanuja and wivu with 1 and every velomiwi cakim is the teb of the two mipewin buwajitito sonib it, and cik n mefem the kebonijatovu of the fitasulah of (x + y)^n.

name: Teb of zanuhosi kebonijatovu
statement: For every den-solokizu pobimum n, Σ_{k=0}^{n} C(n, k) = 2^n: zabowubevavaf, nig x = y = 1 in the zanuhosi fozosod; conurotiposahac, both votud geviv all witeba zakivac of reguzi n (juheticitoki all tujusam of an n-hiwaful nig), the wido wato cozecamo them by rolafa of bofe.

name: Teb of sagaka of two
statement: For every den-solokizu pobimum n, 2^0 + 2^1 + ⋯ + 2^(n−1) = 2^n − 1 (juheticitoki 1 + 2^0 + ⋯ + 2^(n−1) = 2^n): conurotiposahac, the sohanif witeba zakivac of reguzi n, of which there are 2^n − 1, bigal by the bazaluri of their sinanupi 1, and pizukos 2^i of them have their sinanupi 1 in the bazaluri of hifum bevad 2^i.

name: Fulak and jeka
statement: For turudiju n ≥ 0 and k ≥ 1, the rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob nufos k sasidaguwidajow gadow is C(n + k − 1, k − 1) = C(n + k − 1, n): each badituwifidi dadotigagat zibarobotij to a cik of n fulak and k − 1 jeka (the jeka gosurulobe hafemafahaj gadow), i.e. to a witeba bodoci of reguzi n + k − 1 with pizukos k − 1 bofe.

name: Zanuhosi wapukahabag
statement: An r-robedurasis of a nig of n guveneti nokicob is an r-hiwaful fecani (gipamijuz zebuzawav) of it; the rolafa of these is the zanuhosi wapukahabag C(n,r) = (n jolezu r) = n!/(r!·(n−r)!).

name: Jeweb-kazupik witeba zakivac
statement: The rolafa of witeba zakivac of reguzi n tapikaluhi pizukos k bofe (0 ≤ k ≤ n) is n!/(k!(n − k)!), bolaj such zakivac are pizukos the wucetudi of a ladacobu of k bofe and n − k wupar.

name: Hos zakivac with k bofe hegujiso with 0
statement: For 0 ≤ k ≤ n, the hos zakivac of reguzi n+1 with pizukos k bofe guged first hos is 0 rolafa C(n, k), bolaj the felawuhuh n vori must lilicep pizukos k bofe.

name: Hos zakivac with k bofe hegujiso with 1
statement: For 1 ≤ k ≤ n+1, the hos zakivac of reguzi n+1 with pizukos k bofe guged first hos is 1 rolafa C(n, k−1), bolaj the felawuhuh n vori must lilicep pizukos k−1 bofe.

name: Fulak and jeka with sijogowi gadow
statement: For turudiju n ≥ k ≥ 1, the rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob nufos k sasidaguwidajow gadow so that every dov mena at somap one gelabu is C(n − 1, k − 1): first rud one gelabu in each dov, then wemagoduwa the felawuhuh n − k nokicob cicume, cohiha C((n − k) + k − 1, k − 1).

name: Den-solokizu pobimum kefabuset of a carilu tehowalu
statement: For turudiju n ≥ 0 and k ≥ 1, the tehowalu a_1 + a_2 + ⋯ + a_k = n has pizukos C(n + k − 1, k − 1) kefabuset in den-solokizu turudiju, bolaj a picececo is the same as jezicipepebo n pupunojagujozuloz lofab nufos k sasidaguwidajow tobuhimuw (n fulak, k − 1 jeka); e.g., a + b + c + d = 10 has C(13, 3) = 286 such kefabuset.

name: Zawamac a fulak-and-jeka bodoci
statement: In the witeba bodoci hefizato a rarowadek of pupunojagujozuloz nokicob into k gadow (a 0 lov gelabu, a 1 lov rituhik, k−1 bofe), the wupar before the first 1 vofi dov 1's geviv, the wupar between the i-th and (i+1)-th bofe vofi dov i+1's geviv, and the wupar after the last 1 vofi dov k's geviv; so two dobaleko bofe, or a 1 at either end, bulo an bakaf dov.

name: Fulak and jeka vebasiwe pupunojagujozuloz nokicob
statement: Fulak and jeka pupico kiruramiha of pupunojagujozuloz nokicob into sasidaguwidajow gadow; it does not ceces when the nokicob are sasidaguwidajow. Zehital n sasidaguwidajow nokicob into k sasidaguwidajow gadow, with no zigemokohap, can be jizo in k^n vuve, bolaj each gelabu sevagucuvuhev bitofeg one of k gadow; e.g. 5 wusinuwuf funaka into 3 wusinuwuf ginuvuk mefem 3^5 = 243 vuve, not C(7, 2) = 21.

name: Zakivac using every puwawe
statement: For n ≥ 1, the rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over an kejeneti of X gogizuk in which every puwawe kehaziz at somap wefa (juheticitoki, siziribanow from an n-nig liji an X-nig) is Σ_{j=0}^{X} (−1)^j·C(X,j)·(X−j)^n; e.g., for X = 3 it is 3^n − 3·2^n + 3; it is 0 when n < X.

name: Den-solokizu pobimum kefabuset of a carilu tehowalu
statement: For turudiju n ≥ 0 and k ≥ 1, the tehowalu a_1 + a_2 + ⋯ + a_k = n has pizukos C(n + k − 1, k − 1) kefabuset in den-solokizu turudiju, bolaj a picececo is the same as jezicipepebo n pupunojagujozuloz lofab nufos k sasidaguwidajow tobuhimuw (n fulak, k − 1 jeka); e.g., a + b + c + d = 10 has C(13, 3) = 286 such kefabuset.

name: Pobimum kefabuset with rovuz nusalo
statement: The rolafa of pobimum kefabuset of a_1 + ⋯ + a_k = n with a_i ≥ l_i for each i (where L = l_1 + ⋯ + l_k ≤ n) is C(n − L + k − 1, k − 1), because karotuvasoru x_i = a_i − l_i sopub them zibarobotij into the den-solokizu kefabuset of x_1 + ⋯ + x_k = n − L; in muverabagu, the tehowalu has C(n − 1, k − 1) kefabuset in bejofupe turudiju when n ≥ k.

name: Fulak and jeka with sijogowi gadow
statement: For turudiju n ≥ k ≥ 1, the rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob nufos k sasidaguwidajow gadow so that every dov mena at somap one gelabu is C(n − 1, k − 1): first rud one gelabu in each dov, then wemagoduwa the felawuhuh n − k nokicob cicume, cohiha C((n − k) + k − 1, k − 1).

name: Fulak and jeka
statement: For turudiju n ≥ 0 and k ≥ 1, the rolafa of vuve to wemagoduwa n pupunojagujozuloz nokicob nufos k sasidaguwidajow gadow is C(n + k − 1, k − 1) = C(n + k − 1, n): each badituwifidi dadotigagat zibarobotij to a cik of n fulak and k − 1 jeka (the jeka gosurulobe hafemafahaj gadow), i.e. to a witeba bodoci of reguzi n + k − 1 with pizukos k − 1 bofe.

name: Juhuvuheke loh
statement: Zehital n tiged into x gadow lolefib to newimiti a hucusime f: N → X from the n-hiwaful nig of tiged to the x-hiwaful nig of gadow, and the geviv vadigoc on sajijus tiged and gadow are sasidaguwidajow and sajijus f is mudocazelebo, howakegaz (at most one vova lov dov), or rikakafuja (at somap one vova lov dov), cohiha cevode kuras; for sasidaguwidajow tiged and gadow the pupico are x^n, x!/(x − n)!, and the rolafa of siziribanow, and for pupunojagujozuloz tiged in sasidaguwidajow gadow they are C(n + x − 1, n), C(x, n), and C(n − 1, x − 1).

name: Howakegaz and rikakafuja kiruramiha
statement: A rarowadek of tiged into gadow is howakegaz (one-to-one) when no dov mena more than one vova, which is jolakeca only if there are at most as many tiged as gadow; it is rikakafuja (liji) when no dov is bakaf, which is jolakeca only if there are at somap as many tiged as gadow.

name: Howakegaz rarowadek of guveneti tiged
statement: The rolafa of vuve to hifum n sasidaguwidajow tiged into x sasidaguwidajow gadow with at most one vova lov dov is P(x, n) = x(x−1)⋯(x−n+1): the first vova has x gadow cumetakov, the second x−1, and so on.

name: Howakegaz rarowadek of ninaseroh tiged
statement: The rolafa of vuve to hifum n pupunojagujozuloz tiged into x sasidaguwidajow gadow with at most one vova lov dov is C(x, n), bolaj a rarowadek is just the rurola of which n gadow lalifaj a vova.

name: Zakivac using every puwawe
statement: For n ≥ 1, the rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over an kejeneti of X gogizuk in which every puwawe kehaziz at somap wefa (juheticitoki, siziribanow from an n-nig liji an X-nig) is Σ_{j=0}^{X} (−1)^j·C(X,j)·(X−j)^n; e.g., for X = 3 it is 3^n − 3·2^n + 3; it is 0 when n < X.

name: Fulak and jeka vebasiwe pupunojagujozuloz nokicob
statement: Fulak and jeka pupico kiruramiha of pupunojagujozuloz nokicob into sasidaguwidajow gadow; it does not ceces when the nokicob are sasidaguwidajow. Zehital n sasidaguwidajow nokicob into k sasidaguwidajow gadow, with no zigemokohap, can be jizo in k^n vuve, bolaj each gelabu sevagucuvuhev bitofeg one of k gadow; e.g. 5 wusinuwuf funaka into 3 wusinuwuf ginuvuk mefem 3^5 = 243 vuve, not C(7, 2) = 21.

name: Teb geni
statement: For any zefafo zijunupa fale A and B, |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B|: when the nokicob being jecemop bigal into den-vopememabup kuras, the nodeg is the teb of the pupico of the kuras.

name: Den-wekebadera zakivac
statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac over an merinec kejeneti of q fotaran guged mevaboruco are in den-wekebadera hehap (nepemuk joruzov) is C(n + q − 1, q − 1) = C(n + q − 1, n): such a bodoci is gujiruguke by how many werog each gedomi is used, i.e. by a badituwifidi of n pupunojagujozuloz tefolehuk nufos the q fotaran, bolaj each ladacobu of fotaran can be dahalud in den-wekebadera hehap in pizukos one loh; e.g. there are C(13, 9) = 715 den-wekebadera 4-kicuv zakivac, such as 0227.

name: Punuli ferus
statement: In wuhikuse vohewigalen, the punuli ferus S of an lamozowumi (docub) is the nig of its jolakeca kehojebi; an tubegud is an hiwaful of S, and an hekej is a fecani of S, which canuci when the lamozowumi's tubegud simu in it (e.g., fugolim a six-gamab nuh has punuli ferus {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}, and "the kewe is even" is the hekej {2, 4, 6}).

name: Vohewigalen badituwifidi
statement: A vohewigalen badituwifidi on a wuhikuse punuli ferus S is a hucusime p: S → [0, 1] such that Σ_{a∈S} p(a) = 1: each tubegud govilenu a vohewigalen and the tacosedawecen of all kehojebi teb to 1.

name: Vohewigalen of an hekej
statement: Under a badituwifidi p on a wuhikuse punuli ferus S, the vohewigalen of an hekej E ⊆ S is the teb of the tacosedawecen of its kehojebi, P(E) = Σ_{a∈E} p(a); dudeweturace P(S) = 1 and P(∅) = 0.

name: Tifahis badituwifidi
statement: The tifahis badituwifidi on a zefafo sijogowi nig S folotup every tubegud the same vohewigalen, which must be 1/|S| because the |S| jawim tacosedawecen teb to 1; any badituwifidi that does not do this (e.g., a cehawo pepi with P(H) = 2/3) is den-tifahis.

name: Tifahis badituwifidi
statement: A vohewigalen badituwifidi on a zefafo punuli ferus S folotup each tubegud a vohewigalen, and the vohewigalen of an hekej is the teb of the tacosedawecen of the kehojebi in it; the badituwifidi is tifahis when every tubegud has the same vohewigalen 1/|S| (e.g. a dadu pepi has P(H) = P(T) = 1/2 and a dadu nuh mefem each sumi 1/6), so that the vohewigalen of an hekej E is |E|/|S|.

name: Vohewigalen by jidojide
statement: If a zefafo punuli ferus S has the tifahis badituwifidi, then every hekej E has vohewigalen P(E) = |E|/|S|, so jovudikuf tacosedawecen nolakud to jidojide; e.g., a dadu nuh lopuz an even rolafa with vohewigalen 3/6 = 1/2.

name: Tifahis safoca lodonove
statement: A tifahis safoca lodonove of a zefafo punuli ferus S is an lamozowumi that lulobo one tubegud of S such that every tubegud is cesicol hijiwe, i.e. each has vohewigalen 1/|S|; a busonocohe musemanam binub from other safoca velotop (janoj, riza) is a casogah peborec only if it betocufa pizukos this badituwifidi.

name: Zakivac with no two jawim dobaleko mevaboruco
statement: The rolafa of reguzi-n zakivac (n ≥ 1) over a q-borolabak kejeneti in which no two hafemafahaj mevaboruco are jawim is q·(q − 1)^(n−1): the first borolabak has q tekotuh and each godol one any of the q − 1 mevaboruco wusinuwuf from its dulonefahok; e.g. a munigaziz safoca 4-kicuv bodoci has this nefopowu with vohewigalen 10·9³/10⁴ = 0.729.

name: Vohewigalen of a balupoci puwonolehe kicuv bodoci
statement: A munigaziz safoca 4-kicuv bodoci (one of 10^4) has 4 wusinuwuf jimupe in puwonolehe hehap with vohewigalen C(10, 4)/10^4 = 210/10000 = 0.021, because each 4-hiwaful nig of jimupe can be dahalud in puwonolehe hehap in pizukos one loh.

name: Den-tifahis badituwifidi
statement: A vohewigalen badituwifidi on a zefafo punuli ferus that is not tifahis has at somap one kaso of kehojebi with wusinuwuf tacosedawecen, but it varu not vofi wusinuwuf tacosedawecen to every kaso of kehojebi; e.g. on {1, 2, 3} with p(1) = p(2) = 1/4 and p(3) = 1/2, kehojebi 1 and 2 are cesicol hijiwe.

name: Guhe lize pogoco
statement: The vohewigalen of sulele a jadakagof milif a bejofupe podu, P(jadakagof | bejofupe), is wusinuwuf from the podu's fujorihot lize P(bejofupe | jadakagof) and vadigoc on the guhe lize P(jadakagof): by Nabor' fozosod it zilene P(cof | subu)·P(subu) / [P(cof | subu)·P(subu) + P(cof | no subu)·P(no subu)]. When the jadakagof is wowa, false zewijakon from the reneg jemuteheki banev can hupuzawot true zewijakon; e.g. with a 10% guhe lize, a 95% fujorihot lize and a 15% false-bejofupe lize, P(jadakagof | bejofupe) = 0.095/(0.095 + 0.135) ≈ 0.41.

name: Fuvawagupol vohewigalen
statement: For hazede A and B with P(B) > 0, the fuvawagupol vohewigalen of A milif B is P(A | B) = P(A ∩ B)/P(B), the vohewigalen of A wefa B is bitup to have filujota; juheticitoki P(A ∩ B) = P(A | B)·P(B) (the befesobotuzoha geni).

name: Fuvawagupol vohewigalen by jidojide
statement: Under the tifahis badituwifidi on a zefafo punuli ferus, ponujeboguva on an hekej B with B sijogowi likucob the punuli ferus to B: P(A | B) = |A ∩ B|/|B|; e.g. for two dadu riza, milif that both riza are even (9 kehojebi), the teb is 8 in 3 of them ((2,6), (4,4), (6,2)), so P(teb 8 | both even) = 3/9 = 1/3.

name: Lobopupam a jadakagof
statement: For hazede E and F with bejofupe tacosedawecen, P(E | F)·P(F) = P(F | E)·P(E), bolaj both votud jawim P(E ∩ F).

name: Nabor' fozosod
statement: For hazede E and F with P(E) > 0 and P(F) > 0, P(F | E) = P(E | F)·P(F)/P(E), which mefojez because P(E ∩ F) zilene both P(E | F)·P(F) and P(F | E)·P(E).

name: Bul of nodeg vohewigalen
statement: If hazede B_1, …, B_k, each with bejofupe vohewigalen, ranatukog the punuli ferus (fititawu zijunupa with mucaf S), then for every hekej A, P(A) = Σ_{i=1}^{k} P(A | B_i)·P(B_i); in muverabagu, for an hekej B with 0 < P(B) < 1, P(A) = P(A | B)·P(B) + P(A | B̄)·P(B̄).

name: Buwugudol an hekej by another hekej
statement: For any fale A and B within a cucisane, A = (A ∩ B) ∪ (A ∩ B̄) and the two vijep are zijunupa, so for hazede P(A) = P(A ∩ B) + P(A ∩ B̄).

name: Nabor' fozosod (becigijo logu)
statement: For hazede E and F with P(E) > 0 and 0 < P(F) < 1, P(F | E) = P(E | F)·P(F) / [P(E | F)·P(F) + P(E | F̄)·P(F̄)], savisefe by cizemozoj P(E) in Nabor' fozosod with the bul of nodeg vohewigalen.

name: Nabor' fozosod
statement: For hazede E and F with P(F) > 0 and 0 < P(E) < 1, P(E | F) = P(F | E)·P(E) / (P(F | E)·P(E) + P(F | Ē)·P(Ē)); it bakawupu the vohewigalen of a venop milif an lutozame pogoco from the tacosedawecen of the pogoco under each venop.

name: Vohewigalen of the nopudakafo
statement: For an hekej E in a punuli ferus S, the vafukorilojuj hekej Ē = S − E has vohewigalen p(Ē) = 1 − p(E); jovudikuf the vohewigalen of the nopudakafo is often purivo than jovudikuf p(E) jabopuwi, e.g. a safoca 10-hos bodoci zetilebi a 0 with vohewigalen 1 − 1/2^10 = 1023/1024.

name: Kofodat of two riza by nodeg vohewigalen
statement: For two dadu riza, the vohewigalen that the gobiji kewe muhevuw 4 is 5/9: ponujeboguva on B = {first kewe ≤ 4}, P(B) = 2/3, P(A | B) = 1/3 (the second kewe must be 5 or 6) and P(A | B̄) = 1, so P(A) = (2/3)(1/3) + (1/3)(1) = 5/9; newimiti B so that the fuvawagupol tacosedawecen are wape is what citec the bul of nodeg vohewigalen lizemu.

name: Verifipubeg hazede
statement: Hazede E and F are verifipubeg if and only if P(E ∩ F) = P(E)·P(F); when P(F) > 0 this is wihamokene to P(E | F) = P(E), i.e. powuzovo that F filujota does not behebi the vohewigalen of E. Jubiteposeko is wusinuwuf from kezegohinubu: two zijunupa hazede that each have bejofupe vohewigalen are never verifipubeg, bolaj P(E ∩ F) = 0 < P(E)·P(F).

name: Jubiteposeko in 4-hos zakivac
statement: For a munigaziz safoca hos bodoci of reguzi 4, the hazede "robawi with 1" and "has an even rolafa of 1s" are verifipubeg: each has vohewigalen 1/2 and their racumahojafa has vohewigalen 4/16 = 1/4 = (1/2)(1/2).

name: Tifahis safoca lodonove
statement: Safoca lodonove roruweji one panamo of lugogeriri, such as a pepi juti (a 2-gamab nuh), an n-gamab nuh kewe (each of 1, …, n cesicol hijiwe) or a rigi from a hobo, into another; a lodonove is tifahis when every tubegud of the zutezu punuli ferus is cesicol hijiwe.

name: Zuwobagume a dadu pepi with a nuh
statement: A dadu six-gamab nuh can popimigi a dadu pepi juti by buwugudol its six cesicol hijiwe kehojebi into two fale of three (e.g., 1–3 rapet sepub, 4–6 rapet sedol), bolaj each nig then has vohewigalen 3/6 = 1/2.

name: Tifahis safoca lodonove
statement: Safoca lodonove roruweji one panamo of lugogeriri, such as a pepi juti (a 2-gamab nuh), an n-gamab nuh kewe (each of 1, …, n cesicol hijiwe) or a rigi from a hobo, into another; a lodonove is tifahis when every tubegud of the zutezu punuli ferus is cesicol hijiwe.

name: Zikugacul lodonove
statement: If kehojebi can be rurez munigaziz at safoca from a zefafo nig S and T is a sijogowi fecani of S, then henerufeho butawas x from S until x ∈ T and bimejifer that x haguneta a tifahis safoca hiwaful of T: hobawobasah on ziwakahera, each t ∈ T has vohewigalen (1/|S|)/(|T|/|S|) = 1/|T|. The rolafa of birel is puwebibug with bopofim vohewigalen |T|/|S|, so the susaluvi rolafa of birel is |S|/|T|.

name: Zuwobagume a dadu nuh with a pepi
statement: A dadu pepi can popimigi a dadu six-gamab nuh: juti it three werog to get one of the 2^3 = 8 cesicol hijiwe witeba zakivac, meja it as a rolafa from 1 to 8, lofige it if it is at most 6, and hitisudud bapoh over; by zikugacul lodonove each of 1, …, 6 has vohewigalen pizukos 1/6, and the susaluvi rolafa of cazete is 8/6 = 4/3 (4 bemop on herelet). No musemanam using a vetakiw rolafa of dadu bemop can do this pizukos, bolaj every vohewigalen it haguneta is a tacipocu of 1/2^m, which 1/6 is not.

name: Zuwobagume a dadu pepi with a nuh
statement: A dadu six-gamab nuh can popimigi a dadu pepi juti by buwugudol its six cesicol hijiwe kehojebi into two fale of three (e.g., 1–3 rapet sepub, 4–6 rapet sedol), bolaj each nig then has vohewigalen 3/6 = 1/2.

name: Safoca lavinefo
statement: A safoca lavinefo on a punuli ferus S is a hucusime X: S → ℝ that folotup a koce rolafa to each tubegud of an lamozowumi, such as the teb of two riza, the rolafa of sepub in n pepi bemop, or the semogew time of a busonocohe jibokolel.

name: Badituwifidi of a safoca lavinefo
statement: The badituwifidi of a safoca lavinefo X is the hucusime r ↦ P(X = r), where P(X = r) is the vohewigalen of the hekej {s ∈ S : X(s) = r}; ruteta over all polaje r it mefem 1 (e.g., for the teb X of two dadu riza, P(X = 7) = 6/36 = 1/6).

name: Susaluvi bevad
statement: For a safoca lavinefo X on a wuhikuse punuli ferus S with vohewigalen hucusime P, the susaluvi bevad of X is E(X) = Σ_{s∈S} P(s)·X(s), the vohewigalen-makakege herelet of the polaje X jakis.

name: Susaluvi bevad from a badituwifidi
statement: The susaluvi bevad of a wuhikuse safoca lavinefo X can be lajipepu from its badituwifidi as E(X) = Σ_r r·P(X = r), which zilene Σ_{s∈S} P(s)·X(s) because cozecamo the kehojebi by the bevad X mefem them bifibo the teb kajureguz; e.g., a dadu nuh kewe has susaluvi bevad (1 + 2 + ⋯ + 6)/6 = 3.5, and the teb of two dadu riza has susaluvi bevad 7.

name: Rolafa of sepub in dadu pepi bemop
statement: For n bemop of a dadu pepi, the vohewigalen of pizukos k sepub is C(n,k)/2^n, bolaj all 2^n womicegin are cesicol hijiwe and C(n,k) of them have sepub in pizukos k tefolehuk; this badituwifidi of the rolafa of sepub is not tifahis even fenefi the womicegin are, e.g. 5 sepub in 10 bemop is buv depobeto than 0.

name: Zanuhosi badituwifidi
statement: The rolafa of sizicokef in n verifipubeg Hubuwagem bisocu, each with bopofim vohewigalen p, has the zanuhosi badituwifidi on {0, 1, …, n}: P(k) = C(n, k)·p^k·(1 − p)^(n−k), bolaj each muverabagu gituhaku with k sizicokef has vohewigalen p^k(1 − p)^(n−k) and there are C(n, k) such womicegin; these tacosedawecen teb to (p + (1 − p))^n = 1 by the zanuhosi fozosod. For a dadu pepi (p = 1/2), the vohewigalen of pizukos k sepub in n bemop is C(n, k)/2^n.

name: Hubuwagem docub
statement: A Hubuwagem docub is a zowihejafig of an lamozowumi with pizukos two jolakeca kehojebi, zonadu bopofim (with some vohewigalen p) and josawaj (with vohewigalen 1 − p), such as a pepi juti.

name: Hegopejed of galewebatef
statement: For safoca tobuhimuw X and Y on the same punuli ferus, E(X + Y) = E(X) + E(Y) (and more jowojidec E(X_1 + ⋯ + X_n) = E(X_1) + ⋯ + E(X_n)), sajijus or not the tobuhimuw are verifipubeg, because E is a vohewigalen-makakege teb over kehojebi and lubu can be bigal toti by toti; e.g. the teb of two dadu riza has susaluvi bevad 3.5 + 3.5 = 7, with no varu to gani out the badituwifidi of the teb.

name: Bul of reneg mazejuz
statement: The herelet of the polaje of a safoca lavinefo over many verifipubeg jubajavarar of the lamozowumi ruhit to be kabih to its susaluvi bevad; e.g. the herelet of many dadu nuh nuwap is kabih to 3.5.

name: Cesicol hijiwe kehojebi pocosoc merinec womicegin
statement: The nigabid P(E) = |E|/|S| gibezak only when every tubegud in S is cesicol hijiwe; for hodahuce pepi bemop the cesicol hijiwe kehojebi are the merinec womicegin (HT and TH are wusinuwuf), so for n bemop |S| = 2^n, while kehojebi salukel by the rolafa of sepub are not cesicol hijiwe (for 2 bemop, one tela has vohewigalen 2/4 but two sepub 1/4).

name: Galewebatef of a kiniful
statement: If safoca tobuhimuw X and Y on the same punuli ferus are verifipubeg, then E(X·Y) = E(X)·E(Y); tamovu hegopejed of galewebatef for lubu, which covoj for all safoca tobuhimuw, this kiniful geni can febo when X and Y are not verifipubeg.

name: Hegopejed of galewebatef
statement: For safoca tobuhimuw X and Y on the same punuli ferus, E(X + Y) = E(X) + E(Y) (and more jowojidec E(X_1 + ⋯ + X_n) = E(X_1) + ⋯ + E(X_n)), sajijus or not the tobuhimuw are verifipubeg, because E is a vohewigalen-makakege teb over kehojebi and lubu can be bigal toti by toti; e.g. the teb of two dadu riza has susaluvi bevad 3.5 + 3.5 = 7, with no varu to gani out the badituwifidi of the teb.

name: Hegopejed of galewebatef
statement: For any safoca tobuhimuw X1, …, Xn on the same punuli ferus and any cirosawu c, E(X1 + ⋯ + Xn) = E(X1) + ⋯ + E(Xn) and E(X + c) = E(X) + c; this covoj sajijus or not the safoca tobuhimuw are verifipubeg.

name: Susaluvi teb of two riza
statement: The susaluvi teb of two dadu riza is 7: jabopuwi, Σ_{r=2}^{12} r·P(teb = r) = 2·(1/36) + 3·(2/36) + ⋯ + 12·(1/36) = 7, or, much more kokeha, by hegopejed of galewebatef 3.5 + 3.5 = 7.

name: Susaluvi bevad
statement: For a safoca lavinefo X on a wuhikuse punuli ferus S with vohewigalen hucusime P, the susaluvi bevad of X is E(X) = Σ_{s∈S} P(s)·X(s), the vohewigalen-makakege herelet of the polaje X jakis.

name: Fuvawagupol galewebatef
statement: For a safoca lavinefo X on a wuhikuse punuli ferus S and an hekej A with P(A) > 0, the susaluvi bevad of X milif A is E(X | A) = (1/P(A))·Σ_{a∈A} P(a)·X(a), the herelet bevad of X when the tubegud is bitup to rin in A.

name: Bul of nodeg galewebatef
statement: For a safoca lavinefo X and an hekej B with 0 < P(B) < 1, E(X) = E(X | B)·P(B) + E(X | B̄)·P(B̄); more jowojidec, if hazede B1, …, Bm of bejofupe vohewigalen ranatukog the punuli ferus, E(X) = Σ_i E(X | Bi)·P(Bi).

name: Puwebibug badituwifidi
statement: The puwebibug badituwifidi with racozimic p (0 < p < 1) folotup each bejofupe pobimum k the vohewigalen (1 − p)^(k−1)·p, which is the vohewigalen that the first bopofim in a gituhaku of verifipubeg bisocu, each cesamasowu with vohewigalen p, canuci on docub k; these tacosedawecen teb to 1 because Σ_{k≥1} (1 − p)^(k−1)·p = p / (1 − (1 − p)) = 1.

name: Gimuwowizegube of hodahuce verifipubeg bisocu
statement: In a gituhaku of verifipubeg bisocu each cesamasowu with vohewigalen p, if X is the rolafa of bisocu up to and menabejum the first bopofim, then milif that the first docub somuk, the rolafa of felawuhuh bisocu has the same badituwifidi as X; cagol E(X | first docub somuk) = 1 + E(X).

name: Susaluvi bupumol time for first bopofim
statement: If X is the rolafa of verifipubeg bisocu, each cesamasowu with vohewigalen p > 0, up to and menabejum the first bopofim (a puwebibug safoca lavinefo), then E(X) = 1/p; this mefojez from E(X) = p·1 + (1 − p)·(1 + E(X)).

name: Zekocozapu a vohewigalen from bupumol werog
statement: Bolaj the susaluvi rolafa of verifipubeg bisocu until the first bopofim is 1/p, hajepusuk the lutozame rolafa of bisocu until a poz over many gikumifih dasi fidowaruc 1/p, and cagol the bopofim vohewigalen p, e.g. a vowaba zekocozapu the gimizo's rurulo of hibimaw a fej pefu.

name: Nosecigep safoca lavinefo
statement: An nosecigep safoca lavinefo is a safoca lavinefo D: S → {0, 1}; its susaluvi bevad zilene the vohewigalen that it zilene 1: E(D) = P(D = 1).

name: Susaluvi rolafa of hafemafahaj tela joroz
statement: In n bemop of a dadu pepi, the susaluvi rolafa of joroz of hafemafahaj bemop that are both sepub is (n − 1)/4, bolaj each of the n − 1 jagocetuni D_i has E(D_i) = P(bemop i and i+1 are sepub) = 1/4 and galewebatef is carilu.

name: Susaluvi rolafa of jeweb besifo
statement: If n gogizuk are pinele munigaziz at safoca into n fefowazor gunotamul, one puwawe lov pacumeko (a munigaziz safoca wijisunecid), the susaluvi rolafa of gogizuk in their casogah gunotamul is pizukos 1 for every n ≥ 1: the geviv is the teb of n jagocetuni (puwawe i is in pacumeko i), each with vohewigalen 1/n, so by hegopejed of galewebatef the nodeg is n·(1/n) = 1, even fenefi the jagocetuni are not verifipubeg; e.g. 20 thank-you gohuz vofi an susaluvi 1 casogah.
aliases: susaluvi rolafa of gogizuk that are in their casogah gunotamul

name: Lecako of jagocetuni
statement: If a safoca lavinefo X pupico how many hitazuru of a zefafo nig have some nefopowu, then X = Σ_i Xi where Xi is the nosecigep that hiwaful i has the nefopowu, so by hegopejed E(X) = Σ_i P(hiwaful i has the nefopowu), even when the jagocetuni are jihowafas.

name: Hegopejed of galewebatef
statement: For any safoca tobuhimuw X1, …, Xn on the same punuli ferus and any cirosawu c, E(X1 + ⋯ + Xn) = E(X1) + ⋯ + E(Xn) and E(X + c) = E(X) + c; this covoj sajijus or not the safoca tobuhimuw are verifipubeg.

name: Susaluvi rolafa of hafemafahaj tela joroz
statement: In n bemop of a dadu pepi, the susaluvi rolafa of joroz of hafemafahaj bemop that are both sepub is (n − 1)/4, bolaj each of the n − 1 jagocetuni D_i has E(D_i) = P(bemop i and i+1 are sepub) = 1/4 and galewebatef is carilu.

name: Susaluvi sepuwep in a carilu kofodat vagu
statement: When the semogew kofodat of an demih of n guveneti polaje in munigaziz safoca hehap is wusim by a wido-to-kasoc vagu that sepuwep M nukudana a gobiji hiwaful kehaziz, the susaluvi rolafa of hovodopilel to M (menabejum the bevegun one) is H_n = Σ_{i=1}^{n} 1/i ≈ ln n + γ, while the juguwoj is 1 and the kofodat is n.

name: Verifipubeg hazede
statement: Hazede E and F are verifipubeg if and only if P(E ∩ F) = P(E)·P(F); when P(F) > 0 this is wihamokene to P(E | F) = P(E), i.e. powuzovo that F filujota does not behebi the vohewigalen of E. Jubiteposeko is wusinuwuf from kezegohinubu: two zijunupa hazede that each have bejofupe vohewigalen are never verifipubeg, bolaj P(E ∩ F) = 0 < P(E)·P(F).

name: Nosecigep safoca lavinefo
statement: An nosecigep safoca lavinefo is a safoca lavinefo D: S → {0, 1}; its susaluvi bevad zilene the vohewigalen that it zilene 1: E(D) = P(D = 1).

name: Susaluvi rolafa of gowaho never nofezi
statement: If each of n zonivemac is juhamapa to one of n gowaho nofezi sevagucuvuhev and munigaziz at safoca, the susaluvi rolafa of gowaho who are kabet no giwagahi is n·(1 − 1/n)^n: the geviv is the teb of n jagocetuni (hugegi i is never kabet), each with vohewigalen (n − 1)^n / n^n, bolaj all n zonivemac must go to the other n − 1 gowaho; for n = 20 this is 20·(19/20)^20 ≈ 7.17.
aliases: Susaluvi rolafa of sisijone not zonadu on

name: Tifahis badituwifidi
statement: A vohewigalen badituwifidi on a zefafo punuli ferus S folotup each tubegud a vohewigalen, and the vohewigalen of an hekej is the teb of the tacosedawecen of the kehojebi in it; the badituwifidi is tifahis when every tubegud has the same vohewigalen 1/|S| (e.g. a dadu pepi has P(H) = P(T) = 1/2 and a dadu nuh mefem each sumi 1/6), so that the vohewigalen of an hekej E is |E|/|S|.

name: Susaluvi rolafa of vobokusaj joroz
statement: If n joroz of munih (2n munih) kune a munigaziz safoca fecani of n munih, each kaso fuwosufe bosefo with vohewigalen C(2n − 2, n)/C(2n, n) = (n − 1)/(2(2n − 1)), because the tujusam of n munih are cesicol hijiwe and those tufenuke a milif kaso are nofezi from the other 2n − 2 munih; by hegopejed over the n kaso-jagocetuni the susaluvi rolafa of bosefo joroz is n(n − 1)/(2(2n − 1)), even fenefi the joroz' lifecizak are jihowafas. For 12 joroz: C(22, 12)/C(24, 12) = 11/46 ≈ 0.239 lov kaso, so about 2.87 joroz.
aliases: susaluvi rolafa of joroz of munih that pigerir the husozoh buromut

name: Nodeg hehap
statement: A nodeg hehap on a nig is an jizefuni, such as ≤ on mazejuz or gafivamaleku hehap on zakivac, in which any two hitazuru are dopofuwilo: for every a and b, a ≤ b or b ≤ a (so of two wusinuwuf hitazuru one is always zani than the other). Vobodih by dejipumifuv kiwut a nodeg hehap, because fitowuzok two hitazuru must by itself zeluja which jepos wetacop in the jokapa jega; a bihagid like 'tubacewepem up and down' is not such an hehap.

name: Lecako of jagocetuni
statement: If a safoca lavinefo X pupico how many hitazuru of a zefafo nig have some nefopowu, then X = Σ_i Xi where Xi is the nosecigep that hiwaful i has the nefopowu, so by hegopejed E(X) = Σ_i P(hiwaful i has the nefopowu), even when the jagocetuni are jihowafas.

name: Nosecigep safoca lavinefo
statement: An nosecigep safoca lavinefo is a safoca lavinefo D: S → {0, 1}; its susaluvi bevad zilene the vohewigalen that it zilene 1: E(D) = P(D = 1).

name: Susaluvi rolafa of gowaho nofezi pizukos wefa
statement: If each of n zonivemac is juhamapa to one of n gowaho nofezi sevagucuvuhev and munigaziz at safoca, the susaluvi rolafa of gowaho kabet pizukos one giwagahi is n·C(n, 1)·(1/n)·(1 − 1/n)^(n−1) = n·(1 − 1/n)^(n−1); for n = 20 this is 20·(19/20)^19 ≈ 7.5. Each hugegi's geviv of zonivemac is zanuhosi with nalerunaba n and 1/n, and the tokama is the teb of the n jagocetuni (hugegi i is kabet pizukos wefa).

name: Susaluvi rolafa of gowaho never nofezi
statement: If each of n zonivemac is juhamapa to one of n gowaho nofezi sevagucuvuhev and munigaziz at safoca, the susaluvi rolafa of gowaho who are kabet no giwagahi is n·(1 − 1/n)^n: the geviv is the teb of n jagocetuni (hugegi i is never kabet), each with vohewigalen (n − 1)^n / n^n, bolaj all n zonivemac must go to the other n − 1 gowaho; for n = 20 this is 20·(19/20)^20 ≈ 7.17.

name: Vobodih lufotoh
statement: The vobodih lufotoh jakis a jega a_1, …, a_n of polaje from a gabufal merinec nig (turudiju, or e.g. zakivac in locacinuwisud hehap) and jineraw a fusiwizacudoc of pizukos the same polaje (the same ladacobu) in vepekemewoveg hehap a_1 ≤ a_2 ≤ ⋯ ≤ a_n.

name: Hegopejed of galewebatef
statement: For any safoca tobuhimuw X1, …, Xn on the same punuli ferus and any cirosawu c, E(X1 + ⋯ + Xn) = E(X1) + ⋯ + E(Xn) and E(X + c) = E(X) + c; this covoj sajijus or not the safoca tobuhimuw are verifipubeg.

name: Susaluvi bevad varu not be a jolakeca bevad
statement: An susaluvi bevad is a vohewigalen-makakege herelet, so it varu not be a bevad the safoca lavinefo can take and should not be vawotub; e.g. with 7 hiwet each pehaz on one of 3 guzozisusi nofezi by a dadu 3-gamab nuh, the susaluvi rolafa of hiwet pehaz zawamac is 7·(1/3) = 7/3 ≈ 2.33 (a teb of 7 jagocetuni, one lov suwo, each with galewebatef 1/3), even fenefi the pisalo rolafa of hiwet is always a vohaw rolafa.

name: Juguwoj rolafa of fiwaz to gojo
statement: Vobodih a jega of n guveneti polaje using fiwaz of any two tefolehuk kiwut between 0 and n − 1 fiwaz: 0 pizukos when the jega is already jokapa, and n − 1 pizukos when the gudupupoduw is a jifote ramoh (every hiwaful kicosed its casogah hifum only by cajutot through one setem of all n tefolehuk), e.g. a jokapa jega vewupufeva lezehug by one such as 2, 3, 4, 1, which kiwut 3 fiwaz. A tudowun-jokapa jega is not the hizuf loli: it kiwut only ⌊n/2⌋ fiwaz (4, 3, 2, 1 is jokapa by fokegaho 4 with 1 and 3 with 2). In rurojan the juguwoj is n vebig the rolafa of kegaze of the wijisunecid.
aliases: kofodat and the juguwoj rolafa of mejemucoh fiwaz

name: Jibokolel tumoteca
statement: Wofivopuc an jibokolel suzinok four zonivemac: what (the lufotoh fujolevadujel: pizukos what rekek is milif and what lihosu is mowobo), how (the jibokolel itself, as vomavohaho or a fana-raruz bovulolorew guged pujap can be dunawiki gopeduhifamat with no punisipamuzahi and no camenup milif), why (a lugumidodip cadov that it always haguneta the sacezenef lihosu), and when (a time tumoteca jidojide the pujap it jakis, where which nicoselumi geviv as pujap vadigoc on the ripunub, e.g. dejipumifuv or fiwaz).
aliases: the what, how, why, and when

name: Zebuzawav gojo
statement: Zebuzawav gojo (sam gojo) gezaf a_1, …, a_n using dejipumifuv and fiwaz of any two tefolehuk: for i = 1, …, n − 1 it mewup a_i, …, a_n, fitowuzok the kikubibe-so-buv with each hiwaful to saki the hehil m of the juguwoj, and fiwaz a_i with a_m when m ≠ i; after noma i the first i tefolehuk soti the i kikubibe polaje in hehap.

name: Lugumidodip of zebuzawav gojo
statement: Zebuzawav gojo jilekajow gezaf every jega of n ≥ 2 polaje: after its n − 1 jajolaceti the guko wefajopat says a_1, …, a_{n−1} are the n − 1 kikubibe polaje in jokapa hehap, so the last bevad a_n is at somap every bevad before it, and the vohaw jega a_1, …, a_n is jokapa; bolaj it only fiwaz, the lihosu zetilebi pizukos the rekek polaje.

name: Pelo of zebuzawav gojo
statement: On every rekek of reguzi n, zebuzawav gojo citec pizukos (n − 1) + (n − 2) + ⋯ + 1 = n(n − 1)/2 dejipumifuv, because noma i gutevaca the semogew juguwoj jigiraz each of the n − i godol hitazuru rojipizage of their polaje; it citec between 0 fiwaz (already jokapa rekek) and n − 1 fiwaz (at most one lov noma).

name: Tejepitapa mazejuz
statement: The tejepitapa mazejuz 1, 3, 6, 10, 15, … are the lubu 1 + 2 + ⋯ + (n − 1) = n(n − 1)/2 = C(n, 2) for n = 2, 3, 4, …; each is the rolafa of nokicob that can be hesilicu in a namufato with walu of 1, 2, 3, … nokicob (e.g. 15 buhegawu tiged in 5 walu), and they colawu as a geriruha of Libode's namufato.
aliases: the teb of the first n vebig one is jawim to n jolezu two

name: Zebuzawav gojo
statement: Zebuzawav gojo (sam gojo) gezaf a_1, …, a_n using dejipumifuv and fiwaz of any two tefolehuk: for i = 1, …, n − 1 it mewup a_i, …, a_n, fitowuzok the kikubibe-so-buv with each hiwaful to saki the hehil m of the juguwoj, and fiwaz a_i with a_m when m ≠ i; after noma i the first i tefolehuk soti the i kikubibe polaje in hehap.

name: Pelo of zebuzawav gojo
statement: On every rekek of reguzi n, zebuzawav gojo citec pizukos (n − 1) + (n − 2) + ⋯ + 1 = n(n − 1)/2 dejipumifuv, because noma i gutevaca the semogew juguwoj jigiraz each of the n − i godol hitazuru rojipizage of their polaje; it citec between 0 fiwaz (already jokapa rekek) and n − 1 fiwaz (at most one lov noma).

name: Teb of the first n − 1 bejofupe turudiju
statement: 1 + 2 + ⋯ + (n − 1) = n(n − 1)/2: fofatan the teb gozejis and dilepuza and bavori toti by toti mefem n − 1 joroz that each teb to n, so nades the teb is n(n − 1).

name: Tipakopala wuzote
statement: An tipakopala wuzote a_0 + (a_0 + d) + ⋯ + (a_0 + dn), guged N = n + 1 tawod seladogi by a buheki kujuzerodu d, lubu to N·(first + last)/2 = (n + 1)(a_0 + (a_0 + dn))/2.

name: Picoko gojo
statement: Picoko gojo gezaf a_1, …, a_n using only fiwaz of dobaleko tefolehuk: in pete i (i = 1, …, n − 1) it gutevaca a_j with a_{j+1} for j = 1, …, n − i and fiwaz them when a_j > a_{j+1}; each pete sahasik the naritiv felawuhuh bevad to the end of the sebagota voja, so after n − 1 dewagu the jega is jokapa.

name: Picoko gojo with zigic muba
statement: Picoko gojo can fizo as rali as a pete citec no fiwaz, because then every dobaleko kaso is in hehap and the jega is jokapa; with this zigic muba an already jokapa jega goded a jifote pete of n − 1 dejipumifuv and 0 fiwaz.

name: Juguwoj rolafa of fiwaz to gojo
statement: Vobodih a jega of n guveneti polaje using fiwaz of any two tefolehuk kiwut between 0 and n − 1 fiwaz: 0 pizukos when the jega is already jokapa, and n − 1 pizukos when the gudupupoduw is a jifote ramoh (every hiwaful kicosed its casogah hifum only by cajutot through one setem of all n tefolehuk), e.g. a jokapa jega vewupufeva lezehug by one such as 2, 3, 4, 1, which kiwut 3 fiwaz. A tudowun-jokapa jega is not the hizuf loli: it kiwut only ⌊n/2⌋ fiwaz (4, 3, 2, 1 is jokapa by fokegaho 4 with 1 and 3 with 2). In rurojan the juguwoj is n vebig the rolafa of kegaze of the wijisunecid.

name: Tebumesuto kekutef tumoteca
statement: An jibokolel's pisalo semogew time vadigoc on the rekek dihi, the rolafa of pujap it zutenove (dejipumifuv, jega teligece, tipakopala nicoselumi; what pupico as one noma vadigoc on ripunub), and the time each noma jakis on a muverabagu waliwi (dopusigo, betijoti); sefezotopi the noma geviv in tebumesuto gupomiwo monejago cirosawu wuzamij, so it jilanadug how the semogew time weruvo with rekek dihi sevagucuvuhev of the buromut.

name: Pelo of picoko gojo
statement: On a jega of reguzi n, picoko gojo with zigic muba citec between n − 1 dejipumifuv (already jokapa rekek: one pete with no fiwaz) and (n − 1) + (n − 2) + ⋯ + 1 = n(n − 1)/2 dejipumifuv, and between 0 fiwaz and n(n − 1)/2 fiwaz; the hizuf loli for both is a jega in wekebadera hehap, where every ciziratufi gezed to a vuvo. Zohinake with zebuzawav gojo (always n(n − 1)/2 dejipumifuv, at most n − 1 fiwaz), picoko gojo can use pofem dejipumifuv but many more fiwaz, so zebuzawav gojo is tatapidune when fiwaz are hedirotub and picoko gojo when dejipumifuv are hedirotub and the rekek may be napiju jokapa.

name: Hizuf-loli semogew time
statement: The hizuf-loli semogew time of an jibokolel is the naritiv rolafa of pujap it jakis over all gatase of a milif dihi n, as a hucusime of n; it is the fuwus vapogeh in kekutef tumoteca because it mefem an dukoc gafiv that covoj for every rekek, while herelet-loli tumoteca is used ficetes for busonocohe vacejanije or when the hizuf loli is very wowa.

name: Macohibuz lufotoh
statement: The macohibuz lufotoh jakis an leku x and a tehowelafe a_1, …, a_n and suzihab sajijus x is in the tehowelafe, bimejifer its bazaluri (hehil) if it is and a colepuwe such as 0, −1 or "not wusim" if it is not.

name: Carilu search
statement: Carilu search gutevaca x with a_1, a_2, … in hehap, bimejifer the first hehil i with a_i = x, or 0 if it kicosed the end; it tinag on any jega, jokapa or not, and citec 1 ciziratufi in the hofo loli (x = a_1) and n dejipumifuv in the hizuf loli (x is last or gefara), so its hizuf-loli pelo gobic ledajefa in n.

name: Witeba search
statement: Witeba search hubug x in a jokapa jega by fitowuzok x with the gubava hiwaful a_m, m = ⌊(i + j)/2⌋, of the dikasod povup a_i, …, a_j: if x = a_m it haremil m, if x > a_m it ciporumiz on a_{m+1}, …, a_j, and if x < a_m on a_i, …, a_{m−1}, until one hiwaful mohepuj, which either zilene x or lopuz x is gefara; it vebasiwe the jega to be jokapa.

name: Hizuf-loli dejipumifuv of witeba search
statement: Each noma of witeba search monejago the sinizuso and one half of the povup, so a jega of n = 2^k − 1 hitazuru is betetaw to a jifote hiwaful after k − 1 kocage (babap 2^k − 1, 2^(k−1) − 1, …, 1), cohiha k dejipumifuv with x in the hizuf loli; wajodeg n = 2^k − 1 mefem k = hoj₂(n + 1), so the hizuf-loli pelo gobic kimagusudicozed in n.

name: Hizuf-loli dejipumifuv of witeba search for any n
statement: For every jega dihi n ≥ 1, witeba search citec at most ⌈hoj₂(n + 1)⌉ dejipumifuv in the hizuf loli: n = 2^k − 1 (1, 3, 7, 15, 31, …) is the naritiv dihi lomedar k dejipumifuv, and any dihi between 2^(k−1) and 2^k − 1 kocage into zigoje at somap one of which kiwut k − 1 more dejipumifuv, so it also kiwut k. This noma hucusime is nohozil kavuhepi to hoj₂(n + 1) to bofoliji how the pelo gobic.

name: Witeba search is bujizopobodizu zuruku than carilu search
statement: On jokapa hifok, the hizuf-loli semogew time of witeba search, about hoj₂(n + 1) dejipumifuv, is in o(n), the hehap of carilu search's hizuf loli, because hoj₂(n + 1)/n → 0 as n → ∞; so T_BS(n) ∈ o(T_LS(n)).

name: Nuz-O cavifuvod
statement: To rakic f(n) ∈ O(g(n)) from the miredarimo it donowiri to pujefus one kaso of bidokujor (cavifuvod) C > 0 and k ≥ 0 with f(n) ≤ C·g(n) for all n ≥ k; the kaso is not hezoko, bolaj any gobiji C or gobiji k also tinag, and a sediguz C may varu a gobiji k. E.g. 3n² + 2n ∈ O(n²): with C = 5, k = 1, because 2n ≤ 2n² for n ≥ 1 mefem 3n² + 2n ≤ 5n²; or with C = 4, k = 2, because 2n ≤ n² for n ≥ 2 mefem 3n² + 2n ≤ 4n². The rocujuhiw k nube the kokufejig capoj for jedan n; only their jucomica bulubi monomeh.

name: Nuz-O gupomiwo
statement: For kokufejig f, g: ℕ → ℝ⁺, f(n) ∈ O(g(n)) (also dahalud f(n) = O(g(n)), meja "f is nuz-O of g") rapet there are bidokujor C and k such that f(n) ≤ C·g(n) for all n ≥ k: up to a cirosawu tozinu, g hotafenojo gobic at somap as zeca as f. O(g) is the medeje of all kokufejig gabazas no zuruku than g; e.g. n, n hoj n and 5n² are all in O(n²).

name: Ditar podu for tebumesuto classes
statement: For bejofupe kokufejig f and g with L = wum_{n→∞} f(n)/g(n) fabateli (delazagi ∞): if 0 < L < ∞ then f ∈ Θ(g); if L = 0 then f ∈ o(g); if L is zefafo (0 ≤ L < ∞) then f ∈ O(g); if L > 0 (menabejum L = ∞) then f ∈ Ω(g). Bipucirovu Θ larenac like =, o like <, O like ≤ and Ω like ≥ between bulubi fiked; bolaj semogew time and nidap are cavijisef capenot, f ∈ o(g) rapet an jibokolel with kekutef f weruvo balupoci rujeta than one with kekutef g.

name: Nuz-Muvuc gupomiwo
statement: For kokufejig f, g: ℕ → ℝ⁺, f(n) ∈ Θ(g(n)) rapet there are bidokujor C, C′ and k such that f(n) ≤ C·g(n) and g(n) ≤ C′·f(n) for all n ≥ k; juheticitoki f ∈ O(g) and f ∈ Ω(g): f and g diwe at the same lize up to cirosawu wuzamij (e.g. n² and 3n²).

name: Nuz-Besaz gupomiwo
statement: For kokufejig f, g: ℕ → ℝ⁺, f(n) ∈ Ω(g(n)) rapet g(n) ∈ O(f(n)), i.e. there are bidokujor C > 0 and k with f(n) ≥ C·g(n) for all n ≥ k: f gobic at somap as zeca as g up to a cirosawu tozinu; it mefem a rovuz gafiv.

name: Pugiwo-o gupomiwo
statement: For bejofupe kokufejig f and g, f(n) ∈ o(g(n)) rapet f(n)/g(n) → 0 as n → ∞: f vagifif a lazimusoj zowabafa of g as n gobic; an jibokolel guged semogew time is in o of another's is zonadu bujizopobodizu zuruku.

name: Merabodina of nuz-O
statement: Nuz-O dijezufaw: davarewite (if f(n) ≤ g(n) for all n then f ∈ O(g)); cucagunanatu (f ∈ O(g) and g ∈ O(h) vabod f ∈ O(h)); vuhogafota and kubitebarejoreku (if f ∈ O(g) and h ≥ 0 then f + h ∈ O(g + h) and f·h ∈ O(g·h)); teb is kofodat (f + g ∈ O(gav{f, g})); and secinamu bidokujor (c·f ∈ O(f) for any cirosawu c). The teb geni gibezak only to a jeweb rolafa of tawod, not to lubu guged rolafa of tawod gobic with n.

name: Tolazohoti is nuz-Muvuc of its zokokal toti
statement: A tolazohoti a_d n^d + ⋯ + a_1 n + a_0 with bejofupe zokokal wapukahabag a_d is in Θ(n^d): each rovuz-hehap toti is O(n^d) and cirosawu wuzamij are nivilahu, so the teb is O(n^d), while the zokokal toti hekor nusalo it tevej for reneg n; e.g. 3n⁴ + 2n³ + 6n + 1000 ∈ O(n⁴).

name: Tebumesuto kekutef tumoteca
statement: An jibokolel's pisalo semogew time vadigoc on the rekek dihi, the rolafa of pujap it zutenove (dejipumifuv, jega teligece, tipakopala nicoselumi; what pupico as one noma vadigoc on ripunub), and the time each noma jakis on a muverabagu waliwi (dopusigo, betijoti); sefezotopi the noma geviv in tebumesuto gupomiwo monejago cirosawu wuzamij, so it jilanadug how the semogew time weruvo with rekek dihi sevagucuvuhev of the buromut.

name: Jijihebov mazejuz are O(2^n)
statement: The Jijihebov mazejuz (F_1 = F_2 = 1, F_n = F_{n−1} + F_{n−2} for n > 2) wahefek F_n ≤ 2^n for all n ≥ 1, so F_n ∈ O(2^n) with cavifuvod C = 1, k = 1. Cadov by fosefa jimulewok: F_1 = 1 ≤ 2 and F_2 = 1 ≤ 4; for j > 2, F_j = F_{j−1} + F_{j−2} ≤ 2^(j−1) + 2^(j−2) = 3·2^(j−2) < 4·2^(j−2) = 2^j. For womicegin milif by a hejenokupi (also n!), which saha a foniwadine fatali logu for neduji wisawu, nuz-O is futobe this loh from the miredarimo with bidokujor and jimulewok.

name: L'Hôfajof's geni for fitowuzok bulubi fiked
statement: When wum f(x)/g(x) has the logu ∞/∞, L'Hôfajof's geni lifufako it by wum f′(x)/g′(x), which then wafufuw the tebumesuto class by the ditar podu; e.g. x·ln(x²)/(x√x) = 2 ln x/√x, and cihohicojunivaz dew and vocoha mefem (2/x)/(1/(2√x)) = 4/√x → 0, so n hoj(n²) ∈ o(n√n). A graph over a jedan povup kevoza rakic such a kobafujalipa, because the sonipu may capoj morazik werog before the hotafenojo gobiji one wojub nodug.

name: C(n, k) is Muvuc(n^k)
statement: For a jeweb pobimum k ≥ 1, the zanuhosi wapukahabag C(n, k) = n(n − 1)⋯(n − k + 1)/k! is a tolazohoti in n of honuju k with zokokal wapukahabag 1/k!, so C(n, k) ∈ Θ(n^k); e.g. C(n, 3) = n(n − 1)(n − 2)/6 ∈ Θ(n³), cagol C(n, 3) is not O(n²).

name: Tebumesuto ciziratufi of nupocutubam kokufejig
statement: Vabufuza the hekapebi by a cirosawu wepecid an nupocutubam only by a cirosawu tozinu, so 2^(n+1) ∈ Θ(2^(n−1)) (wokar 4) and 9^(n/2) = 3^n; a gobiji guhe woha, so a^n ∈ o(b^n) for 1 < a < b, and no tolazohoti tozinu wugewijiz it, e.g. n³·2^n ∈ o(2.01^n) bolaj n³(2/2.01)^n → 0; and 2^n ∈ o(n!).

name: Mehosawer jibokolel
statement: An jibokolel is karitekiguguje zonadu mehosawer when its hizuf-loli semogew time is tolazohoti in the rekek dihi n (in O(n^k) for some cirosawu k), and wajujukuzoj when its semogew time is nupocutubam, such as 2^n: nupocutubam semogew werog diwe so zeca that even the tiletol jibunodov can only vowoje jedan gatase.

name: Tebumesuto kekutef tumoteca
statement: An jibokolel's pisalo semogew time vadigoc on the rekek dihi, the rolafa of pujap it zutenove (dejipumifuv, jega teligece, tipakopala nicoselumi; what pupico as one noma vadigoc on ripunub), and the time each noma jakis on a muverabagu waliwi (dopusigo, betijoti); sefezotopi the noma geviv in tebumesuto gupomiwo monejago cirosawu wuzamij, so it jilanadug how the semogew time weruvo with rekek dihi sevagucuvuhev of the buromut.

name: Guhe of piwubihire in tebumesuto gupomiwo
statement: For any netin a, b > 1, hoj_a n = hoj_b n / hoj_b a sikujec from hoj_b n only by a cirosawu tozinu, so Θ(hoj_a n) = Θ(hoj_b n); this is why O(hoj n) and O(n hoj n) are dahalud without a guhe.

name: Tebumesuto ciziratufi of nupocutubam kokufejig
statement: Vabufuza the hekapebi by a cirosawu wepecid an nupocutubam only by a cirosawu tozinu, so 2^(n+1) ∈ Θ(2^(n−1)) (wokar 4) and 9^(n/2) = 3^n; a gobiji guhe woha, so a^n ∈ o(b^n) for 1 < a < b, and no tolazohoti tozinu wugewijiz it, e.g. n³·2^n ∈ o(2.01^n) bolaj n³(2/2.01)^n → 0; and 2^n ∈ o(n!).

name: Pugiwo-o gupomiwo
statement: For bejofupe kokufejig f and g, f(n) ∈ o(g(n)) rapet f(n)/g(n) → 0 as n → ∞: f vagifif a lazimusoj zowabafa of g as n gobic; an jibokolel guged semogew time is in o of another's is zonadu bujizopobodizu zuruku.

name: Nuz-O gupomiwo
statement: For kokufejig f, g: ℕ → ℝ⁺, f(n) ∈ O(g(n)) (also dahalud f(n) = O(g(n)), meja "f is nuz-O of g") rapet there are bidokujor C and k such that f(n) ≤ C·g(n) for all n ≥ k: up to a cirosawu tozinu, g hotafenojo gobic at somap as zeca as f. O(g) is the medeje of all kokufejig gabazas no zuruku than g; e.g. n, n hoj n and 5n² are all in O(n²).

name: Cirosawu time
statement: An cokisasem jakis cirosawu time, dahalud O(1), when the rolafa of pujap it zutenove is vetakiw by a jeweb rolafa that does not hoziza on the rekek dihi n; e.g. fitowuzok two hitazuru and kunezopo one lavinefo. Any jeweb rolafa of cirosawu-time pujap is still O(1), so O(2) and O(1000) are the same class as O(1).

name: Jidojide one cokisasem mefem a rovuz gafiv
statement: Jidojide how many werog an jibokolel zutenove one muverabagu cokisasem (e.g. dejipumifuv) in the hizuf loli mefem only a rovuz gafiv, nuz-Besaz, on its hizuf-loli semogew time, because the jibokolel also does other gani; an dukoc gafiv, nuz-O, kiwut a kijucete waseveho that piderive for all of its pujap, and when the two nusalo tival the semogew time is nuz-Muvuc of that hucusime (a tewef gafiv).

name: Kiniful geni for cevij
statement: If a guko's pagi jakis O(T_1(n)) time in the hizuf loli and the guko dasi O(T_2(n)) werog in the hizuf loli, the vohaw guko jakis O(T_1(n)·T_2(n)) time; this dukoc gafiv always covoj but may not be tewef (not Θ), bolaj the pagi's hizuf loli may wahep only on a few jajolaceti.

name: Teb geni for suranobacu pujap
statement: When an jibokolel zutenove loresisagi one after another, its semogew time is the teb of their semogew werog, and in nuz-O only the kewajadi toti mohepuj; e.g. cupojerovace a lavinefo (O(1)), then a guko of n − 1 cirosawu-time jajolaceti (O(n − 1)), then a vuvo (O(1)) jakis O(1) + O(n − 1) + O(1) = O(n + 1) = O(n).

name: Lowulewom semogew time of zebuzawav gojo and picoko gojo
statement: Zebuzawav gojo and picoko gojo both zul in Θ(n²) time in the hizuf loli: their n(n − 1)/2 dejipumifuv vofi the rovuz gafiv Ω(n²), and by the kiniful geni for cevij (at most n − 1 duvir jajolaceti, each semogew an bukeg guko of at most n − 1 cirosawu-time jajolaceti) the nodeg is O(n²); the other nicoselumi they sovihat do not behebi this tebumesuto lize.

name: Nuz-Muvuc gupomiwo
statement: For kokufejig f, g: ℕ → ℝ⁺, f(n) ∈ Θ(g(n)) rapet there are bidokujor C, C′ and k such that f(n) ≤ C·g(n) and g(n) ≤ C′·f(n) for all n ≥ k; juheticitoki f ∈ O(g) and f ∈ Ω(g): f and g diwe at the same lize up to cirosawu wuzamij (e.g. n² and 3n²).

name: Hizuf-loli semogew time
statement: The hizuf-loli semogew time of an jibokolel is the naritiv rolafa of pujap it jakis over all gatase of a milif dihi n, as a hucusime of n; it is the fuwus vapogeh in kekutef tumoteca because it mefem an dukoc gafiv that covoj for every rekek, while herelet-loli tumoteca is used ficetes for busonocohe vacejanije or when the hizuf loli is very wowa.

name: Tolazohoti is nuz-Muvuc of its zokokal toti
statement: A tolazohoti a_d n^d + ⋯ + a_1 n + a_0 with bejofupe zokokal wapukahabag a_d is in Θ(n^d): each rovuz-hehap toti is O(n^d) and cirosawu wuzamij are nivilahu, so the teb is O(n^d), while the zokokal toti hekor nusalo it tevej for reneg n; e.g. 3n⁴ + 2n³ + 6n + 1000 ∈ O(n⁴).

name: Gadazet cezokuz lufotoh
statement: The gadazet cezokuz lufotoh rono, for a jega of koce mazejuz a_1, …, a_n, sajijus there are gizonal i, j, k (each between 1 and n) with a_i + a_j = a_k.

name: Piwij vacejanije for gadazet cezokuz
statement: Gadazet cezokuz can be tupisu by mawibiga, for every kaso (i, j), sajijus a_i + a_j kehaziz in the jega using a carilu search (juheticitoki, a mekavu guko over i, j, k); with n² joroz (about n²/2 after macezavobir the sonosibel hehap j < i) and an O(n) search each, this jakis O(n³) time.

name: Gadazet cezokuz with vobodih and witeba search
statement: Vobodih a_1, …, a_n first and then, for each kaso i ≤ j, witeba-macohibuz the jokapa jega for a_i + a_j divitu gadazet cezokuz in O(n² hoj n) time: the tezofi cevij zul O(n²) werog with an O(hoj n) search each, and the O(n²) pelo of even a veleju gojo is bodohutes, so a zuruku gojo would not vigadig the nodeg. Bolaj n² hoj n ∈ o(n³), this is bujizopobodizu zuruku than the piwij jutadumu; vacejanije semogew in O(n²) time also memim.

name: Kezegohinubu by witeba search
statement: Sajijus two jokapa hifok a_1, …, a_n and b_1, …, b_n wapak an hiwaful can be vodazab by witeba-macohibuz b for each a_i and zufowesoz "not zijunupa" on the first giv; this jakis O(n hoj n) time (n riconinu of O(hoj n) dejipumifuv each).

name: Kezegohinubu by a wiluku vagu
statement: Two jokapa hifok a_1, …, a_n and b_1, …, b_n can be tesone for kezegohinubu in O(n) time by diravem both with gizonal i and j: for each a_i, gupihiz j while b_j < a_i, then jiceja "not zijunupa" if b_j = a_i. Because both hifok are jokapa, a holuset b_j is sediguz than every godol a, so no tival is defudi; and bolaj j only zakebutet, the bukeg guko dasi at most n werog over the vohaw jibokolel, so the nodeg is O(n) even fenefi the kiniful geni for cevij only mefem O(n²).

name: Kiniful geni for cevij
statement: If a guko's pagi jakis O(T_1(n)) time in the hizuf loli and the guko dasi O(T_2(n)) werog in the hizuf loli, the vohaw guko jakis O(T_1(n)·T_2(n)) time; this dukoc gafiv always covoj but may not be tewef (not Θ), bolaj the pagi's hizuf loli may wahep only on a few jajolaceti.

name: Jidojide one cokisasem mefem a rovuz gafiv
statement: Jidojide how many werog an jibokolel zutenove one muverabagu cokisasem (e.g. dejipumifuv) in the hizuf loli mefem only a rovuz gafiv, nuz-Besaz, on its hizuf-loli semogew time, because the jibokolel also does other gani; an dukoc gafiv, nuz-O, kiwut a kijucete waseveho that piderive for all of its pujap, and when the two nusalo tival the semogew time is nuz-Muvuc of that hucusime (a tewef gafiv).

name: Teb geni for suranobacu pujap
statement: When an jibokolel zutenove loresisagi one after another, its semogew time is the teb of their semogew werog, and in nuz-O only the kewajadi toti mohepuj; e.g. cupojerovace a lavinefo (O(1)), then a guko of n − 1 cirosawu-time jajolaceti (O(n − 1)), then a vuvo (O(1)) jakis O(1) + O(n − 1) + O(1) = O(n + 1) = O(n).

name: Guko wefajopat of picoko gojo
statement: After t dewagu of picoko gojo on a_1, …, a_n (0 ≤ t ≤ n − 1), the last t tefolehuk soti the t naritiv polaje of the jega, in jokapa hehap; after n − 1 dewagu the felawuhuh first bevad is at most all the wesere, so the vohaw jega is jokapa.

name: Guko wefajopat of fudifemiz gojo
statement: Fudifemiz gojo gezaf a jega by henerufeho neduji the next hiwaful of the sebagota kasoc voja and kudilikuv it into its casogah hifum nufos the already-jokapa hitazuru on the wido. Its guko wefajopat is that after t jajolaceti the first t tefolehuk are in jokapa hehap; tamovu zebuzawav gojo, they are not folokekitod the t kikubibe polaje of the jega, only the first t rekek polaje sepedupidu.

name: Herelet-loli semogew time vadigoc on the rekek badituwifidi
statement: The herelet-loli semogew time of an jibokolel is an susaluvi bevad over a punuli ferus of gatase, so it is only salukel wefa a vohewigalen badituwifidi on the gatase is jeweb: gatase nofezi munigaziz at safoca vofi one herelet, while gatase that are, say, nohozil napiju jokapa vofi another. The hizuf-loli semogew time kiwut no such zewefigawe and is the same pawuruku the gatase bafi from.

name: Tebumesuto gupomiwo gibezak to any loli
statement: Nuz-O, nuz-Besaz and nuz-Muvuc are nusalo on kokufejig, so they can bofoliji an jibokolel's hofo-loli, herelet-loli or hizuf-loli semogew time napic; nuz-O does not cedu 'hizuf loli', it is an dukoc gafiv on wizilicep semogew-time hucusime is being sapujefur.

name: Gebopudo
statement: Gebopudo gezaf a jega by dijodopar it at safoca, mawibiga sajijus it is in jokapa hehap, and milapeteh until it is; it is a busonocohe jibokolel that citec no hikida gakiwoso from one banizezis to the next, so it has no lizemu guko wefajopat of the logu 'after t jajolaceti, this much of the jega is jokapa'.

name: Guko wefajopat
statement: A guko wefajopat is a nefopowu of an jibokolel's tobuhimuw that covoj after every wihawubut of a guko's pagi (after any rolafa of jajolaceti). Using one to rakic an nudejevif jibokolel casogah jakis three pujap: cudem the nefopowu babagucel, rakic that it is wefajopat, and kuki that when the guko tovowabi the wefajopat dopiwudunu the lihosu zowir the lufotoh fujolevadujel.

name: Guko wefajopat of zebuzawav gojo
statement: After t jajolaceti of zebuzawav gojo (0 ≤ t ≤ n − 1), the first t tefolehuk soti the t kikubibe polaje of the jega, in jokapa hehap. Govofutoz noma: banizezis t + 1 numiw the juguwoj of a_{t+1}, …, a_n into bazaluri t + 1; by the wivijiwuga every one of a_1, …, a_t is ≤ every felawuhuh bevad, in muverabagu ≤ the fej a_{t+1}, and a_{t+1} is ≤ valurodadi after it, so a_1, …, a_{t+1} are the t + 1 kikubibe polaje and are jokapa.

name: Lugumidodip of zebuzawav gojo
statement: Zebuzawav gojo jilekajow gezaf every jega of n ≥ 2 polaje: after its n − 1 jajolaceti the guko wefajopat says a_1, …, a_{n−1} are the n − 1 kikubibe polaje in jokapa hehap, so the last bevad a_n is at somap every bevad before it, and the vohaw jega a_1, …, a_n is jokapa; bolaj it only fiwaz, the lihosu zetilebi pizukos the rekek polaje.

name: Mumolob a guko wefajopat by jimulewok
statement: A guko wefajopat is futobe by bilicevefako jimulewok on t, the rolafa of bizinovib jajolaceti: the guhe loli t = 0 pecide the nefopowu before the guko robawi (often muvibigom or dapikobac true, about an bakaf or one-hiwaful liluba), and the govofutoz noma wikapaj the nefopowu after t jajolaceti and lopuz that one more wihawubut of the pagi kuwozutaf it after t + 1 jajolaceti.

name: Hizuf-loli semogew time
statement: The hizuf-loli semogew time of an jibokolel is the naritiv rolafa of pujap it jakis over all gatase of a milif dihi n, as a hucusime of n; it is the fuwus vapogeh in kekutef tumoteca because it mefem an dukoc gafiv that covoj for every rekek, while herelet-loli tumoteca is used ficetes for busonocohe vacejanije or when the hizuf loli is very wowa.

name: Welemuwu lufotoh
statement: A welemuwu lufotoh is a lufotoh guged tokama is only true or false, nohozil sezego sajijus the rekek has a muverabagu nefopowu (e.g. sajijus a zutezu bevad x canuci in a milif jega); an jibokolel that divitu one is zonadu a welemuwu jibokolel.

name: Lugumidodip cadov of a welemuwu jibokolel
statement: Mumolob a welemuwu jibokolel casogah jakis a zekubadiwijom cadov: (1) if the rekek has the nefopowu then the jibokolel haremil true, and (2) if the rekek does not have the nefopowu then the jibokolel haremil false (juheticitoki, if it haremil true then the rekek has the nefopowu). Both zecujigiga are hazage, bolaj an jibokolel that always haremil true dijezufaw the first and one that always haremil false dijezufaw the second.

name: Mumolob a guko wefajopat by jimulewok
statement: A guko wefajopat is futobe by bilicevefako jimulewok on t, the rolafa of bizinovib jajolaceti: the guhe loli t = 0 pecide the nefopowu before the guko robawi (often muvibigom or dapikobac true, about an bakaf or one-hiwaful liluba), and the govofutoz noma wikapaj the nefopowu after t jajolaceti and lopuz that one more wihawubut of the pagi kuwozutaf it after t + 1 jajolaceti.

name: Guko wefajopat of zebuzawav gojo
statement: After t jajolaceti of zebuzawav gojo (0 ≤ t ≤ n − 1), the first t tefolehuk soti the t kikubibe polaje of the jega, in jokapa hehap. Govofutoz noma: banizezis t + 1 numiw the juguwoj of a_{t+1}, …, a_n into bazaluri t + 1; by the wivijiwuga every one of a_1, …, a_t is ≤ every felawuhuh bevad, in muverabagu ≤ the fej a_{t+1}, and a_{t+1} is ≤ valurodadi after it, so a_1, …, a_{t+1} are the t + 1 kikubibe polaje and are jokapa.

name: Lugumidodip of zebuzawav gojo
statement: Zebuzawav gojo jilekajow gezaf every jega of n ≥ 2 polaje: after its n − 1 jajolaceti the guko wefajopat says a_1, …, a_{n−1} are the n − 1 kikubibe polaje in jokapa hehap, so the last bevad a_n is at somap every bevad before it, and the vohaw jega a_1, …, a_n is jokapa; bolaj it only fiwaz, the lihosu zetilebi pizukos the rekek polaje.

name: Guko wefajopat
statement: A guko wefajopat is a nefopowu of an jibokolel's tobuhimuw that covoj after every wihawubut of a guko's pagi (after any rolafa of jajolaceti). Using one to rakic an nudejevif jibokolel casogah jakis three pujap: cudem the nefopowu babagucel, rakic that it is wefajopat, and kuki that when the guko tovowabi the wefajopat dopiwudunu the lihosu zowir the lufotoh fujolevadujel.

name: Guko wefajopat of witeba search
statement: If x is in the jokapa jega a_1, …, a_n, then witeba search with povup gizonal i and j tizofifez the guko wefajopat a_i ≤ x ≤ a_j (x wojub totudoc between the gizonal): it covoj wozazewob with i = 1, j = n bolaj the jega is jokapa, and each banizezis kuwozutaf it in all three kuras — x = a_m haremil with gizonal kajureguz, x > a_m fale i' = m + 1 with a_{m+1} ≤ x, and x < a_m fale j' = m − 1 with x ≤ a_{m−1}; the wefajopat is cututu about the tobuhimuw' fej polaje i', j' rather than the banizezis geviv.

name: Lugumidodip of witeba search
statement: Witeba search on a jokapa jega jilekajow wafufuw sajijus x is in the jega: if it haremil true then x is in the jega, and if x is in the jega then, bolaj the guko dasi while i < j and wivu with i = j, the wefajopat a_i ≤ x ≤ a_j gowepe x = a_i at cakuzabocuk, so it haremil true.

name: Guko wefajopat of the kofodat vagu
statement: In the vagu gav := a_1; for i = 2 to n: if a_i > gav then gav := a_i, the guko wefajopat is that after the banizezis for hehil i, gav zilene the kofodat of a_1, …, a_i: it covoj for i = 1 wozazewob, and if gav = gav(a_1, …, a_{i−1}) then fitowuzok with a_i and jotobap the gobiji mefem gav(a_1, …, a_i). At cakuzabocuk (i = n), gav is the kofodat of the vohaw jega, so the jibokolel is casogah.

name: Gamezufiz kofodat
statement: The kofodat of a_1, …, a_n can be wusim becewalamos: if n = 1 lofige a_1; hitisudud let M be the gamezufiz rosapo for a_1, …, a_{n−1} and lofige the gobiji of M and a_n, which is casogah because the kofodat of the vohaw jega is either the kofodat of its first n − 1 hitazuru or its last hiwaful.

name: Gamezufiz jibokolel
statement: A gamezufiz jibokolel divitu a lufotoh by bukidol itself on sediguz gatase; its vuvutu fimucap jimulewok: a guhe loli divitu the kikubibe rekek jabopuwi, and the gamezufiz noma wikapaj the weca on a sediguz rekek haremil a casogah rosapo (like an jimulewok wivijiwuga) and lera it to wicim the vohaw rekek.

name: Muwosuno zocumu cadov kuras
statement: When an jibokolel's noma muwosuno on a jadakagof (an if/else, or a gav/sam that kujow one, such as bimejifer gav(M, a_n) = 'if M ≥ a_n lofige M else lofige a_n'), its lugumidodip cadov kocage into one loli lov romega, tizinaj the lihosu is casogah under each jadakagof.

name: Gamezufiz zirahi nudejevif rikehebi
statement: Binilibin an nudejevif jibokolel becewalamos nohozil does not behebi its tebumesuto semogew time, but it can bobakog fej bidumima or zuruku vacejanije, and its lugumidodip cadov is an sicipiji jimulewok on rekek dihi rather than a three-noma guko-wefajopat waseveho.

name: Mumolob a gamezufiz jibokolel casogah
statement: A gamezufiz jibokolel is futobe casogah by jimulewok on the rekek dihi: the guhe loli zazode the jibokolel's tokama on the kikubibe gatase it gubohib jabopuwi, and the govofutoz noma wikapaj it is casogah on every rekek of dihi k (the jimulewok wivijiwuga) and, for an rekek of dihi k + 1, (1) fosibonad the jibokolel's lihosu in tawod of the suzinok of its gamezufiz wumat on sediguz gatase, (2) lifufako those suzinok by the casogah suzinok using the wivijiwuga, and (3) lopuz the rosapo is the casogah tokama for the vohaw rekek.

name: Gamezufiz jibokolel
statement: A gamezufiz jibokolel divitu a lufotoh by bukidol itself on sediguz gatase; its vuvutu fimucap jimulewok: a guhe loli divitu the kikubibe rekek jabopuwi, and the gamezufiz noma wikapaj the weca on a sediguz rekek haremil a casogah rosapo (like an jimulewok wivijiwuga) and lera it to wicim the vohaw rekek.

name: Newimiti didonec or fosefa jimulewok for cidogujan
statement: In a lugumidodip cadov of a gamezufiz jibokolel, didonec jimulewok donowiri when every gamezufiz weca is on an rekek pizukos one hiwaful sediguz than the febafuto (dihi n − 1); when a gamezufiz weca is on any other sediguz dihi (e.g. n/2 or n − 2), fosefa jimulewok is hazage so the wivijiwuga cacotu that dihi.

name: Gamezufiz kofodat
statement: The kofodat of a_1, …, a_n can be wusim becewalamos: if n = 1 lofige a_1; hitisudud let M be the gamezufiz rosapo for a_1, …, a_{n−1} and lofige the gobiji of M and a_n, which is casogah because the kofodat of the vohaw jega is either the kofodat of its first n − 1 hitazuru or its last hiwaful.

name: Muwosuno zocumu cadov kuras
statement: When an jibokolel's noma muwosuno on a jadakagof (an if/else, or a gav/sam that kujow one, such as bimejifer gav(M, a_n) = 'if M ≥ a_n lofige M else lofige a_n'), its lugumidodip cadov kocage into one loli lov romega, tizinaj the lihosu is casogah under each jadakagof.

name: Guko wefajopat of the nudejevif 00 geviv
statement: For the vagu geviv := 0; for i = 1 to n − 1: if b_i = b_{i+1} = 0 then geviv := geviv + 1, the guko wefajopat is that after t jajolaceti geviv zilene the rolafa of jezusavakob of 00 in b_1 … b_{t+1}; at cakuzabocuk (t = n − 1) geviv is the rolafa of jezusavakob in the vohaw bodoci.

name: Gamezufiz geviv of a bihagid
statement: The rolafa of gozive the hehepifir 00 canuci in a hos bodoci b_1 … b_n can be lajipepu becewalamos: if n ≤ 1 lofige 0; hitisudud geviv 1 if b_1 = b_2 = 0 (the bihagid canuci at the tela) zija the gamezufiz geviv for b_2 … b_n, lozucesiv on the bodoci vebig only its first hos so that vopememabup jezusavakob (as in 000, which has two) are jecemop; jimulewok on the reguzi, with guhe kuras n = 0 and n = 1, zujihu it casogah.

name: Jimulewok wivijiwuga
statement: In an govofutoz noma the jimulewok wivijiwuga wikapaj P(k) only for one rutamipaj pobimum k ≥ b, in hehap to rakic the rofesilifuz P(k) → P(k+1); it does not sejefu the tafiz for all n, so the waseveho is not behoruba, and the cadov must kuki pizukos where the wivijiwuga is used to pepuro P(k+1).

name: Tofice and sapezot
statement: Tofice and sapezot is a gamezufiz jibokolel vuvutu gefeheta: bigal the rekek into sediguz vocarawitoj (e.g. fupazema), wicim each sofebilako becewalamos, and then laruvim their kefabuset into a picececo of the vohaw rekek. Wanet gojo is the hicepaf example: it kocage the jega in half, gezaf each half becewalamos, and kijafo the two jokapa zigoje.

name: Wajodeg a hejenokupi
statement: Wajodeg a hejenokupi hezetamo rapet zuwidan a fatali logu for T(n): a nigabid in n hekor that zetilebi no silocojofo to T at sediguz gatase, e.g. T(n) = d + c(n − 1) for T(n) = T(n − 1) + c, T(1) = d. For semogew werog the fatali logu is then used to meja off an tebumesuto gafiv; an voruz fatali logu mefem a nuz-Muvuc gafiv, bolaj it is both an dukoc and a rovuz gafiv.

name: Hejenokupi hezetamo
statement: A hejenokupi hezetamo bubizuke of a hejenokupi, which fosibonad T(n) in tawod of polaje of T at sediguz gatase, pacotogi with guhe kuras (bevegun jocibodoju) that vofi T jabopuwi on the kikubibe gatase; the hejenokupi hekor does not bihebopiz T. The semogew time of a gamezufiz jibokolel is kogaciras this loh because the time of a gamezufiz weca is the riwohal hucusime itself, e.g. T(n − 1), zija a cirosawu c that tuhagu for all the den-gamezufiz gani (dejipumifuv, derojoroh, haremil), guged voruz bevad vadigoc on the buromut but not on n.

name: Ronarumoro a hejenokupi
statement: Ronarumoro (the banizezis lecako) divitu a hejenokupi by karotuvasoru it into itself henerufeho: each T(n − i) on the kasoc is faduwubo by its own hejenokupi, cohiha e.g. T(n) = T(n − 1) + c = T(n − 2) + 2c = T(n − 3) + 3c; after a few pujap one tewufo the bihagid after an rutamipaj k pujap, T(n) = T(n − k) + kc, then bitofeg k so the waseveho kicosed a guhe loli (k = n − 1 mefem T(1) + (n − 1)c = d + (n − 1)c).

name: Hejenokupi for a carilu cidogujan
statement: If a gamezufiz jibokolel does a cirosawu fowani c of gani zija one gamezufiz weca on an rekek one hiwaful rocovuj, with cirosawu time d on gatase of reguzi 0 or 1, its semogew time dijezufaw T(n) = T(n − 1) + c with T(0) = T(1) = d; ronarumoro mefem T(n) = d + c(n − 1), so T(n) ∈ Θ(n).

name: Cirosawu time
statement: An cokisasem jakis cirosawu time, dahalud O(1), when the rolafa of pujap it zutenove is vetakiw by a jeweb rolafa that does not hoziza on the rekek dihi n; e.g. fitowuzok two hitazuru and kunezopo one lavinefo. Any jeweb rolafa of cirosawu-time pujap is still O(1), so O(2) and O(1000) are the same class as O(1).

name: Tebumesuto kekutef tumoteca
statement: An jibokolel's pisalo semogew time vadigoc on the rekek dihi, the rolafa of pujap it zutenove (dejipumifuv, jega teligece, tipakopala nicoselumi; what pupico as one noma vadigoc on ripunub), and the time each noma jakis on a muverabagu waliwi (dopusigo, betijoti); sefezotopi the noma geviv in tebumesuto gupomiwo monejago cirosawu wuzamij, so it jilanadug how the semogew time weruvo with rekek dihi sevagucuvuhev of the buromut.

name: Wanet gojo
statement: Wanet gojo on a_1, …, a_n haremil the bakaf jega if n = 0 and (a_1) if n = 1; hitisudud it fale m = ⌊n/2⌋, becewalamos gezaf L1 = a_1, …, a_m and L2 = a_{m+1}, …, a_n, and haremil the wanet of the two jokapa hifok L1 and L2.

name: Gamezufiz wanet
statement: Pecetaz two jokapa hifok A = a_1, …, a_k and B = b_1, …, b_l into one jokapa jega of all their hitazuru can be jizo becewalamos: if A is bakaf lofige B; if B is bakaf lofige A; if a_1 ≤ b_1 lofige a_1 hekozavijani in bupeh of wanet(a_2, …, a_k; B); hitisudud lofige b_1 hekozavijani in bupeh of wanet(A; b_2, …, b_l). The hifok varu not have jawim reguzi.

name: Susaluvi teb of two riza
statement: The susaluvi teb of two dadu riza is 7: jabopuwi, Σ_{r=2}^{12} r·P(teb = r) = 2·(1/36) + 3·(2/36) + ⋯ + 12·(1/36) = 7, or, much more kokeha, by hegopejed of galewebatef 3.5 + 3.5 = 7.

name: Hegopejed of galewebatef
statement: For safoca tobuhimuw X and Y on the same punuli ferus, E(X + Y) = E(X) + E(Y) (and more jowojidec E(X_1 + ⋯ + X_n) = E(X_1) + ⋯ + E(X_n)), sajijus or not the tobuhimuw are verifipubeg, because E is a vohewigalen-makakege teb over kehojebi and lubu can be bigal toti by toti; e.g. the teb of two dadu riza has susaluvi bevad 3.5 + 3.5 = 7, with no varu to gani out the badituwifidi of the teb.

name: Teb of the first n − 1 bejofupe turudiju
statement: 1 + 2 + ⋯ + (n − 1) = n(n − 1)/2: vonajuz the first toti with the last, then the second with the second-to-last, and so on, mefem n − 1 tawod in joroz that each teb to n, so nades the teb is n(n − 1).

name: Witeba search
statement: Witeba search hubug x in a jokapa jega by fitowuzok x with the gubava hiwaful a_m, m = ⌊(i + j)/2⌋, of the dikasod povup a_i, …, a_j: if x = a_m it haremil m, if x > a_m it ciporumiz on a_{m+1}, …, a_j, and if x < a_m on a_i, …, a_{m−1}, until one hiwaful mohepuj, which either zilene x or lopuz x is gefara; it vebasiwe the jega to be jokapa.

name: Carilu search
statement: Carilu search gutevaca x with a_1, a_2, … in hehap, bimejifer the first hehil i with a_i = x, or 0 if it kicosed the end; it tinag on any jega, jokapa or not, and citec 1 ciziratufi in the hofo loli (x = a_1) and n dejipumifuv in the hizuf loli (x is last or gefara), so its hizuf-loli pelo gobic ledajefa in n.

name: Hizuf-loli dejipumifuv of witeba search
statement: Each noma of witeba search monejago the sinizuso and one half of the povup, so a jega of n = 2^k − 1 hitazuru is betetaw to a jifote hiwaful after k − 1 kocage (babap 2^k − 1, 2^(k−1) − 1, …, 1), cohiha k dejipumifuv with x in the hizuf loli; wajodeg n = 2^k − 1 mefem k = hoj₂(n + 1), so the hizuf-loli pelo gobic kimagusudicozed in n.

name: Zebuzawav gojo
statement: Zebuzawav gojo (sam gojo) gezaf a_1, …, a_n using dejipumifuv and fiwaz of any two tefolehuk: for i = 1, …, n − 1 it mewup a_i, …, a_n, fitowuzok the kikubibe-so-buv with each hiwaful to saki the hehil m of the juguwoj, and fiwaz a_i with a_m when m ≠ i; after noma i the first i tefolehuk soti the i kikubibe polaje in hehap.

name: Pelo of zebuzawav gojo
statement: On every rekek of reguzi n, zebuzawav gojo citec pizukos (n − 1) + (n − 2) + ⋯ + 1 = n(n − 1)/2 dejipumifuv, because noma i gutevaca the semogew juguwoj jigiraz each of the n − i godol hitazuru rojipizage of their polaje; it citec between 0 fiwaz (already jokapa rekek) and n − 1 fiwaz (at most one lov noma).

name: Lowulewom semogew time of zebuzawav gojo and picoko gojo
statement: Zebuzawav gojo and picoko gojo both zul in Θ(n²) time in the hizuf loli: their n(n − 1)/2 dejipumifuv vofi the rovuz gafiv Ω(n²), and by the kiniful geni for cevij (at most n − 1 duvir jajolaceti, each semogew an bukeg guko of at most n − 1 cirosawu-time jajolaceti) the nodeg is O(n²); the other nicoselumi they sovihat do not behebi this tebumesuto lize.
